jobs.description:
Job Title: Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business (B2B & B2G)

Reporting Relationship:Executive Director, Strategic Partnership Expansion

Unit: National & Global

Department: Strategic Partnerships - IWU National & Global

Campus Location: Online/Remote within the United States

Summary of Position:The Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business represents IWU–National & Global and the DeVoe School of Business in developing B2B and B2G organizational partnerships that create sustainable enrollment pipelines for working professionals and adult learners.

This role focuses on employer-driven talent development by connecting organizations with IWU’s business degree portfolio, including traditional business programs, leadership and management pathways, graduate business programs, MBA-related offerings, and emerging AI-focused business programs and certificates. The position helps employers address workforce needs by developing talent pipelines, career ladders, upskilling pathways, and retention solutions.

The Partnership Development Executive serves as a consultative relationship builder with Human Resources leaders, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, municipal and government HR divisions, and other employer decision makers.

This position is designed for a high-potential, relationship-driven professional with non-negotiable excellence in written and verbal communication, professional polish, business acumen, strategic curiosity, and disciplined follow-through. A background in human resources, talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations is strongly preferred. The successful candidate will identify prospective partners, initiate outreach, conduct professional discovery meetings, present tailored business and AI education solutions, manage pipeline milestones in Salesforce, collaborate with DeVoe faculty and academic leaders, and advance opportunities toward signed partnership agreements.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • B2B and B2G Partnership Development, Discovery, and Advancement
    • Identifies and initiates outreach to prospective employer partners across private-sector, nonprofit, workforce, municipal, and government/public-sector organizations
    • Prepares for and leads professional, agenda-driven discovery meetings with HR executives, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, City/County HR Directors, state agency HR leaders, workforce leaders, and other organizational decision-makers
    • Positions IWU DeVoe School of Business programs, including traditional business degrees and AI-focused business programs and certificates, as strategic solutions for employer talent pipelines, career ladders, employee upskilling, succession planning, leadership development, and retention
    • Writes clear, polished prospecting emails, executive summaries, meeting recaps, and tailored proposals linking organizational workforce goals to IWU degree and certificate pathways
    • Presents IWU educational solutions, tuition discount benefits, cohort opportunities, and Prior Learning Assessment options clearly and persuasively
    • Works collaboratively with leadership to navigate decision-making pathways, address objections, establish clear next steps, and secure formal partnership agreements using institutional legal templates
    • Develops consultative relationships that move beyond general awareness or event attendance and toward measurable partnership, enrollment, and workforce outcomes
  • Targeted Market Outreach, Strategic Events, & Lead Generation
    • Develops and executes targeted regional outreach plans for priority employers, workforce development boards, chambers of commerce, professional associations, HR networks, and business organizations
    • Builds strategic presence within key professional organizations and employer networks, including SHRM, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, talent development groups, industry associations, municipal HR networks, and business leadership forums
    • Partners with DeVoe School of Business faculty by coordinating and exhibiting at events where DeVoe faculty are speaking, presenting, facilitating workshops, or representing the university as thought leaders
    • Leverages faculty expertise and public speaking engagements to generate qualified employer conversations, strengthen DeVoe’s market visibility, and connect organizational needs to IWU programs
    • Uses selective event attendance strategically by conducting pre-event outreach, securing scheduled one-on-one meetings, engaging decision makers during the event, and completing disciplined post-event follow-up
    • Employs market research and AI-enabled prospecting tools to identify workforce trends, talent shortages, skill gaps, AI adoption needs, leadership development opportunities, and high-yield employer targets
    • Represents IWU and the DeVoe School of Business with professionalism at employer meetings, association events, conferences, workforce forums, and community-based business events
  • CRM Pipeline Discipline, Follow-Through, & AI Workflow Utilization
    • Maintains uncompromising daily discipline in Salesforce as the system of record for all accounts, contacts, meeting notes, pipeline stages, and follow-up tasks
    • Demonstrates meticulous follow-through by executing committed action items promptly and maintaining momentum across all active partner relationships
    • Utilizes CRM performance metrics and pipeline management tools to prioritize outreach, track conversion rates, and meet weekly/monthly activity benchmarks
    • Leverages artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication drafting, and data analysis
    • Ensures that all partner activity is documented accurately, timely, and completely to support team visibility, leadership reporting, and effective handoff
  • Internal Collaboration & Academic Pathway Alignment
    • Collaborates closely with the DeVoe School of Business Dean, faculty, program directors, and academic leaders to understand program offerings, emerging AI curriculum, business programs, custom cohort opportunities, and employer education capabilities
    • Coordinates with DeVoe faculty to support speaking engagements, professional organization involvement, employer-facing workshops, and thought leadership opportunities that can generate partnership conversations
    • Partners with Enrollment Counselors, Marketing, Legal, Operations, and Student Success teams to ensure responsive communication, smooth handoffs, and tailored recruitment campaigns for partner employees
    • Communicates employer feedback, workforce trends, market intelligence, and partnership barriers to academic and enrollment leaders to support continuous improvement and program alignment
    • Helps translate academic offerings into employer-relevant language focused on workforce outcomes, employee development, retention, promotion pathways, and organizational performance
    • Supports internal planning for co-branded employer materials, landing pages, employee communication plans, webinars, information sessions, and partnership launch activities
  • Partner Onboarding, Activation, & Relationship Transition
    • Coordinates the initial onboarding process for newly signed partners, including launch communications, co-branded landing pages, employee announcements, webinars, lunch-and-learns, and discovery sessions
    • Ensures early partner engagement and qualified student interest before transitioning mature accounts to designated long-term account nurture managers or appropriate internal owners
    • Documents onboarding steps, communication commitments, stakeholder contacts, and future engagement opportunities in Salesforce
    • Supports a smooth transition from signed agreement to active enrollment pipeline by coordinating internal teams and ensuring timely follow-up with partner contacts
    • Monitors early partner activity to identify additional opportunities for employee engagement, cohort development, program alignment, and future growth

Qualifications:According to Indiana Wesleyan University employment policy all employees must possess a strong Christian commitment and adhere to the standards outlined in the IWU Community Lifestyle Statement.

Education

  • Required: Minimum of a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Preferred: Master's degree in business, Human Resources, Management, Leadership, Communication, Higher Education, or equivalent experience

Experience

  • Required:
    Minimum of two to four (2-4) years of successful professional experience in human resources, talent development, learning and development, workforce development, organizational development, B2B sales, B2G sales, business development, partnership development, account management, employer relations, higher education recruitment, corporate recruitment, or a related externally facing role
  • Preferred:
    Experience working with employers, HR leaders, workforce organizations, business associations, chambers of commerce, professional associations, government agencies, or talent development networks
  • Ideal Background:
    A candidate with a talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations background is strongly preferred because this role requires understanding of workforce planning, employee development, career ladders, retention, talent pipelines, and organizational learning needs
  • IWU is willing to consider candidates with less direct partnership development experience if they demonstrate exceptional communication skills, strong business acumen, professional presence, coachability, initiative, and disciplined follow-through

Required Skills

  • Exceptional Written Communication:
    Proven ability to write clear, polished, persuasive, and error-free business correspondence, prospecting emails, meeting recaps, executive summaries, and proposals. A writing assessment may be part of the interview process
  • Professional Presentation and Executive Polish:
    Confidence, poise, and clarity when presenting to HR executives, C-suite leaders, workforce leaders, faculty, internal stakeholders, and professional business audiences
  • Business Acumen:
    Understanding of employer needs related to workforce planning, talent pipelines, career ladders, employee retention, leadership development, upskilling, succession planning, and organizational performance
  • Consultative Relationship Building:
    Ability to ask strong discovery questions, listen carefully, identify organizational needs, summarize opportunities accurately, and connect employer challenges to relevant IWU academic solutions
  • Strategic Thinking:
    Ability to evaluate partner fit, prioritize high-potential opportunities, plan outreach intentionally, and use events and professional networks to generate qualified partnership conversations
  • Disciplined Follow-Through and Organization:
    Strong time management, attention to detail, personal accountability, and proactive follow-through. Ability to set next steps, document commitments, and keep opportunities moving through the pipeline
  • Technology, CRM, and AI Acumen:
    Experience using CRM systems, pipeline management tools, and performance analytics. Proficiency with artificial intelligence tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication, and data analysis. Salesforce experience strongly preferred
  • Collaboration:
    Ability to work effectively with academic leaders, faculty, enrollment teams, marketing, legal, operations, and external partners to advance shared goals
  • Mission Fit:
    Personal ability to articulate and support the Christ-centered mission, values, and educational philosophy of Indiana Wesleyan University
  • Mobility:
    Valid driver’s license with an excellent driving record. Willing and able to travel approximately 50% across Central Indiana and surrounding regions, with occasional evening, weekend, and overnight travel. Able to lift 50lbs

IWU Kingdom Diversity Statement

IWU, in covenant with God's reconciling work and in accordance with the Biblical principles of our historic Wesleyan tradition, commits to build a community that reflects Kingdom diversity. We will foster an intentional environment for living, teaching and learning, which exhibits honor, respect, and dignity. Acknowledging visible or invisible differences, our community authentically values each member's earthly and eternal worth. We refute ignorance and isolation and embrace deliberate and courageous engagement that exhibits Christ's commandment to love all humankind.

LIMITATIONS AND DISCLAIMER

As a religious educational institution operating under the auspices of The Wesleyan Church, Indiana Wesleyan University is permitted and reserves the right to prefer employees on the basis of religion (42 U.S.C., Sections 2000e-1 and 2000e-2).

Employees will be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

jobs.description:
About N-Power Medicine

N-Power Medicine aims to establish a new paradigm in drug development by reinventing the ‘how’ and transforming clinical trials through better integration with clinical practice, ensuring broader participation by physicians and patients. We are building an exceptional multi-disciplinary team with diverse expertise spanning healthcare, engineering, technology and regulatory, and with people who share our core value of Empowering Community through generosity, curiosity and humility. We are working with urgency to bring better therapies to patients faster.

Position Overview

The Strategic Partner Executive is a senior account and implementation leader responsible for the end-to-end operations and success of the partnership with each assigned oncology network partner. This leader is the single point of accountability for ensuring network partners are fully activated and engaged in N-Power’s clinical programs and physicians are actively enrolling, advocating, and referring within and beyond their practice. This is a commercially minded role but is not a business development function, as it begins only after the deal is signed.

This role partners closely with on-site implementation staff to ensure staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day program execution run smoothly, while also building the physician relationships, advisory boards, and education materials that keep the partnership growing.

This position is remote within the United States, with regular travel to partner sites.

Role Objectives and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for each assigned oncology network partner from contract execution onward, owning overall account health, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

  • Ensure network partners are fully engaged and successfully running the company’s clinical programs, currently focused on Prospective ECAs (ProECAs).

  • Drive active, sustained physician engagement through enrollment, advocacy, and partner-sourced referrals to new network expansion opportunities.

  • Own end-to-end implementation and ongoing operations for each partner, partnering closely with on-site staff on staff roll-out, EHR integration, and day-to-day execution, and surfacing and resolving issues before they impact the relationship.

  • Establish a consistent partner engagement cadence including quarterly business reviews, partner check-ins, onsite visits, and physician advisory boards, blending tactical, day-to-day conversations with strategic discussions on growth, expansion, and advocacy to keep the relationship active between formal touchpoints.

  • Position N-Power as a true partner by ensuring the value we bring is delivered and clearly understood by physicians and practice staff.

  • Actively promote the clinical program within partner organizations, translating our value proposition into terms that resonate with physicians and research teams.

  • Build and continuously refine repeatable playbooks for partner management, physician engagement, and implementation that can scale across the network.

  • Monitor program performance and engagement metrics across the network, proactively addressing gaps.

  • Support the BD team during contract signing by providing operational and implementation insight — helping shape deal terms and expectations that set the partnership up for a smooth launch.

Education, Experience, Behavioral Competencies, & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, client services, or partnership roles within oncology, healthcare, or life sciences, ideally with direct exposure to clinical research and research site operations.

  • Working knowledge of how oncology research and physicians operate, including academic/community research workflows, practice business administration.

  • Experience with large health systems, including navigating multi-stakeholder relationships and organizational complexity.

  • Demonstrated strong commercial and strategic acumen.

  • Program or implementation management experience, including cross-functional coordination.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree a plus.

  • Generous, Curious & Humble.

Travel Requirements

  • As necessary for partner and physician relationships.

About CirrusMD:

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at cirrusmd.com.

JOB SUMMARY

The Client Success Executive (CSE) is responsible for developing and maintaining exceptional relationships with internal and client partners, ensuring clients achieve maximum value from the CirrusMD platform. The CSE owns retention and growth across an assigned book of business — identifying upsell opportunities, growing membership/covered lives, and meeting utilization goals. This role involves day-to-day client management, proactive engagement to understand and address client needs, and cross-functional collaboration to drive measurable success outcomes. The ideal candidate will have a background in mid- to large-scale client relationship management within healthcare services, with demonstrated success exceeding expectations while maintaining and growing their book.

ESSENTIAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Percent of time spent is approximate and totals 100%.

25% — Client Value, Relationships & Implementation

  • Client Value Realization: Work closely with clients to understand their business objectives and vision, and ensure the CirrusMD platform delivers measurable value aligned with those goals; share client objectives across the CirrusMD team.
  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned large, strategic accounts, managing day-to-day communications and building strong relationships with client stakeholders at all levels, up to and including the executive suite.
  • Onboarding, Implementation & Adoption: Manage intake and implementation of new projects from Client Success leadership and the Sales team; act as the key partner contact to facilitate implementation and hit go-live timelines, and drive adoption through training, best practices, and ongoing support.
  • Expectation Setting: Set proper client expectations based on knowledge of the CirrusMD platform, scope of relationship, and contractual requirements.

50% — Growth, Retention & Account Strategy

  • Client Growth & Upselling: Identify opportunities for account growth — including product upsell, cross-sell of complementary solutions, and growing membership/covered lives — and partner with Marketing to increase utilization across the book of business.
  • Retention & Renewal Management: Proactively manage client renewals, minimizing churn through ongoing engagement and demonstrated, continuous value.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Develop and maintain strategic account plans for growth and retention; strategize with clients on all opportunities to ensure solutions are being effectively utilized and expanded, and conceptualize new programs that deepen partner relationships.
  • Business Reviews & ROI Reporting: Develop and deliver business review presentations that demonstrate return on investment and program outcomes, and use ongoing review of those outcomes to recommend changes that optimize the CirrusMD platform to its full potential.
  • Client Health Monitoring: Regularly track and assess client health, using data and insights to identify risk and surface opportunities for deeper engagement and growth.
  • Performance Metrics & Reporting: Monitor key success metrics such as utilization and adoption rates, client satisfaction (NPS/CSAT), membership growth, and revenue; report progress and outcomes regularly to both clients and internal stakeholders.

25% — Collaboration, Advocacy & Market Insight

  • Issue Resolution: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring issues and concerns are addressed swiftly and effectively, coordinating with internal teams as necessary.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Sales Support, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, and Support to ensure a seamless client experience and to complete requests for proposals/information in a timely, accurate, and professional manner.

  • Client Presentations & Site Visits: Lead client presentations and facilitate site visits; routinely present product updates and roadmap to external client stakeholders; participate in Sales finalist presentations as needed.
  • Platform & Industry Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of CirrusMD's technical and operational set-up and how it is implemented to ensure platform optimization; stay current on company initiatives and industry trends.

Company Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Account Executive to originate, shape, and close transformational software partnerships with leading utilities. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercial builder who can create opportunity from ambiguity, lead a complex 6-12+ month enterprise sale, and earn credibility from the executive suite through technical, operational, procurement, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.

You will own account strategy and the commercial relationship for approximately 5–7 named Tier 1 utilities. You will build the business case, coordinate the full Gigawatt pursuit team, close an initial deployment, and remain accountable for major module and platform expansion. The role reports to GTM leadership and works closely across Gigawatt teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own named-account strategy and revenue: Develop and execute account plans for a focused portfolio of strategic utilities, with clear pathways from executive access and qualified opportunity through initial close and multi-module expansion.

Build pipeline from the ground up: Create opportunities through targeted outreach, industry relationships, partners, events, and insight-led engagement; maintain sufficient pipeline coverage to deliver against annual and multi-year revenue goals.

Lead the end-to-end enterprise sale: Drive discovery, qualification, solution shaping, value engineering, commercial proposals, RFI/RFP responses, procurement, negotiation, and contracting through close.

Multi-thread complex buying committees: Build trusted relationships across executive sponsors, operational and functional leaders, technology and security teams, procurement, finance, legal, and other key influencers. Identify champions, blockers, decision criteria, and the path to approval

Quarterback the opportunity team: Bring Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Services, Partnerships, and executives into each pursuit at the right time. Establish clear roles, next steps, decision gates, and accountability.

Navigate utility markets: Leverage deep understanding of utility procurement cycles, regulatory dynamics, long sales cycles, and risk-averse decision-making to shorten time-to-value and win strategic accounts.

Forecast with discipline: Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity plans, mutual action plans, pipeline reporting, and forecasts. Surface risks early and bring a clear point of view on how to create momentum.

Bring the market back into Gigawatt: Translate customer feedback, competitive intelligence, procurement patterns, and regulatory or market developments into actionable input for product strategy, positioning, and the GTM playbook.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a strong track record of originating and closing net-new business.
  • Demonstrated success personally closing complex, multi-year, seven-figure platform or transformation agreements with large enterprises.
  • Ability to build compelling business cases, quantify value, and communicate effectively with board-level, executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic account-planning skills, including identifying champions, economic buyers, decision-makers, and potential sources of resistance.
  • Technical curiosity and ability to develop fluency in an AI-native, data-intensive platform and its role within a customer's enterprise architecture.
  • Builder’s mindset with the ability to operate with pace, ambiguity, limited playbooks, and high personal accountability in an early-stage environment.
  • Excellent written, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with modern CRM, pipeline management, and rigorous forecasting practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into utilities, energy, or other regulated and infrastructure-intensive industries such as telecom, government/public sector, or similar.
  • Existing relationships and executive network within utilities and/or energy.
  • Experience selling AI, data, cloud, or other technically complex enterprise platforms.
  • Experience within a high-growth, early-stage or scale-up software company.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree is a plus.

Location

  • Remote but Chicago, Austin, Nashville are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Opportunity to shape a transformative AI product in a vital industry working with a rock-star team.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, remote work flexibility, and 401k match.
  • Collaborative culture focused on innovation and impact.
  • If you are passionate about the future of AI in utilities, apply today!

Job Title: Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disorders Mid-Atlantic


  • Location: Remote/ US

About the Job


The Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disease is a field-based commercial role focused on encouraging diagnostic testing and enhancing patient identification for systemic mastocytosis and future precision medicine therapies within Sanofi’s portfolio. This individual will partner with key accounts, diagnostic laboratories, and cross-functional Sanofi teams to support disease education, testing adoption, and account-level execution aligned to business and patient needs.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with key account stakeholders, including pathology, laboratory, clinical, and executive decision-makers, to support appropriate diagnostic testing and patient identification.
  • Develop and execute account plans that advance high-quality diagnostic, biomarker, and genomic testing aligned to Rare Blood Disease priorities.
  • Educate stakeholders on systemic mastocytosis, diagnostic pathways, and the role of precision medicine in patient care.
  • Partner with commercial, medical, marketing, access, and field teams to deliver approved education, resources, and account-level initiatives.
  • Identify and communicate customer needs, market insights, diagnostic barriers, and opportunities to improve testing pathways.
  • Serve as a regional subject matter expert for diagnostics and precision medicine in systemic mastocytosis and future applicable therapies.
  • Represent Sanofi at relevant local, regional, and national congresses and customer-facing forums in accordance with company policies.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, healthcare laws, Sanofi Code of Conduct, and EBI Guidance

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology, or related life sciences industries and in diagnostics or precision medicine
  • Ability to travel regularly within the assigned geography.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, business, or a related field.
  • Background in pathology, molecular biology, diagnostics, hematology, oncology, rare disease, or precision medicine.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and planning skills with the ability to work effectively in a field-based, cross-functional environment.
  • Working knowledge of diagnostic testing, biomarker or genomic testing, and patient identification pathways.
  • Experience engaging external healthcare stakeholders and account decision-makers in complex clinical or laboratory environments.
  • Experience supporting specialty product launches, indication expansions, diagnostic strategy, or market development.
  • Understanding of diagnostic market dynamics, including reimbursement, regulatory, policy, provider, patient, and payer considerations.
  • Ability to influence without authority, build credibility, align stakeholders, and drive adoption of new approaches or technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with a patient-focused and compliance-oriented mindset.

Why choose us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.​​
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.​​
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.​​
  • ·Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an experienced Program Executive to lead one of our high-priority development programs in earlier-stage clinical development. This leader will own the cross-functional strategy, execution, and governance required to advance a potentially best- or first-in-class therapy through proof-of-concept and key value-inflection milestones, while building a clear path toward later-stage development.

Working across Research, Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Translational Sciences, Medical, and other functions, you will align teams around the most important questions, translate emerging data into decisive action, and drive high-quality execution. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, challenges assumptions, and knows when to accelerate, adapt, or stop.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the integrated program strategy and development plan through early clinical development, proof-of-concept, and preparation for later-stage development.
  • Drive cross-functional execution, governance, and decision-making against program objectives, timelines, and key scientific, clinical, and business milestones.
  • Own program strategy, budget, resource planning, and investment recommendations, including acceleration, adaptation, and go/no-go decisions.
  • Partner across Clinical Development, Research, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, Finance, and other functions to build an integrated evidence-generation strategy.
  • Evaluate emerging clinical, translational, regulatory, competitive, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and alternative development paths.
  • Lead preparation for key health authority interactions and ensure alignment across clinical, regulatory, CMC, and evidence-generation strategies.
  • Represent the program with executive leadership, governance committees, partners, and external stakeholders while fostering accountability, transparency, and high performance.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading therapeutic programs through early clinical development and meaningful value-inflection points, including first-in-human, dose optimization, proof-of-mechanism, proof-of-concept, or transition to later-stage development.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership with accountability for integrated program strategy and execution in Phase 1 and/or Phase 2 development.
  • Direct ownership of program strategy, budgets, resource planning, governance, and investment recommendations for complex development programs.
  • Experience integrating clinical, translational, biomarker, preclinical, regulatory, and competitive evidence to make sound decisions with incomplete or evolving data.
  • Experience leading or preparing significant interactions with FDA and/or other global health authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead matrixed teams, resolve competing perspectives, and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end drug development and the ability to connect near-term decisions to long-term product and patient impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing therapies in CNS
  • Experience with rare disease development, biomarker-driven development, patient stratification, or innovative proof-of-concept strategies.
  • Alliance or partnership management experience.
  • Success operating in lean, fast-paced biotechnology organizations where leaders move fluidly between strategy and execution.

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

jobs.description:
About LogicGate
LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.

The GRC MarketGovernance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.

Strategic Account Executive

Location: United States - Remote

About the role

Our Strategic Account Executives have a passion for pitching novel technology in big markets. You’ll target large enterprises in all verticals with a focus on their GRC programs. We are disrupting the GRC software industry as a recent Forrester Wave Leader by providing a solution end users can self-manage, saving enterprises huge amounts of time and money and you’ll focus on identifying target accounts and bringing them through the full sales process. This is an opportunity to play a key role in building a business, have a huge and direct impact on top line revenue growth, and be part of a collaborative, high-performing sales team.

How you’ll spend your time:

  • Strategically developing a territory plan for a targeted list of accounts in Salesforce leveraging best in class sales technology including marketing automation, buyer intent signals, pipeline analytics, and more!
  • Generating new business pipeline primarily by cold prospecting through partner collaborations, social communication, email and phone calls.
  • Form strategic sales plan to target use cases within industry verticals.
  • Taking a customer through the full lifecycle of an opportunity including qualification/ discovery, demo (in partnership with a Solutions Engineer), building relationships within an organization, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Being an advocate for our customers. Actively listening to understand their goals and share these potential opportunities with our product team.
  • Leveraging sales enablement tools to effectively measure activities and develop best practices. Continuously refining and improving on sales activities.
  • Consulting and advising our customers on best practices for their use case on the LogicGate platform.
  • Deliver world class customer service in every customer interaction

We get excited about you if you have:

  • Proven sales experience. You will ideally have 10+ years of total Sales experience, specifically 5+ years of large enterprise sales experience selling B2B SaaS technology.
  • Curiosity and the desire to understand our customer’s problems – and effectively communicate how LogicGate can add value.
  • Great listening skills, as well as humility. We won’t be the right solution all the time for every organization, so we believe in understanding customer needs first before we make our pitch.
  • A tech savvy seller – can quickly pick up new technology and understands our platform front and back. Previous experience in BPM or GRC software is a huge plus.
  • Great people skills. Ability to quickly understand your audience and tailor the right message to them, typically via web conference.
  • Excitement to build lasting relationships. Someone who is in it for the long term and understands the value in building trust with customers.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce.com and sales automation software.
  • Willingness to be creative, test solutions, measure results and iterate on a process for continual improvement.

The anticipated on-target earnings range for the role is $290,000 - $350,000 per year + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

How We WorkAt LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.

Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.

Global Total Rewards
We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK:

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region.
  • Time Away: Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best.
  • Growth & Development: Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms.

Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.

Client Advocate Executive -HIS


3M Health Care is now Solventum

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role


As a Client Advocate Executive, you will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to some of the most innovative healthcare organizations globally. This role is designed to influence client success at the highest levels, drive measurable business outcomes, and strengthen Solventum’s position as a leader in Health Information Systems. The CAE will be expected to cultivate executive-level relationships, drive top quartile client performance, proactively removing barriers inhibiting success and looking for growth opportunities within the organization. The ideal candidate will have hospital/healthcare system workflow and analytics knowledge, a working knowledge of the Health Information Systems product portfolio and the ability to function as an advocate for both the client/partner and HIS through their relationships.

  • Driving best practice performance to assist organizations, achieving top quartile performance, effective revenue cycle processes and clinical efficiencies and outcomes
  • Working with a highly experienced team to drive customer retention/renewals of the Solventum HIS portfolio
  • Nurture and build relationships with CXO, VP and Department Managers to maximize value.
  • Advise clients on business process and customer workflow improvement that takes place in this changing market segment.
  • Drive cross-functional focus on Customer Outcomes, Value, and Experiences

As a Client Advocate Executive, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


Client Care & Advocacy -

  • Cultivating executive-level relationships, positioning Solventum as a strategic partner and thought leader.

  • Identifying growth opportunities and collaborate with sales teams to advance strategic initiatives.

Value Realization– Lead ROI analysis and performance reviews to demonstrate solution impact and inform executive decision-making.

  • Driving in-depth analysis of client performance metrics to inform strategic decisions, with emphasis on product outcomes (top quartile performance) and financial impact.
  • Developing and executing action plans that align client objectives with measurable outcomes.

Strategic Execution - Ensure consistent, high-level engagement across executive client leadership to reinforce partnership value.

  • Serving as the Client Advocate for activities across HIS with assigned organization partner.
  • Engaging HIS business leaders where appropriate to coordinate activities across multiple HIS departments, engage subject matter experts (SMEs) for respective projects.
  • For providers, conducting current-state workflow and configuration review with client implementing Solventum best practice workflows.
  • Engaging in feedback sessions to refine and improve content and workflow, implementation best practice, outstanding decisions that impact clients.
  • Engaging with client to understand their technical environment and any changes that will require Solventum engagement.

Strategy and Planning - Understanding the client/partners’ short and long-term strategy with the goal to further integrate HIS Solutions. Developing consistent ongoing onsite presence.

  • Partnering with clients to co-create strategic roadmaps that integrate HIS solutions into their long-term vision. Updates plan as decisions are made internally and externally.
  • Understanding strategy, organizational structure, technical architecture changes and the impacts/opportunities for HIS.
  • Ensuring client/partner is fully aware of HIS solution roadmaps and assists in planning for both changes in current portfolio workflows and portfolio evolution to solve client problems.
  • Monitoring market trends and organizational shifts to identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment.

Leadership and Coordination - Responsible for leading the team to ensure account satisfaction and ongoing client engagement.

  • Setting the agenda for advocacy engagements, driving conversations that shape client strategy.
  • Leading client meetings and coordinate follow-up on all requested items.
  • Positioning Solventum as an industry leader by sharing insights, thought leadership, and best practices.
  • Fostering innovation that enhances client experience and strengthens competitive advantage.

Performance and Analytics

  • Regular analysis of clients analytics and performance data and delivering ROI/Performance reports to the client on a scheduled basis.
  • Actively stay up to date with knowledge of industry changes and product changes.
  • Participating in relevant corporate programs/initiatives, complies with professional and quality standards, complies with corporate policies and procedures, and acts in a manner consistent with Solventum’s values and ethical standards.

Dark Matter Mission Statement

To be the trusted innovation partner that empowers home lending. We fulfill this mission by earning trust through accountability and integrity, bringing clarity to complex challenges, collaborating across our ecosystem, and remaining dedicated to meaningful innovation and customer outcomes.


Position Summary

The Sales Executive IV - Strategic Partnerships is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for generating and closing revenue through a portfolio of strategic relationships, including technology providers, industry organizations, consultants, referral sources, and other ecosystem partners. The role builds and manages executive-level relationships, develops partner-specific account plans and qualified pipeline, and leads opportunities from initial identification through partnership go-to-market by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ value, technology, client base, and ecosystem opportunities.

This role combines strategic partnership development with the ability to educate and inform partners about Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, client base, market reach, and ecosystem value. The Sales Executive positions solutions in the context of each partner’s business model and growth objectives, prepares estimates, negotiates commercial terms, and coordinates internal resources to deliver outcomes that align partner expectations with the company’s ability to execute. Success is measured by quota attainment, closed revenue, pipeline creation and conversion, forecast accuracy, and the growth and productivity of assigned relationships.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Own and achieve an assigned individual revenue quota, sales goals, and other performance objectives for the strategic partnerships channel.
  • Build, manage, and expand a portfolio of strategic partner relationships that generate referrals, partner-sourced opportunities, integrated solution sales, and recurring revenue growth.
  • Develop and execute relationship and account plans that define revenue targets, priority opportunities, key stakeholders, and the actions required to close business.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with current and prospective partners, consultants, industry organizations, and other sources of qualified opportunities.
  • Create and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline by identifying market opportunities, securing partner commitment, and advancing deals through each stage of the sales process.
  • Lead assigned opportunities from discovery through close by educating partners on Dark Matter Technologies’ technology, platform capabilities, client demand, market reach, and integration value; aligning the opportunity to the partner’s business objectives; positioning the solution; and managing pricing, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing partner relationships, including new products, services, integrations, referral arrangements, pricing initiatives, and additional revenue channels.
  • Translate knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, technology, customer use cases, client base, markets, and competitive environment into clear business, integration, and revenue value that enables informed partner investment and go-to-market decisions.
  • Prepare and present pricing, commercial recommendations, partnership plans, business cases, forecasts, and performance updates to partner executives and internal leadership.

  • Represent the company at industry events, partner meetings, executive forums, and trade associations to deepen relationships, strengthen market presence, and create new sales opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Performance Expectations

  • Consistent attainment of assigned revenue quota and sales objectives.
  • Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.
  • Effective conversion of qualified opportunities into signed agreements and closed revenue.
  • Accurate, disciplined forecasting and CRM management.
  • Growth in revenue, opportunity volume, and strategic value across assigned relationships.
  • Effective management of complex sales cycles from discovery through close.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive field sales, enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, business development, alliance management, or related commercial experience.
  • Demonstrated success carrying and attaining a revenue quota and closing complex, high-value sales or partnership agreements.
  • Proven experience building executive-level relationships and generating revenue through partners, channels, referrals, alliances, or ecosystem relationships.
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, pricing, negotiation, contracting, forecasting, and close.
  • Experience engaging mortgage, fintech, financial services, and technology providers at the C-suite level, including educating executive stakeholders on technology capabilities, client demand, market opportunities, integration value, and the commercial benefits of partnership.
  • Strong record of leading cross-functional pursuits in a complex, matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in mortgage technology, fintech, financial services, or another regulated, technology-enabled industry.
  • Experience selling software products, technology-enabled services, integrations, platforms, or transaction-based solutions.
  • Experience developing or scaling referral channels, strategic alliances, and partner-led go-to-market motions.
  • Working knowledge of technology integrations, platform partnerships, commercial agreements, pricing, and product commercialization.
  • Established network among relevant technology and service providers, consultants, industry associations, financial institutions, or customer organizations.
  • Knowledge of Dark Matter Technologies’ products, services, and capabilities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in translating complex technology solutions into clear business value for external partners. Ability to educate stakeholders on platform capabilities, market reach, client demand, and ecosystem opportunities, helping partners understand the strategic and revenue benefits of integration investments. Fosters alignment between business objectives and technology initiatives, enabling partners to make informed decisions that support mutual growth, customer adoption, and market expansion.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility, communicate value, and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, including the ability to translate partner relationships and market insights into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, account-planning, and CRM discipline.
  • Financial and analytical capability, including pricing, business-case development, revenue forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Cross-functional leadership and execution discipline, with the ability to coordinate resources and maintain deal momentum across long, complex sales cycles.

Compensation and Classification

  • This is a quota-carrying sales position with a competitive base salary and eligibility to participate in the applicable sales commission plan. Commission plan details are provided upon hire.

  • Clarity: Simplifies complex solutions, commercial terms, priorities, and value propositions so stakeholders can make confident decisions.

Position Summary
The Executive Client Partneris responsible forleadingDataSpring’smost strategic and consequential client relationships, including marquee health plan and healthcare organization partners represented onDataSpring’sBoard of Directors.

This role serves as the senior relationship owner across both executive decision-makers and operational leaders, ensuringDataSpringunderstands each partner’s strategic priorities, delivers measurablevalueandremainspositioned as a trusted, long-term advisor. The Executive Client Partner will build and sustain relationships across the client enterprise, from C-suite and board-level stakeholders to operational,technicaland functional leaders responsible for day-to-day execution.

The role is guided by four core principles:Protect, Influence,Innovateand Partner.

The Executive Client Partner will protectDataSpring’smost important relationships and revenue, influence strategic decisions and future direction,identifyopportunities to innovate alongside clients and partner closely withDataSpring’sExecutive Leadership Team and key cross-functional leaders to deliver a coordinated enterprise experience.

This individual will develop and execute comprehensive account strategies, strengthen executive alignment, drive value realization,anticipaterisksandidentifyopportunities to expand the partnership acrossDataSpring’sportfolio. The role requires a highly credible healthcare leader who can navigate complex organizations, build influence at the highestlevelsand translate client priorities into coordinated action acrossDataSpring.

The Executive Client Partner is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the VP, Account Management.
This position will require the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Responsibilities

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for a select portfolio of DataSpring’s largest, most strategic and highest-profile partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with board members, C-suite executives, senior decision-makers and operational leaders across assigned client organizations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s enterprise strategy, business objectives, operating environment, stakeholder dynamics and future priorities.
  • Establish and maintain multilevel relationship maps that ensure strong connections across executive, operational, technical, financial and procurement stakeholders.
  • Create a consistent and intentional executive engagement strategy, including executive sponsorship, strategic planning sessions, executive business reviews and ongoing leadership communication.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor who brings perspective, insight and recommendations beyond routine account management.

Protect Strategic Partnerships

  • Maintain accountability for the health, retention and long-term strength of DataSpring’s most important client relationships.
  • Anticipate relationship, performance, operational, financial and reputational risks before they affect the partnership.
  • Develop and lead comprehensive risk-mitigation and executive intervention plans.
  • Ensure emerging concerns are elevated with the appropriate context, recommended actions and clearly defined ownership.
  • Protect client trust by ensuring commitments are understood, coordinated and fulfilled across DataSpring.
  • Lead sensitive client discussions and escalations with sound judgment, executive presence and a solution-oriented approach.
  • Partner with DataSpring leadership to ensure marquee clients receive a consistent, proactive and differentiated experience.

Influence and Strategic Alignment

  • Translate client strategies, market pressures and leadership priorities into actionable implications for DataSpring.
  • Influence internal priorities by representing the voice of strategic clients across the Executive Leadership Team, Product, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other key functions.
  • Provide client and market intelligence that informs product strategy, operating priorities, investment decisions and go-to-market planning.
  • Shape executive conversations around client value, strategic direction, industry change and the future of the partnership.
  • Build alignment among client executives, operational stakeholders and DataSpring leaders around shared priorities and desired outcomes.
  • Help clients understand and prepare for DataSpring’s strategic initiatives, platform evolution and future-state capabilities.

Innovation and Partnership Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to innovate with clients through new solutions, expanded use cases, strategic pilots and collaborative initiatives.
  • Develop a clear understanding of client whitespace, unmet needs and future priorities.
  • Connect DataSpring’s broader portfolio and capabilities to client objectives in ways that create measurable enterprise value.
  • Partner with Sales and commercial leaders to develop and advance qualified growth and expansion opportunities.
  • Support strategic commercial discussions, renewal planning and complex negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate client participation in advisory groups, innovation forums, market-shaping discussions and other strategic initiatives.
  • Position DataSpring as a proactive partner in solving complex healthcare administrative and data challenges.

Strategic Account Planning and Value Realization

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive, multiyear strategic account plans for each assigned partner.
  • Define clear relationship, adoption, value, retention, innovation and growth objectives.
  • Establish measurable success outcomes and ensure DataSpring can demonstrate the value delivered through its solutions and partnership.
  • Lead executive business reviews that connect performance, insights and opportunities to the client’s strategic priorities.
  • Monitor account health across relationship strength, engagement, solution adoption, operational performance, support experience, financial position and future opportunity.
  • Translate account data, client feedback and industry trends into clear recommendations and executive action plans.
  • Maintain accurate and timely strategic account information in Salesforce and other designated systems.

Enterprise Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with DataSpring’s Executive Leadership Team to establish and execute coordinated strategies for marquee client relationships.
  • Lead cross-functional account teams that may include Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Implementation, Analytics, Finance, Legal and Communications.
  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making, timelines and accountability across complex client initiatives.
  • Ensure clients experience DataSpring as one coordinated organization rather than a collection of separate functions or products.
  • Mobilize the appropriate internal leaders and subject-matter experts based on client priorities, risks and opportunities.
  • Facilitate internal executive account reviews to assess relationship health, strategic priorities, commitments and next actions.
  • Provide guidance and leadership to Client Partnerships colleagues supporting the operational aspects of assigned accounts.

Organizational and Market Leadership

  • Model the standards, behaviors and strategic discipline expected across the Client Partnerships organization.
  • Contribute to the development of executive-engagement practices, strategic account playbooks, health frameworks and relationship-management standards.
  • Share market, client and competitive insights that strengthen DataSpring’s enterprise strategy.
  • Represent DataSpring at client events, executive meetings, industry forums and other external engagements.
  • Support a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and client-centered decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Ten to fifteen years of progressive experience in strategic account management, client partnerships, customer success, consulting, healthcare leadership or another senior client-facing role.
  • Significant experience working with health plans, provider organizations, healthcare technology companies or healthcare administrative solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, high-value enterprise relationships with multiple products, stakeholders and business priorities.
  • Experience engaging and influencing board members, C-suite executives and senior operational decision-makers.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility as a trusted strategic advisor.
  • Demonstrated success protecting and expanding strategic client relationships, including retention, renewals, adoption, value realization and growth.
  • Experience developing and executing multiyear strategic account plans and executive-engagement strategies.
  • Ability to understand complex healthcare business challenges and connect them to data, technology and administrative solutions.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying whitespace, shaping expansion opportunities and supporting complex commercial discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging risks, lead executive escalations and navigate sensitive or high-stakes client situations.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional teams and initiatives without direct authority.
  • Ability to influence internal executives and translate client priorities into organizational action.
  • Strong strategic thinking, business judgment and decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to lead board-level and executive-level discussions.
  • Ability to synthesize client, market, financial, product and operational information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong organizational discipline and the ability to manage a select portfolio of highly complex relationships and priorities.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another enterprise customer relationship management platform.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for executive meetings, client engagements and industry events.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Location: Remote – South Africa

We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and experienced Executive Assistant to provide direct support to the Founder & CEO of a fast-growing, US-based technology business.

This is an exciting opportunity for a high-performing professional who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and enjoys taking ownership of executive administration, financial operations, client communications and business coordination.

The successful candidate will act as the CEO's right hand, ensuring daily operations run smoothly while supporting strategic business activities.

This position offers a clear career progression opportunity into Account Management, with increasing responsibility for client relationships, customer onboarding and project coordination

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive & Personal Assistance

  • Manage the CEO's inbox, calendar, appointments and daily scheduling.
  • Draft professional, accurate and well-structured emails and client communications.
  • Coordinate meetings with clients, prospects, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Arrange travel, accommodation and business appointments.
  • Handle personal administration, expense tracking and ad hoc requests.
  • Conduct research and prepare reports, presentations and meeting summaries.
  • Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively manage priorities.

2. Financial Administration & Operations

  • Manage bill payments, vendor payments and invoicing.
  • Assist with payroll administration and payment processing.
  • Track expenses, invoices and financial records.
  • Coordinate internal administrative processes and operational workflows.
  • Ensure payments, documentation and financial information are accurate and processed on time.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency and implement better systems.

3. Client Communication & Account Support

  • Prepare professional client follow-up emails based on meeting notes and discussions.
  • Coordinate client meetings, scheduling and ongoing communication.
  • Respond to client requests and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Assist with customer onboarding and implementation processes.
  • Track client deliverables, action items and outstanding tasks.
  • Support account management activities as knowledge of the business develops.
  • Maintain excellent communication standards when dealing with senior stakeholders and enterprise clients.

4. Project Management & Business Coordination

  • Coordinate projects, deadlines and internal team activities.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure deliverables are completed.
  • Maintain organised workflows and project documentation.
  • Support quality assurance reviews of software, data and internal processes.
  • Identify operational challenges and proactively recommend solutions.

5. Systems, Technology & AI Tools

  • Use Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs and Sheets.
  • Work with Microsoft Excel for reporting, tracking and administration.
  • Utilise HubSpot CRM for client information, follow-ups and account coordination.
  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and automation platforms to improve productivity.
  • Use AI-assisted meeting notes and summaries to prepare accurate, professional client correspondence.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive administrative processes.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, business administration, operations or similar roles preferred.
  • Previous experience supporting a US-based startup CEO or Founder remotely is essential.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting professional client-facing emails and business correspondence.
  • Hands-on experience with invoicing, vendor payments, bill payments and payroll administration.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, calendars and document management.
  • Excellent organisational, multitasking and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience managing confidential business and financial information.
  • Comfortable working US Pacific Time hours on a permanent basis.
  • Must be available for full-time, exclusive employment, without conflicting employment commitments.

Advantageous Experience

  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology or startup environment.
  • Customer success, client onboarding or account management experience.
  • HubSpot CRM experience.
  • Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation and productivity platforms.
  • Experience coordinating projects and customer implementations.
  • Exposure to sales support, lead management, prospecting or business development.
  • Experience supporting high-value enterprise clients.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented: Produces accurate, polished work with no careless errors.
  • An outstanding communicator: Writes clear, concise, professional emails and confidently communicates with senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and independent: Anticipates needs, solves problems and takes initiative without constant direction.
  • Highly organised: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines and responsibilities.
  • Commercially minded: Understands the importance of client relationships, customer experience and business growth.
  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools to improve efficiency.
  • Accountable and reliable: Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently delivers results.
  • Ambitious: Interested in long-term career development and progressing into account management.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position is designed for someone seeking more than a traditional Executive Assistant role.

As the successful candidate becomes familiar with the company's operations, technology and client base, they will have the opportunity to transition into broader Account Management and Customer Success responsibilities, including:

  • Managing client relationships and communications.
  • Coordinating customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Overseeing client requests, deliverables and follow-ups.
  • Supporting long-term customer satisfaction and retention.

Application Requirements

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

  1. An updated CV outlining relevant executive support and operational experience.
  2. A short video introduction demonstrating professional communication skills.
  3. A brief written assessment involving drafting a client-facing email from meeting notes.

As an Executive Loan Officer, you’ll be the face of Rocket Mortgage to clients in your local community. You’ll use your expertise in mortgage origination and the home the buying process to guide clients through the mortgage process and help them achieve their goals. Your established network combined with the Rocket Mortgage brand and support will help you take your business to the next level.

About the Role

  • Build and maintain relationships with real estate agents, investment advisors, accountants, other professionals, friends, family and closed clients to market the Rocket brand and help homebuyers or homeowners obtain real estate financing that meets their personal and financial goals

  • Represent the Rocket brand in various civic and community functions to support business development initiatives and drive lead flow

  • Establish, develop and maintain a book of business to drive referral volume and revenue

  • Consult with clients and analyze their financial situations to determine the appropriate loan product to achieve their goals.

  • Advise and educate clients on the home-buying or refinance process and how to better manage their mortgage

  • Evaluate client financial status and documents including their credit, employment, income, assets and property to ensure they qualify for financing

  • Assist clients through the loan process from application to closing including resolving any client concerns

  • Provide every referral source and client with the best client service in the industry

  • Stay up to date on Rocket Mortgage’s product offerings, qualifying parameters and process changes

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in mortgage loan origination, including a proven track record of obtaining referrals and generating lead volume

  • Federal NMLS and state mortgage licenses

  • Professional communication, time management and critical/strategic thinking skills

  • Results-driven, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 years of proven success in self-generated mortgage loan origination

  • Desire to work and grow in an entrepreneurial environment

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy,innovationand growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We goabove and beyondto give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put:We’vegot your back. Check out our full list ofBenefits and Perks.

About us

Rocket Mortgage® was founded in 1985. Today, we’re a Detroit-based, publicly traded company with a mission to Help Everyone Home. At Rocket Mortgage, we believe that home is more than the house you live in. Our wide variety of home loan options, tools and resources empower our clients to achieve their homeownership dreams. We’re known as experts in the mortgage industry, but we’re also innovators – we strive to create the best experiences for our clients from beginning to end. And we’re not your typical employer. We’re insistently different in how we look at the world and are committed to an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard. Apply today to join a team that offers career growth, amazing benefits and the chance to work with leading industry professionals.

The National Account Executive (NAE) is responsible for strategic management of large and/or complex national accounts. This role focuses on driving revenue through deep customer engagement, consultative partnership, and the sale of additional products and services. The NAE leads the development and execution of account strategies, oversees implementation for new and expanding business, and plays a critical role in maintaining persistency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Bilingual Spanish-English Executive Assistant to provide administrative and executive support to leadership. The ideal candidate is fluent in both Spanish and English, has strong written and verbal communication skills, and can manage schedules, coordinate meetings, handle correspondence, and support day-to-day business operations.
