  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to executives and leadership.

  • Manage calendars, schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, and send reminders.

  • Organize travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, itineraries, and transportation.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes, and track action items.

  • Maintain organized digital files, documents, and records.

II. Bilingual Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate professionally with clients, colleagues, and business partners in both Spanish and English.

  • Draft, proofread, and translate emails, business correspondence, reports, and other documents as needed.

  • Assist with Spanish-English communication during meetings, calls, and virtual conferences.

  • Respond to inquiries, relay messages, and coordinate information between Spanish- and English-speaking stakeholders.

  • Ensure communications are clear, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.

III. Email and Correspondence Management

  • Monitor and organize executive inboxes, prioritize messages, and flag urgent matters.

  • Draft responses to routine inquiries and follow up on pending communications.

  • Maintain professional correspondence with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track important deadlines, requests, and commitments to ensure timely responses.

Requirements:

  • Fluency in both Spanish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or in a similar support role.

  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.

  • Strong written communication, proofreading, and document preparation skills.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, calendar management tools, and virtual meeting platforms.

  • Ability to handle confidential information and exercise sound judgment.

  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work setup.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

  • Availability to work according to the executive's required time zone.

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based executives or international teams.

  • Experience working in a remote or virtual support environment.

  • Familiarity with project management tools, CRM platforms, and business communication software.

  • Experience translating or coordinating professional communications between Spanish- and English-speaking stakeholders.

jobs.description:
About the Team

Join a high-performing sales team focused on helping financial institutions mitigate risk, prevent fraud, and make informed identity and trust decisions. Our team partners with broker-dealers, banks, wealth management firms, and other financial services organizations to deliver innovative fraud, identity, risk, and analytics solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

We are a collaborative, client-focused group that works closely with Product, Data Science, and Professional Services teams to deliver strategic solutions that address complex industry challenges and create long-term customer value. We seek experienced sales professionals who have successfully engaged executive leadership within major financial institutions and guided organizations through enterprise-wide technology and risk transformation initiatives.


About the Role

We are seeking a results-driven Enterprise Sales Executive / Account Manager to lead growth initiatives within the broker-dealer and broader financial services market. This role is primarily focused on identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities while strategically managing a select portfolio of existing accounts.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of enterprise sales success selling software, data, analytics, fraud, identity, risk, or fintech solutions to large financial institutions. You will build executive-level relationships, develop strategic account plans, and position high-value solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives while driving significant revenue growth.

This role requires a consultative sales leader who excels in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments and can effectively navigate executive decision-making processes across Tier 1 banks, broker-dealers, capital m

arkets firms, and other financial services organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new business development within the broker-dealer and financial services market through proactive prospecting, pipeline generation, strategic account engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Identify, qualify, and close complex, high-value, multi-year sales opportunities with enterprise clients.
  • Develop and execute territory plans focused on broker-dealers, banks, wealth management firms, capital markets organizations, and adjacent financial services institutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite executives, senior business leaders, risk officers, compliance leaders, and technology decision-makers to uncover strategic business priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Apply a consultative, value-based sales approach to understand customer challenges and align fraud, identity, risk, analytics, and data-driven solutions with business objectives.
  • Create compelling business cases, proposals, executive presentations, and solution strategies tailored to client needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Lead complex negotiations involving procurement, legal, compliance, and executive stakeholders to successfully close enterprise agreements.
  • Leverage industry expertise in fraud prevention, digital identity, risk management, analytics, compliance, and financial services technology solutions to position differentiated offerings and drive competitive wins.
  • Manage and expand a portfolio of existing strategic accounts by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities that enhance client outcomes and revenue growth.
  • Own revenue performance against assigned sales quotas, including accountability for pipeline creation, forecasting, deal conversion, and strategic account planning.
  • Drive enterprise-wide solution adoption and long-term client success through executive sponsorship and stakeholder engagement.
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Professional Services, and other internal stakeholders to design and deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline activity, opportunity management, and account plans within CRM systems.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory changes, emerging fraud threats, and competitive developments impacting broker-dealers, banks, and financial services organizations.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience selling enterprise software, data, analytics, fraud, identity, risk, fintech, or related technology solutions to large financial institutions.
  • Proven success in enterprise sales, business development, or strategic account management within the financial services industry.
  • Demonstrated success managing multi-million-dollar strategic accounts, consistently exceeding sales quotas, and closing complex multi-year enterprise agreements.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders, senior executives, risk leaders, and technology decision-makers.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex procurement, legal, compliance, and contract negotiations within large financial institutions.
  • Experience selling complex solutions through consultative, value-based sales methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, build executive relationships, generate pipeline, and close high-value opportunities.
  • Track record of achieving or exceeding sales quotas and revenue targets in highly competitive enterprise sales environments.
  • Experience driving enterprise-wide solution adoption across large, matrixed organizations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience managing long, complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate across cross-functional teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with broker-dealers, Tier 1 banks, wealth management firms, capital markets organizations, investment firms, or other large financial services institutions.
  • Knowledge of fraud prevention, digital identity, risk management, compliance, AML, KYC, financial crime, or related solutions.
  • Experience selling SaaS, data, analytics, or risk platforms within regulated financial services environments.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, strategic account planning, and sales forecasting methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, business development, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience developing executive business cases, board-level presentations, and enterprise proposals for large financial institutions.
  • Established network of executive relationships within the broker-dealer, banking, wealth management, or financial services sectors.

ABOUT SULLIVANCOTTER

Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation. Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America. We are driven by a people-first mission to be the best home for businesses and their leaders, by marrying capital allocation with inspired operations.

The Evergreen holding company team is comprised of 40+ professionals based in San Francisco who are focused on capital allocation, M&A, executive level hiring, strategic board leadership, and finance and accounting. Evergreen is a uniquely long-term oriented holding company that seeks to hold and grow businesses indefinitely rather than follow the 5-7 year holding period of a typical private equity fund. This allows us to take a truly long-term view on performance and people. Evergreen is backed by Alpine Investors, a leading private equity firm focused on the services and software industries with $16B+ in AUM.

The Opportunity (Future Leadership Roles)

We are looking for Operating Executives to take on high-impact leadership roles within new businesses acquired throughout the United States. Operating Executives will be responsible for driving organic EBITDA growth and recurring revenue at an operating company through active management and strategic leadership. We believe leadership talent is a key lever to a company's performance and are seeking Operating Executives to inspire the highest levels of performance, followership, and employee engagement within their company.

We primarily hire first-time CEOs into our operating companies and are seeking individuals who are ready to step up to the challenge and opportunity. The ideal candidate will be able to make difficult trade-off decisions between growth and profitability, hold teams accountable to budgets and targets, and create a winning environment of support and success.

  • Cultivate a healthy, effective team dynamic among the leadership team.

  • Monitor inventory management, supply chain, and logistics to maintain product/service quality and availability.

Job Description

VICTAULIC

Title: Commercial/Mechanical Business Development Executive

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department/Function: Sales/Business Development

Immigration sponsorship: None

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

  • We build from within.
  • We stand behind our people.
  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

The Business Development Executive (BDE) spearheads strategic business development initiatives within a designated geographic territory, serving a pivotal role in advancing Victaulic solutions. Focused on enhancing specification standing through a market-centric approach, their primary objectives revolve around implementing the market box strategy, collecting valuable market intelligence, and obtaining comprehensive project information, including detailed scopes of work. The BDE proactively cultivates Victaulic opportunities by targeting, engaging, and influencing key stakeholders, including owners and engineers.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN

  • Strategically evaluate assigned territory, collaborating with the Regional Business Development Manager and/or Divisional Sales Leader to prioritize target accounts.
  • Develop and execute an annual business plan aimed at elevating Victaulic's specification standing, emphasizing a comprehensive market box strategy encompassing both master and project specifications, as well as owner guidelines.
  • Drive the penetration and expansion of Victaulic's influence within assigned accounts (owners, engineers, GCs) by crafting and fortifying owner guidelines, master specifications, and project specifications.
  • Leverage Salesforce to effectively capture, share, and collaborate account and project details with the commercial sales team, ensuring seamless communication and coordination.
  • Facilitate effective project handoffs at the appropriate phase of the project lifecycle with the commercial sales team.
  • Attains comprehensive expertise in various aspects, including:
    • Product features and benefits, account influences, market and product applications, and technical language, encompassing material science knowledge.
    • Specifications as an industry document, comprehending both content and language intricacies.
    • Competitive products and their positioning in the market
  • Cultivate and foster industry connections with clients and prospects.
  • Stay abreast of market trends and competitor dynamics.
  • Employ strategic social engineering to enhance relationships and gather market intelligence.
  • Engage with local trade organizations and professional associations, actively becoming integral to the industry fabric in the assigned territory.
  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or construction management strongly preferred.
  • Previous sales experience preferably related to the commercial construction industry or engineering fields.
  • Proven track record of success, including business development, sales, and account management while achieving targets and complex sales.
  • Established owner group relationships in healthcare, higher education, and airports throughout the area.
  • Understanding of HVAC piping system solutions.
  • Established owner group relationships.
  • Capable of lifting 50+ pounds.
  • Willingness to travel overnight as required by the position and territory

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Engineering skills in writing and developing design specifications a plus.
  • Proficient project management and communication skills.
  • A self-starter who enjoys working in an autonomous leadership role while being a member of a team of highly skilled colleagues.
  • Ability to demonstrate drive, resiliency, and adaptability while possessing a team mindset.
  • Ability to demonstrate learning agility, creative thinking, problem solving and resourcefulness.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to work in a virtual setting with minimal supervision.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings plans with company match
  • Life insurance and disability coverage

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

Build A Better World

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this position is typically between $150,000.00–$210,000.00 annually. Top end of range can be exceeded, as actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for variable compensation in addition to the full benefits package described above.

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process.

VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.

This position is responsible for the full strategic relationship across a portfolio of enterprise payer accounts — health plans, managed care organizations, and other risk-bearing entities — for the Veradigm Payer Products portfolio. The Veradigm Outcome Executive (VOE) is the most senior client-facing individual contributor for these accounts, with particular focus on risk adjustment and quality programs (HEDIS and Stars) and on payer-provider clinical data exchange. Serving as the integration layer across Sales, Consulting, Support, and A/R, the VOE drives retention, expansion, and wallet share through deep knowledge of each plan’s medical economics, quality and risk performance, and regulatory obligations. The role operates with significant autonomy and is fully accountable for C-suite engagement, annual account planning, QBR cadence, and measurable revenue outcomes.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner to C-suite and senior functional leadership within an assigned portfolio of enterprise payer accounts — including Chief Medical Officer, Chief Actuary, quality and Stars leadership, risk adjustment leadership, and Chief Information Officer — owning the full client relationship across quality, risk, network, and regulatory touchpoints
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships through on-site visits, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and proactive engagement, establishing Veradigm as a trusted long-term partner
  • Understand and document each plan’s enterprise priorities — Stars and HEDIS targets, risk adjustment accuracy, medical loss ratio pressure, value-based care strategy, and interoperability mandates — and develop and execute annual account plans focused on retention, optimization, and expansion
  • Analyze plan membership, line-of-business mix, and product utilization data to identify whitespace across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial, and ACA lines of business; translate findings into actionable pipeline and sales strategy
  • Position Veradigm risk adjustment and quality solutions against each plan’s annual program cycle — chart retrieval and review, supplemental data submission, gap identification and closure, and audit readiness — and align proposal timing to that cycle
  • Position payer-provider clinical data exchange solutions, connecting plan requirements for clinical data acquisition, interoperability compliance, and prior authorization workflow to Veradigm’s provider network and data assets
  • Drive ACV quota attainment and MBO performance through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and timely opportunity progression
  • Navigate payer procurement, security review, and contracting processes, coordinating Legal, InfoSec, and Privacy to move enterprise agreements and data use terms to signature
  • Advocate internally for client needs — surface product feedback, coordinate cross-functional issue resolution, and represent the payer voice in roadmap and strategy discussions
  • Partner with Consulting, Support, and A/R to ensure dependable delivery and early resolution of at-risk situations before they affect retention
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of CMS and NCQA program mechanics — risk adjustment models and submission, RADV audit exposure, HEDIS measure specifications, the Medicare Advantage Stars program, and federal interoperability and prior authorization rules — to credibly advise executive stakeholders
  • Conduct whitespace and competitive analysis to expand Veradigm’s footprint within each plan and identify new use cases across additional lines of business

jobs.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer

Location: Remote (US or Canada), with regular collaboration across CSC Generation brands

About the Role

    This role exists to find and close executive, strategic, and highly specialized hires across CSC Generation's portfolio — the kind of searches where the right candidate is passive, hard to find, and being courted by everyone else. As Executive & Strategic Recruiter, you will own end-to-end search strategy and execution, partnering directly with hiring executives to define roles, map talent, and close candidates who weren't looking.

    In the first 6–12 months, success means you have personally sourced and closed multiple senior-level searches, built a warm pipeline of high-value passive candidates, and established yourself as a trusted advisor to hiring executives across the portfolio.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end search strategy and execution for executive, strategic, and hard-to-fill roles across CSC Generation's portfolio brands and shared services, including sourcing approach, assessment criteria, and offer strategy in partnership with hiring executives.
  • Proactively source passive candidates through direct outreach, competitive talent mapping, referral networks, and platforms like LinkedIn — going well beyond inbound applicant flow.
  • Partner directly with hiring executives to define hard-to-articulate role profiles and translate them into actionable sourcing strategies.
  • Close searches where the ideal candidate profile is narrow, such as roles requiring deep applied AI or data science experience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with high-value passive candidates over time, even when there is no open role, so the pipeline is warm when the need arises.
  • Manage confidential searches with judgment and discretion, including roles tied to organizational restructuring or leadership transitions.
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability and competitive hiring activity to inform how and where CSC Generation competes for talent.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing passive candidates for hard-to-fill executive or specialized roles — not just managing inbound pipelines. You have personally sourced and closed 10–15 or more senior-level searches in the last 12 months.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy, ambiguity, and direct executive access as an individual contributor.
  • A genuine network and the instincts to know who to call, not just how to run a search.
  • Technical fluency with modern AI and automation tools, with demonstrated ability to use these tools to increase effectiveness and productivity while exercising judgment about where human review is required in candidate evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Search firm or agency recruiting background — you know how to cold-approach someone who wasn't looking and make them interested in speaking with you.
  • Experience recruiting technical, data science, or AI talent, given CSC Generation's AI-first operating model.
  • Retail, e-commerce, or multi-brand holding company experience.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every brand and function in the portfolio. Every search you close directly shapes the leadership and capabilities of CSC Generation.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will operate inside an AI-native company that expects you to leverage modern tools and continuously sharpen how you source, evaluate, and close talent.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own your searches from intake through close — no handoffs, no committees. You set the strategy, run the process, and deliver the hire.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Chief Administrative Officer focused on your search approach, sourcing methodology, and how you close passive candidates at the executive level.
    3. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our office hubs (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    4. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

About the job

Twilio is seeking a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Business Partner to support executives within our Enterprise Technology organization. This role extends well beyond traditional administrative support. The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, technology strategy, organizational priorities, and key initiatives—using that context to anticipate needs, manage competing demands, and help leaders and their teams operate more effectively.

You will serve as a trusted partner to your executives, proactively managing their time and attention. You will be expected to exercise sound judgment, take ownership, and move work forward even when direction is not fully defined or all information is not yet available.

This role requires someone who is comfortable taking charge, solving problems, and navigating ambiguity. You will build strong relationships with executive leadership, their direct reports, and administrative partners across the organization, serving as a central point of coordination and a reliable source of insight and continuity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Enterprise Technology organization, including its strategy, priorities, key initiatives, stakeholders, and operating rhythms, and use that knowledge to anticipate needs and inform day-to-day decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, providing informed input, identifying potential risks or conflicts, and helping move priorities forward without waiting for detailed direction.
  • Strategically manage complex executive calendars by evaluating and prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, protecting time for critical work, and redirecting or delegating meetings when appropriate.
  • Make sound, independent decisions on behalf of executives, including determining when their participation is needed and ensuring they are prepared with the right context, materials, and desired outcomes.
  • Manage complex domestic and international travel, prepare and reconcile expenses, and proactively address changes or issues that arise.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for executives’ direct reports and administrative partners, building trusted relationships and facilitating effective coordination across the organization.
  • Help translate executive priorities into action by tracking commitments, following up on decisions, and driving accountability for milestones, deliverables, and next steps.
  • Support key projects and initiatives by gathering information, synthesizing updates, identifying dependencies, and ensuring the right stakeholders remain aligned.
  • Draft and coordinate executive communications, presentations, program updates, meeting materials, and other written content with a high degree of clarity and professionalism.
  • Manage leadership meeting and operating cadences, including developing agendas, coordinating presenters, preparing materials, capturing decisions and action items, and ensuring effective follow-through.
  • Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of executive offsites, leadership summits, strategic planning sessions, and team gatherings, including budget management, venue sourcing, agenda development, material preparation, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Analyze team surveys, operational information, or other inputs to identify themes and provide executives with useful insights.

  • Handle sensitive information and complex situations with exceptional discretion, professionalism, and judgment.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or business-critical information.
  • Experience planning and facilitating virtual, in-person, and hybrid leadership meetings, summits, offsites, and team-building events.
  • Familiarity with contract management, procurement processes, budget tracking, and general business workflows.
  • Proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools, including Google Workspace and Zoom.

Desired

Location

Travel

What We Offer

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) team, you will build a portfolio of clients by prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing new accounts. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, and management consulting. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a territory from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts from scratch - identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.

  • Working closely with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities while also expanding existing relationships.
  • You’ll operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment, working alongside pre-sales experts and delivery teams to craft compelling, tailored solutions for each client.
  • Your initial portfolio will scale toward an annualized gross sales target of $1M in your first year, with expectations to grow into a $5M book by years 2–3, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

We are seeking scrappy, bold, client-obsessed professionals who are energized by face-to-face interaction, inspired by client success, and motivated to close high-impact deals. This is not a “work from your home office” role. We’re looking for professionals who are ready to get in the field, build lasting relationships, and lead with purpose.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal, learning the core of our model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Work with your Portfolio Leader to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Begin to meet with clients, articulate Toptal’s capabilities, and identify where we can help organizations in your territory plan.
  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with Sales Development Representatives and Client Partners and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pre-Sales Solutions and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage Toptal’s engineering, design, and business specialists.
  • Provide consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Develop a network of client relationships and build a foundation of advocates and sponsors to expand Toptal’s partnership with existing accounts in alignment with your portfolio strategy.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior AIOps Engineer I
Location: United States
Workplace Type: Remote


Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior AIOps Engineer I.

In this role, you will partner with product managers, platform engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to make sure our AI and ML-powered systems are reliable, observable, secure, and cost-efficient in production. You will focus on how AI systems run in the real world: monitoring model performance and drift, keeping deployment pipelines robust, managing incidents, and standing up new AI infrastructure. Our AI/ML stack is built on Python and runs on Kubernetes (GKE) and Google Cloud Platform, using tools such as Union Cloud (Flyte), BentoML, Feast, Label Studio, BigQuery, and Dataflow. On the GenAI side, we operate a centralized LLM routing and gateway service, run batch prediction services for large-scale inference, and are building out RAG infrastructure. You will help evolve this stack so teams can ship AI features quickly and safely.


What You Will Do As A Senior AIOps Engineer I

  • Own production reliability for AI/ML services by monitoring availability and performance, defining SLOs and SLIs (latency, error rates, model performance) tied to user experience and business impact, and owning recurring model refresh cycles (retraining, validation, and redeployment) to prevent staleness and drift.
  • Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for models and data pipelines, and integrate model and system metrics with existing observability stacks and dashboards (Datadog, Opik, and others).
  • Streamline deployment workflows with data scientists and ML engineers (blue/green, canary, A/B, and shadow deployments), improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes for AI services, and support the productionization of image-based ML models, including batch prediction workflows.
  • Provision, deploy, configure, and maintain new AI infrastructure as it is adopted, including AI gateways, RAG platforms, LLM observability tools, agentic workflows, and no-code agent builders, using tools such as Union Cloud, BentoML, Feast, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GCP services.
  • Build automation and tooling to reduce manual operational work around model promotion, configuration, environment management, and Docker image maintenance, and support multi-BU infrastructure provisioning (separate environments, projects, roles, and CI/CD integrations).
  • Own the operational health of Label Studio, our production data annotation platform, including supporting GCS buckets, BigQuery pipelines, and database and SSO dependencies, and supporting bi-weekly annotation project cycles.
  • Stand up and operate RAG and vector database infrastructure, including embedding pipelines and context retrieval APIs, and optimize embedding storage and retrieval performance at scale.
  • Monitor and optimize LLM token usage and costs across providers, maintain centralized cost tracking dashboards and alerting across business units, and recommend cost-efficient model routing and provider selection strategies.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for AI/ML systems, triage and resolve production incidents, and lead and contribute to post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Develop production-grade services and tooling, primarily in Python, on Kubernetes, applying strong engineering practices (testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security), and document standards, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks for other teams.

What You Will Bring As A Senior AIOps Engineer I

  • A curious and driven mindset, with a strong interest in how AI systems behave in production and how to make them more reliable and observable.
  • 4+ years of applicable experience, including at least 3 years in commercial software engineering or production operations (SRE, DevOps, Platform, or ML Platform), operating services on Kubernetes and/or major cloud platforms.
  • Experience operating production systems at scale, preferably distributed, microservices-based, or Kubernetes-based architectures.
  • Strong GCP experience preferred, including hands-on work with GKE, BigQuery (data warehousing, SQL, schema management), Pub/Sub, Vertex AI (batch prediction, model deployment), Cloud SQL, GCS, and IAM.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and deployment automation (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar), infrastructure-as-code tools (preferably Terraform), monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, or similar), and container management and the Docker image lifecycle.
  • Experience operating and administering self-hosted open-source tools on Kubernetes, including installation, configuration, upgrades, security hardening, and backup and disaster recovery.
  • Understanding of basic machine learning concepts and model lifecycles (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring), and familiarity with common ML tooling.
  • Familiarity with LLM ecosystem tooling (AI gateways, vector databases, RAG pipelines, embedding models, or LLM evaluation frameworks) is a strong plus.
  • Strong computer science and programming fundamentals, with solid problem-solving skills and a proven ability to write high-quality software using Test-Driven Development (TDD), SOLID principles, clean code, and robust documentation.
  • Experience with Python-based data and ML stacks (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch) is a plus. Experience building or operating ML infrastructure (feature stores, orchestration platforms, model serving, annotation tools) is highly desirable.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with data scientists, ML engineers, and product stakeholders in both business and technical contexts.
  • Comfort participating in an on-call rotation and working in a trustful, respectful, and collaborative environment.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 11/2/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.


At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia.


What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: $135,000 to $189,000 annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.
  • Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.
  • We offer pre-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options.
  • We provide company paid Basic Life and AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD&D plans.

  • Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs.

What’s next?

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Lead Unity Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of complex Unity applications for immersive and interactive experiences.

In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.

You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring all software and hardware components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Your Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Unity Technical Design Document (TDD).
  • Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.
  • Establish development standards and best practices for C#, Unity project organization, asset management, and source control.
  • Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and integration challenges early in development.
  • Document the final application architecture, configuration, and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unity Application Development & Delivery

  • Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unity application.
  • Implement and maintain core application systems using C# and Unity's component architecture.
  • Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.
  • Troubleshoot performance, rendering, memory management, compatibility, and application stability issues.
  • Manage application builds, deployment configurations, and production releases.
  • Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

  • Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.
  • Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.
  • Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

  • Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unity application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.
  • Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.
  • Support integration with external hardware, display systems, sensors, touch interfaces, and control systems.
  • Develop or integrate communication interfaces for external hardware and software using appropriate protocols.
  • Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.
  • Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

  • Coordinate with third-party web development vendors responsible for creating web-based UI components.
  • Define and support communication interfaces between Unity and web-based applications.
  • Integrate web-based UI components or overlays into Unity applications where required.
  • Ensure reliable bidirectional communication, input handling, rendering, and interaction between UI and application systems.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with external developers on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

  • Collaborate with Unity Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, animation, and visual systems.
  • Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.
  • Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates, resolution requirements, and hardware constraints.
  • Troubleshoot rendering pipeline, shader, material, and asset integration issues.
  • Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements

Your Journey Includes

Must Have

  • Unity Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering production applications using Unity.
  • C# Programming: Strong proficiency in C# development, debugging, object-oriented programming, and software architecture.
  • Unity Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable application systems using Unity's component-based architecture.
  • Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU/GPU performance, memory usage, draw calls, shaders, and real-time rendering.
  • Rendering Pipelines: Working knowledge of Unity's Universal Render Pipeline (URP), High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP), and associated rendering workflows.
  • Systems Integration: Experience integrating third-party SDKs, APIs, plugins, and external software systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.
  • Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Unity Version Control, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.
  • Production Delivery: Experience building, troubleshooting, packaging, and deploying production-ready Unity applications.

Nice to Have

  • JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.
  • React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unity.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.
  • Shader & Material Development: Experience with Shader Graph, HLSL, compute shaders, and custom rendering effects.
  • Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.
  • Multi-Display Rendering: Experience with multi-monitor configurations, high-resolution output, camera synchronization, or distributed rendering systems.
  • AV & Show Control Systems: Familiarity with external control systems and communication protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, WebSockets, OSC, Art-Net, or DMX.
  • Interactive Hardware Integration: Experience with touchscreens, depth cameras, sensors, tracking systems, RFID, and other physical interaction devices.
  • Video & Media Playback: Experience integrating high-resolution video playback, hardware decoding, synchronized media, or third-party media plugins such as AVPro Video.
  • Networking & External Services: Experience with REST APIs, real-time communication, event-driven architectures, and application-to-application messaging.
  • Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, automated startup, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability..

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

The Senior Accounting Manager, Corporate Accounting is a pivotal operational leadership role within the US Accounting organization, responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of corporate accounting operations, month-end close workflows, OPEX reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, and audit readiness. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, this role bridges the gap between hands-on transactional preparation and high-level controllership governance.

In addition to operational ownership of the close engine, this individual partners closely with Finance Transformation and cross-functional teams to execute continuous improvement initiatives across corporate accounting operations. They will focus on streamlining workflows, enforcing robust internal controls, and scaling general ledger infrastructure to support SOX compliance and public-company readiness as the company positions itself for future expansion.

Core Responsibilities

1. Month-End Close Execution & Corporate Accounting Operations

  • Close Ownership: Own the day-to-day operational execution of the US corporate general ledger close, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and strict adherence to internal accounting policies.
  • Timeline Management: Manage close calendar tracking, step dependencies, and daily sequencing across general ledger workstreams and operational accounting benches (AP, AR, Payroll).
  • Risk Escalation: Identify, assess, and document close-related risks, control gaps, and judgment areas, formulating structured recommendations to present to the Assistant Controller for final determination.
  • System Synchronization: Coordinate downstream data synchronization with system owners, ensuring sub-ledgers, management tools, and reporting engines tie accurately back to the core ERP system.

2. Journal Entry, Accrual Governance, & Technical Review (Leases, Debt, & Equity)

  • Accrual Management & Model Optimization: Oversee accrual accounting processes, including cross-functional estimate gathering, review of assumptions, and continuous improvement of accrual models and procedures to enhance forecast accuracy and close efficiency.
  • Lease Accounting (ASC 842) Review: Act as the primary accounting reviewer for the corporate lease portfolio under ASC 842, verifying initial lease classification, discount rates, schedule additions/modifications, and monthly right-of-use (ROU) asset and liability entries.
  • Capital Structure Review: Review material and non-routine journal entries and balance sheet schedules relating to corporate debt instruments, interest accruals, and equity/stock-based compensation administration.
  • SOX-Compliant Review Frameworks: Perform first-pass and secondary reviews of higher-risk, material, or manual journal entries, enforcing rigid supporting-documentation requirements and segregation of duties in line with public-company SOX control standards.

3. Balance Sheet Integrity, Fixed Asset Oversight, & Financial Narratives

  • Balance Sheet Integrity: Oversee the preparation and rigorous review of critical balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring audit-ready workpapers, robust supporting documentation, and timely resolution of aged items.
  • Fixed Asset Oversight: Oversee the review and approval of fixed asset rollforwards, CAPEX schedules, and depreciation workpapers prepared by dedicated asset accounting roles, validating accurate capitalization thresholds and asset tagging.
  • Fluctuation Analysis: Lead month-over-month and quarter-over-quarter P&L and Balance Sheet variance analyses for corporate OPEX and general accounting scopes, evaluating underlying business drivers.
  • Reporting Partnership: Partner with the Assistant Controller to translate financial trends, operational estimates, and analytical findings into executive-ready close narratives.
  • Tool Optimization: Collaborate actively with close-management platform administrators (e.g., FloQast) to optimize close tasks, reduce workflow bottlenecks, and strengthen review visibility and auditability.

4. Policy Operationalization, Transformation Partnership, & Controls

  • Transformation Partnership: Partner closely with Finance Transformation peers and system administrators to operationalize new tools, process enhancements, and automated future-state accounting workflows.
  • Process Alignment & Playbooks: Support the implementation of corporate accounting policies, designing operational playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that translate US GAAP and internal control mandates into daily execution.
  • Technical Support: Partner with Technical Accounting and the Assistant Controller to embed technical updates and accounting standard changes into operational systems and workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting Operations (AP, Payroll) and FP&A to elevate upstream data integrity, cutoff discipline, and documentation standards.

5. Audit Management, Risk, & Internal Controls (SOX Readiness)

  • Audit Interface & Request Management: Serve as a primary operational interface for external auditors, managing PBC request fulfillment, technical walkthroughs, and supporting documentation across corporate accounting domains.
  • SOX Framework Execution: Design, execute, and document key management controls (ITGCs, transactional controls, and automated application controls) in alignment with ŌURA’s evolving SOX control matrix.
  • Control Testing & Deficiency Remediation: Proactively identify internal control deficiencies, process vulnerabilities, or segregation of duties gaps, partnering with internal audit and controllership leadership to design and execute immediate remediation plans.

6. Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • People Management: Directly manage, mentor, and upskill a high-performing team of corporate accountants, fostering a culture grounded in technical rigor, accountability, internal control discipline, and analytical review.
  • Performance Excellence: Set clear performance metrics, establish professional development plans, and drive continuous team growth aligned with public-company expectations.
  • Bench Strength: Build a robust internal leadership bench to sustainably support company expansion and organizational evolution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 8–10+ years of progressive corporate accounting experience, with at least 3+ years in a people management capacity within a fast-paced environment.
  • Technical & Governance Expertise: Strong foundational grasp of US GAAP, operational accrual methodologies, OPEX reporting, lease accounting (ASC 842), corporate balance sheet management, and internal control frameworks (COSO / SOX).
  • Environment: Proven track record of operating within high-growth technology, consumer products, hardware, or inventory-intensive manufacturing companies.
  • Systems & Close Tools Mastery: Advanced hands-on experience utilizing Tier-1 ERP systems (NetSuite, Oracle, or similar) alongside close management platforms (e.g., FloQast) and audit request management software.
  • Public Readiness & SOX Experience: Direct experience designing, testing, or executing SOX control frameworks and external audit processes in a public-company or late-stage pre-IPO environment.
  • Education/Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA designation required.

Benefits

At Oura,, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. About Us:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.
We support thousands of restaurants across North America, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.
Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

As the Marketing & Partner Operations Manager, you will be the owner of the systems and infrastructure that drive demand generation and partner-sourced growth. You are expected to identify the problem impacting funnel performance and ensure the system changes are made, end-to-end, to improve efficiency across the revenue engine.

You drive impact on the acquisition side by building durable systems that make channel and partner performance visible and improvable, not just reported after the fact. You define the fix and configure the system directly as a HubSpot admin, partnering with Business Systems, and you'll need enough fluency in Salesforce to ensure these systems connect seamlessly.

This role reports directly to the Head of Revenue Operations and will not have any direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.
You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.
You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.
You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

Responsibilities include:

    Reporting & Workflows

  • Own top of funnel lead routing & assignment, scoring, enrichment, and lifecycle management, built and maintained directly in HubSpot. Partner with Biz Systems on LeanData-side configuration

  • Establish clear rules of engagement and ensure attribution logic is accurate, so leads are correctly mapped to the right channel — maintaining the data integrity needed to measure channel ROI with confidence.

  • Accelerate revenue and improve pipeline hygiene by implementing automations and workflows across the lead-to-customer lifecycle.

  • Proactively identify and fix funnel inefficiencies — including MQL/PQL → SQL handoff rules and SLAs with the Sales & CS Business Partner — to improve speed to lead and conversion metrics.

  • Partner with GTM Analytics and Biz Systems on Salesforce data needs for models like Propensity to Revenue or Propensity to Close — ensuring the right fields exist, data flows cleanly between systems, and resulting scores land in Salesforce in a usable way. Model logic and validation stay with GTM Strategy & Analytics.

  • Partner with the B2B Marketing team to improve lead management and nurture across all channels (marketing, partnerships, rep-gen) — how and when leads get warmed for the Sales team.

  • Deliver ad-hoc reporting for Marketing & Partnerships teams.

  • Forecast and project expected pipeline contribution by channel to support GTM planning.

    • Marketing Ops

  • Own end-to-end delivery of marketing workflows and campaigns — build, launch, and post-launch verification — to keep the funnel healthy and acquisition on track.

  • Manage the marketing tech stack, including HubSpot and Salesforce infrastructure, integration, and field mapping requirements.

  • Standardize campaign management and reporting in SFDC to ensure consistent tracking across Marketing-sourced pipeline.

  • Partner closely with Marketing team to execute, measure, and scale multi-channel campaigns

    • Partnerships Ops

  • Own end-to-end delivery of partnerships workflows and campaigns — build, launch, and post-launch verification — to keep the partner pipeline healthy and performing.

  • Own partner tech infrastructure including Partnerstack and Salesforce, integration, and field mapping requirements

  • Analyze partner-level lead quality and conversion, collaborate with Partnerships team on incentive experiments to boost performance, and track impact to learn what works

  • Monitor partner discount usage, ensuring discounts are only applied to partner-referred deals and flagging misuse that could erode ASP. (Comp design sits with GTM Strategy & Analytics; comp operationalization sits with the Sales & CS Business Partner).

You Should Apply If You:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a similar systems-focused role, with hands-on HubSpot administration experience

  • Have a background in B2B SaaS

  • Are a genuine systems builder — comfortable owning a HubSpot instance end to end, not just using one

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agentic Ads Experience team, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered product experiences that change how advertisers work with Reddit Ads Platform.   • Measurement: Define offline and online evals, instrument traces, run A/B tests, and connect model and product metrics to advertiser and business outcomes.

jobs.description:
About InvestEngine

We’re a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we’re just getting started.

We’ve been featured by MoneyWeek, Finder and Forbes, and we’re growing fast with big ambitions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Pensions Team as its first dedicated frontend engineer. The team looks after around 100,000 SIPP accounts and thousands of pension transfers every month.

You’ll own our pensions web journeys end to end — from clarifying requirements with Product, Design and Backend to building, testing, releasing and checking how features behave in production. Your first big goal is the frontend scope of a pension administrator migration: new account-opening flows, updated legal documents and in-app changes for existing customers.

The team is backend-heavy, so you’ll be the frontend voice in technical decisions: shaping API contracts with backend engineers, setting how frontend work is reviewed and tested in Pensions, and later onboarding a second frontend engineer.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain customer-facing pension journeys in React and TypeScript

  • Own features from refinement to production, shipping web in the same sprint as backend

  • Agree API contracts, states and error handling with backend engineers and designers

  • Build complex, multi-step forms for account opening, transfers and declarations

  • Write unit and component tests, and release safely behind feature flags

  • Monitor features in production and fix issues quickly

  • Work in a large, long-lived codebase and follow our documented frontend architecture

  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) in daily work — and review what they produce

  • Set frontend review and testing practices in the team, and onboard our next frontend engineer

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, Operations and the wider frontend group

What We’re Looking For

  • Commercial experience with React and TypeScript as your main tools over the last 2+ years, in a large, long-lived codebase

  • Production experience with a state manager beyond component state (Effector, Redux or similar)

  • Solid REST API integration skills, including loading and error states

  • Experience working closely with backend engineers — discussing and shaping API contracts, not just consuming them

  • Experience building complex or multi-step forms in production

  • Unit or component testing as part of your daily work (Jest, React Testing Library or similar)

  • General understanding of web accessibility (semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA)

  • Experience working within a documented frontend architecture

  • Strong ownership: you clarify unclear requirements before you start and see features through to production

  • Clear communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders

  • English B2+ and fluent Russian

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on backend experience — commercial or personal projects

  • Experience building a Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer

  • Experience planning frontend architecture and breaking work down for other engineers

  • Experience with Effector

  • Playwright or other end-to-end testing tools

  • Feature flags and error monitoring (GrowthBook, Sentry or similar)

  • React Native experience

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry — not required, we’ll get you up to speed

How We Work

We’re a lean, collaborative team where engineers have a real influence on product, architecture and engineering culture.

We value ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. We start from the customer problem rather than the ticket, and we pick the simplest solution that works.

In Pensions, you’ll be the team’s frontend owner — the person who makes sure pension features reach customers on web at the same pace as the backend.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one — own the web side of a business-critical pensions product

  • Real ownership — shape how frontend works in the team from the start

  • Growth — onboard and mentor the next frontend engineer joining the team

  • Modern tooling — TypeScript, React, Effector, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, Claude Code and Codex

  • Remote-first and flexible — work from anywhere, at your own pace

  • Unlimited vacation — take time off when you need it, no fixed limits

  • Supportive team — thoughtful, skilled colleagues who care about quality and results

Hiring Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Technical interview with the Frontend team (about 1 hour, case-based discussion, no live coding)

  3. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  4. Final conversation with our CTO

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-obsessed Lead Solution Engineer to join our global technical operations team.

This is a premier role designed for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem-solving and direct client consultation. While you will support our diverse, global network of premium publishers, you will also serve as the critical technical lead for our rapidly expanding Brazilian market.

You won't be hiding behind a ticketing system; you will be the face of our technical expertise, working directly with our customers to solve their most complex technical challenges and seamlessly guide them through the adoption of our advanced ad-tech products. Because of this strategic focus, native or professional fluency in Portuguese is required, alongside excellent English communication skills to bridge the gap between our Brazilian customers and our global internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Consultations: Partner with global Business Development and Account Management teams to evaluate a customer’s setup, proactively recommending configurations that unlock higher ad revenue.

We have developed a set of three strategic objectives covering our policy outcomes and corporate objectives.   • To pass on to the next generation a natural environment protected and enhanced for the future.

The role:

Defra is seeking an experienced Senior HR Business Partner to join its HR Project Delivery Team, providing strategic HR leadership and expertise across high-impact initiatives within the Defra group.

The role will focus on leading and shaping business-critical HR projects, supporting organisational change, transformation and cross-cutting HR improvements. You will provide HR leadership, direction and structure, working closely with HR Business Partners, HR Expert Services teams, senior leaders and trade union partners to deliver effective people solutions.

You will take ownership of project delivery from initial scoping and design through to implementation, influencing strategic outcomes and ensuring successful transition into business-as-usual operations where required.

  • Lead and shape HR projects and provide HR input into large-scale business transformation programmes.

  • Lead projects from initial scoping and design through to implementation and delivery.
  • Establish effective project governance, structures, plans and delivery timelines.
  • Lead engagement with senior stakeholders, trade union partners and key business representatives.
  • Build and lead cross-HR matrix project teams to deliver effective people solutions.
  • Work closely with HR Business Partners and HR Expert Services teams to drive project outcomes.
  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders to achieve successful project delivery.
  • Identify, assess and manage project risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Drive collaboration and joined-up delivery across different teams and functions.
  • Support organisational change, HR transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee project closure and ensure effective transition into business-as-usual operations.

Essential:

  • Strong HR generalist experience, with the ability to operate strategically and provide HR leadership.
  • Proven experience leading and delivering HR projects, ideally within change or transformation environments.
  • Experience managing projects from initial scoping and design through to implementation.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional or matrix project teams.
  • Proven experience influencing, challenging and managing senior stakeholders.
  • Experience engaging with trade unions and key organisational partners.
  • Ability to establish effective project structures, governance and delivery plans.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Desirable:

If you are results-driven, resourceful, and strive for excellence, this could be the perfect role for you.

What You'll Do

Nice to Have
