jobs.title: Founder in Residence, Scaling grid construction and deployment
jobs.excerpt: Join us to build: we’re seeking entrepreneurially-minded individuals with deep technical and commercial domain expertise, who are eager to solve urgent unmet challenges through venture building.
jobs.description:
Join us to build: we’re seeking entrepreneurially-minded individuals with deep technical and commercial domain expertise, who are eager to solve urgent unmet challenges through venture building. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of energy infrastructure, building a new company that dramatically reduces the cost of high-voltage transmission construction through novel approaches to fragmentation and modularity.

The role is full-time, remote initially until venture incorporation and spin-out (circa Q4 2027), location TBD.

The Problem Worth Solving

Across the UK, US and Europe, electricity transmission networks face an unprecedented construction challenge. Decarbonisation targets and the electrification of heat, transport, and industry require a dramatic expansion of high-voltage overhead lines - yet the construction methods used to build transmission towers have barely changed in half a century. Lattice steel towers are fabricated in large sections, transported by heavy goods vehicles and erected using mobile cranes that can cost £300K-£750K per project mobilisation. Foundations are over-designed because site-specific geotechnical data is too expensive to gather at scale.

Most cost-reduction efforts remain anchored in incremental optimisation: slightly lighter steelwork, marginally faster crane cycles. These leave the fundamental cost structure intact. Mass-dependent items - steel, concrete, transport, cranage and installation labour - still account for 35-45% of total line CAPEX. For transmission operators facing the scale of the UK's ASTI programme, or equivalent US and European grid expansion, incremental savings are not enough.

The Opportunity

We believe one of the most promising directions is fragmentation and modularity: decomposing transmission towers into standardised, factory-produced modules - small enough for conventional transport, light enough to assemble without heavy plant, designed for rapid field connection by semi-skilled labour. This approach has the potential to address not only the direct costs of tower erection and foundation installation, but the cascading cost drivers that inflate transmission project budgets: crane mobilisation, road upgrades for heavy transport, weather-dependent construction windows, skilled labour shortages and field operations risk premiums.

The commercial space remains wide open. Existing tower manufacturers and EPC contractors are optimised for the current paradigm and face strong institutional incentives to preserve it. Transmission owners are under acute regulatory and political pressure to build faster and cheaper but lack internal innovation capacity to drive a paradigm shift. The UK's ASTI programme alone requires £20B+ of new overhead line construction over the coming decade. Similar build-out pressures exist across the US and Europe.

Ultimately, the opportunity isn't to build a better transmission tower - it's to reinvent how transmission infrastructure gets built, so grids can expand an order of magnitude faster and at dramatically lower cost. It's plausible to think about building a construction productivity company for high-voltage transmission, with the wedge being fragmentation/modularity of towers and foundations.

Working in partnership with a Major Transatlantic Utilities Company

One of the hardest parts of building an infrastructure company is securing meaningful industry access. We've already partnered with one of the world's largest transmission owners to back this opportunity. This partnership leverages their deep domain access and position as one of the world’s largest transmission owners to provide founders with unparalleled market insight and a direct route to first customers.

The Role

You will join DSV’s venture creation programme as a Founder-in-Residence and work closely with the DSV and the Partner’s team to co-found a new company. During the programme you will critically evaluate, refine, challenge and extend existing scoping work:

  • The technical thesis for approaches that fragment or modularise transmission tower and foundation construction, enabling off-site manufacture, rapid deployment, and reduced dependence on heavy plant (neglect and technical tractability);
  • Commercial neglect (IP strategy, differentiation, competition);
  • Value proposition (market, value capture, techno-economics);
  • Regulatory strategy & positioning;
  • Fundraising strategy & pitching;
  • Optimising company strategy for the most rapid and de-risked path to Series A.

Preparation for Investment Committee (IC) will involve fulfilling our investment criteria, recruiting advisory and co-founding team members, and parallel fundraising for additional expansion funds.

Assuming success at IC, you will receive pre-seed investment and spinout the company in Q4 2027. You and your co-founders will own a significant stake in the business and continue receiving support post-spinout.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Essential - engineering depth i.e.:
You have deep engineering expertise in designing, analysing or deploying complex structural systems. This will typically come from civil, structural or mechanical engineering, but we are equally interested in adjacent disciplines where similar engineering challenges arise (e.g. aerospace structures, offshore engineering, deployable structures, defence, advanced manufacturing or robotics).
You have genuine hands-on depth in at least one of:

  • Modular structural systems (interlocking connections, DfMA, kit-of-parts)
  • Advanced connection technologies (friction-grip bolting, adhesive bonding, snap-fit joints, field-weldable nodes)
  • Lightweight/composite structural materials (FRP, BFRP, advanced steel alloys)
  • Foundation engineering and geotechnics (micropile systems, helical anchors, precast foundations)
  • Automated/robotic construction (robotic assembly, drone-assisted installation, self-erecting mechanisms)

If your expertise sits outside traditional transmission engineering but you've solved comparable challenges in structural systems, modular construction, deployable infrastructure, heavy lifting, advanced manufacturing, aerospace, offshore or defence, we'd strongly encourage you to apply and tell us why your experience transfers.

Strongly preferred - translational execution e.g.:

  • Full project lifecycle experience in grid, energy or large infrastructure construction
  • Hands-on regulatory navigation (UK/EU/USA)
  • A prototype or field trial you personally shipped, or a type-test/standards-compliant data package you delivered
  • Experience designing products or systems for manufacture, field deployment or installation at scale (DfMA, modular construction or equivalent)

Nice to have - commercial experience e.g.:

  • BD/partnerships experience in energy infrastructure/construction
  • Founder, C-suite or technical leadership experience building and commercialising deep-tech, construction-tech or industrial products.

Above all, we're looking for systems thinkers. We're less interested in incremental optimisation of existing transmission infrastructure, and more interested in engineers who naturally rethink how complex systems are designed, manufactured and deployed. If you've fundamentally changed how something gets built, assembled or installed - even outside the transmission industry - we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

Our Offer

By joining DSV, you’ll be joining a team of operators who have founded companies and led translation of science at some of the most respected universities, charities, funds and government agencies. 2/3 of the team have founded or led a company at C-suite and 65% have a PhD. Our team dedicate several hours every week to each Founder or founding team to provide tailored guidance, resources and feedback covering every aspect of what it takes to successfully launch a new venture from both the tech and commercial perspectives:

  • We provide optimised, purpose-built, proprietary tools, resources and processes to help create high-impact ventures from scratch, using our venture creation methodology;
  • DSV and the Partners’ extensive network incl. leaders of energy infrastructure, transmission operators, EPC contractors, technical & commercial domain expertise, and wide-ranging portfolio company capabilities;
  • We jointly provide an initial £250k (~$340k / €290k) investment governed by our Investment Committee to incorporate the new venture and develop early proof-of-concept data that is often needed to attract high profile non-venture studio VCs. This funding is also key for obtaining grant funding, which often needs to be matched with private investment;
  • You and your co-founder(s) together will own the majority equity stake in the company;
  • We provide minimum guaranteed income of £4,166 per month (fixed), paid to each Founder as a consultancy fee until the company is launched and pre-seed investment is secured;
  • We provide continuous support post spin-out, including fundraising, commercial partnerships, recruitment and team-building (amongst other things);
  • Other Founders currently at DSV across sectors working collaboratively and supporting one another - a unique resource to draw on.

About DSV

Deep Science Ventures (DSV) is on a mission to create a future in which both humans and the planet can thrive. We use our unique venture creation process to create, spin-out, and invest in science companies, combining available scientific knowledge and founder-type scientists into high-impact ventures. Operating in four sectors - Pharmaceuticals, Climate, Agriculture, and Computation - we tackle the challenges defining these areas by taking a first principles approach and partnering with leading institutions.

jobs.title: MBA Intern, Strategy & Development
jobs.excerpt: Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy’s biggest challenges: wasted power.
jobs.description:
Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy’s biggest challenges: wasted power. Our data centersconvert excesssolar, hydro, and windenergy into productive computational work, such as Bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. By co-locating with renewable power sources, we bring demand directly to the source,helping power plants increase revenue while contributing more megawatts to the grid.

We are looking for an MBA Intern, Development & Strategy to join our world-class team.

The Opportunity

Soluna's growth depends on finding the right sites before anyone else does. Every week, inbound leads arrive from independent power producers, renewable developers, landowners, and brokers — and our team sources many more. Most of them will not work. A small number are exceptional. The difference between the two is a disciplined screen: is there curtailed or low-cost power, is there a credible path to interconnection, is there land, fiber, and water, and does the arithmetic clear our return threshold?

This internship owns the front end of that funnel. You will take raw leads, run them through Soluna's qualification criteria, build a first-pass economic screen, and produce a clear recommendation on whether the opportunity advances to full diligence or gets a fast, well-reasoned no. The modeling is deliberately light — enough to size the opportunity and pressure-test the assumptions, not a full project finance build. Speed and judgment matter more than precision at this stage.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team: your screens will be read by the people who decide where Soluna builds next.

What You'll Do

Lead Qualification & Screening

  • Run inbound and sourced leads through Soluna's qualification framework — power cost and curtailment profile, interconnection status and queue position, land control, fiber and water availability, and counterparty credibility.
  • Produce a standard one-page qualification summary for each lead so the team can make a go / no-go call quickly and consistently.
  • Recommend advance, park, or pass on every opportunity you touch, with the reasoning written down — including the reasoning behind the passes.
  • Maintain the lead intake queue so nothing sits unreviewed and the team always knows what is waiting.

Light Financial Modeling

  • Build first-pass economic screens for qualified sites — estimated cost of power, capacity sizing, indicative capex, and top-line return.
  • Run sensitivities on the variables that actually move the answer, such as energy price, curtailment hours, hashprice or contracted AI/HPC revenue, and time to energization.
  • Pressure-test counterparty assumptions against market data and flag where a lead's claims are not supported by the underlying economics.
  • Keep the screening model clean and reusable so the team can run it without you after the internship ends.

Market & Pipeline Intelligence

  • Track opportunities across ERCOT, SPP, MISO, and PJM, including interconnection queue movement and curtailment trends that create new leads.
  • Update the pipeline tracker and executive summary so leadership has a current view of what is in the funnel and where it stands.
  • Research specific markets, utilities, or counterparties on demand to support live deal conversations.
  • Present a summer project to the Development & Strategy team and senior leadership — a durable improvement to how Soluna screens and qualifies opportunities.

What You Bring

Required

  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program, with an expected graduation date following the internship period.
  • Strong Excel modeling skills — comfortable building a screening model from a blank sheet, not just editing someone else's.
  • Demonstrated analytical judgment: the ability to reach a defensible answer with incomplete information and say clearly what you do not know.
  • Clear, concise written communication; you can compress a complicated opportunity into one page a busy executive will actually read.
  • Genuine interest in energy, digital infrastructure, or the intersection of the two.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, private equity, or corporate development.
  • Familiarity with U.S. wholesale power markets, interconnection processes, or renewable project development.
  • Exposure to market data platforms such as Orennia, Velocity Suite, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of Bitcoin mining economics or AI/HPC data center demand drivers.
  • Comfort building in PowerPoint for investor- and board-facing audiences.

Why join Soluna?

We are a diverse, driven team of entrepreneurs, energy experts, private equity leaders, storytellers and engineers. We are passionate about making the world greener and we have conviction about how we will bring change on a global scale.

We are equally as zealous about championing our teams, relentless about developing our people, and believe strongly that Soluna’s goals and commitment to our mission are strengthened by our employee’s voices.

  • Ability to operate at both a strategic and operational level – Established experience launching successful products in highly competitive technology markets.

  • Proven creative thinker that independently generates and executes on innovative product marketing ideas. Proven track record in crafting compelling positioning and thought leadership content.

Working for Velixo:

At Velixo, we believe in creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

Accuris transforms the world's largest repository of standards and supply chain data into AI-driven insights and connected workflows - enabling engineers to work smarter, stay compliant, and innovate faster. Behind every world-changing innovation - there's Accuris - the most trusted intelligence platform for engineers. The Opportunity Accuris is seeking a strategic, analytical, and hands-on Head of Demand Generation to build a predictable, scalable pipeline engine across our Engineering Intelligence and Supply Chain Intelligence portfolios. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this leader will own the global demand generation strategy - from audience segmentation and campaign development through pipeline creation, acceleration, and measurement. You will bring together digital programs, account-based marketing, lifecycle marketing, events, content activation, and sales plays into coordinated buying experiences. This is a highly visible role for a leader who understands complex enterprise B2B markets. The right person can translate growth objectives into executable programs, develop a clear point of view about where to invest, and remain close enough to execution to improve campaigns in real time. Success will be measured by qualified pipeline and revenue contribution - not activity or lead volume alone. What You'll Own Demand strategy and pipeline

  • Develop and lead Accuris's global demand generation strategy, aligned with annual revenue targets, priority markets, product launches, and customer expansion objectives.
  • Own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline goals, including coverage, conversion, velocity, and program return.
  • Create differentiated demand motions for Accuris's Engineering Intelligence and Supply Chain Intelligence solutions.
  • Balance new-logo acquisition with cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, and customer expansion opportunities.
  • Build quarterly and annual plans that clearly connect investments, audiences, programs, pipeline targets, and expected business outcomes.
  • Establish a disciplined testing and optimization roadmap across messages, offers, audiences, channels, and conversion points.

Integrated campaigns

  • Turn company and product priorities into integrated campaigns that span paid media, organic and AI search, email, webinars, events, content syndication, retargeting, nurture, and sales activation.
  • Work with Product Marketing to develop compelling buying journeys for technical users, functional leaders, and executive decision-makers.

  • Create repeatable campaign frameworks that can be adapted by product, industry, geography, account segment, and stage of the customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Field and Partner Marketing to connect global programs with regional, industry, publisher, and channel opportunities.

Account-based growth

  • Design and scale account-based marketing programs for priority enterprise accounts and buying groups.
  • Partner with Sales to define target accounts, identify account-level opportunities, coordinate outreach, and establish shared success measures.
  • Use account, intent, engagement, and opportunity data to determine when and how Marketing and Sales should act.
  • Develop plays for whitespace discovery, stalled-pipeline acceleration, competitive displacement, renewal support, and expansion within the installed base.

Lifecycle and conversion

  • Own the prospect lifecycle from first engagement through qualification, sales acceptance, pipeline progression, and re-engagement.
  • Improve conversion across web experiences, forms, content offers, demo requests, events, nurture programs, and sales handoffs.
  • Develop nurture strategies based on audience, product interest, account status, behavior, and buying stage.
  • Work with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to strengthen scoring, routing, attribution, funnel definitions, data quality, and service-level agreements.

Performance and operations

Leadership and collaboration

  • Create strong operating relationships across Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Product, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Bring clarity and focus to a complex portfolio, helping teams align around a manageable number of high-impact growth priorities.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, experimentation, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of revenue outcomes.
  • Communicate strategy, performance, risks, and recommendations clearly to executive stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Clear, persuasive communication skills and the ability to create alignment across functions and levels.
  • A customer-centered mindset and the intellectual curiosity to understand technical products, specialized markets, and engineering audiences.

Especially Valuable

jobs.excerpt: Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt.
jobs.description:
Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt. Aktuell hängen zu viele Entscheidungen an zu wenigen Köpfen — und unsere Account Manager:innen brauchen jemanden, der sie führt, nicht nur jemanden, der über ihnen steht.

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Wir sagen offen dazu: Diese Rolle ist gerade die anspruchsvollste im Unternehmen. Du bekommst Druck von oben (Wachstumsziele) und von unten (ein Team, das sich erst einspielt). Wir wissen das, wir lassen dich damit nicht allein — aber wir tun auch nicht so, als wäre es bequem.

Aufgaben

Führung

  • Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
  • Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
  • Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Kunden

  • Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.
  • Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.
  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.

Fachlichkeit & Prozesse

  • Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
  • Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
  • Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
  • Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.

Qualifikation

  1. Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
  2. Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
  3. Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
  4. Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
  5. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
  6. Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).

Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.

Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
  • … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
  • … du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.
  • … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.
  • … du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

Benefits

  • Ein Team, das dir gehört — und die Freiheit, es zu formen.
  • Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.
  • Halbjährliche Entwicklungsgespräche mit echtem Feedback statt Formularen. Gehalt wird bei uns nach System vergeben, nicht nach Verhandlungsgeschick.
  • Führungskräfte-Ausbildung mit einem externen Coach, der Führungsteams bei Meta und in mehreren Scale-ups aufgebaut hat.
  • 100 % remote, überall in Deutschland — plus regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations.
  • MacBook, bei Bedarf zusätzliche Hardware.
  • 50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit.

Sechs Sätze, an denen wir uns messen lassen — auch als Führungskraft:

Be confident.

We don't need all the answers to start, just the grit to find them first.

Be curious.

Let's be obsessed to find the ‚Why‘ to unlock the ‚How‘.

Keep growing.

Treat yourself like brilliant software: ship a new upgrade every month.

Be accountable.

Openness over cosiness. We own our words.

Act entrepreneurial.

Don't just do tasks: own real business impact.

Over-deliver where it matters.

Promise what's possible. Then challenge these boundaries.

jobs.title: Global Commodity Manager - Optics
jobs.excerpt: As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era.
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.


Ciena’s Supply Chain organization drives strategic sourcing decisions that enable innovation, technology leadership, and operational resilience across the optical networking portfolio. This role influences supplier strategy, risk management, cost optimization, and new product introduction activities for critical optical components. Success in this position helps ensure access to leading technologies while maintaining supply continuity and competitive advantage.

How you will make an impact:

  • Develop and implement commodity strategies for optical products and suppliers across technology, quality, supply, and cost objectives.
  • Monitor optical component market trends, technology developments, product costs, supply conditions, and supplier landscapes to inform sourcing strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align commodity strategies with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Lead negotiations to optimize total cost of ownership for optical components throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Resolve critical supply shortages through engagement with suppliers and EMS partners to maintain supply continuity.
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risks associated with optical components throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Build supplier relationships and conduct recurring business reviews to align supplier actions with business objectives.

The must haves:

  • Education: Engineering and/or Business degree.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in optical procurement.
  • Experience: 5+ years of Commodity Management and/or Procurement experience.
  • Application of optical technologies, optical component industry trends, and supplier ecosystems.
  • Utilization of optical products including lasers, optical receivers, modulators, passive optical components, and transceivers.
  • Background in optics manufacturing processes, including optical fabrication, assembly, and testing.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, including R&D, PLM, and Quality, on commodity initiatives.

Nice to haves:

  • Commodity knowledge of optical components including, but not limited to, line cards, WSS & ROADMs, gain blocks, and laser pumps.
  • Expertise defining and implementing supply strategies to mitigate risks and ensure continuity of supply for optical components.
  • Experience resolving critical supply shortages and optimizing supplier relationships.
  • Experience supporting internal stakeholders with the negotiation of legal agreements involving suppliers.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure using time management practices.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support supplier relationships and business needs.

Pay Range:

The annual pay range for this position is $97,300 - $155,300 CAD

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

Required Qualifications:

  • Understanding of agile methodologies, scrum, waterfall, and software development processes.
  • Minimum 2 years of project management experience, with a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams on successful technical projects in a consulting environment.
  • Experience managing project risks and controlling scope, budget, and schedule.

Preferred Qualifications:

fusionSpan is a fast-paced, high-energy global firm with a highly motivated team. We are open to qualified candidates worldwide even though our job opportunities are posted for a specific region.

We embrace change, celebrate creativity, and prioritize quality to create a new standard of performance.

jobs.title: Fund Administration Senior Associate
jobs.excerpt: FSG is the solution for operational excellence being sought by private fund managers who wish to focus solely on raising capital and identifying investment opportunities.
jobs.description:
FSG is the solution for operational excellence being sought by private fund managers who wish to focus solely on raising capital and identifying investment opportunities. We support the entire life-cycle of our clients’ private funds and management company, managing the execution of investments, the experience of their investors, and the compliance, finance and human resource solutions needed to satisfy all regulatory requirements. Our team is asked to serve our clients with consistent excellence and accountability, while being allowed to live their definition of success. We focus on bringing new team members on board who share our passion for providing excellence in our service, while never wavering from our Principles of integrity, effort, communication and protecting time with our families.

Fund Administration Senior Associate

FSG is the opportunity to learn and experience the finance industry for a people-oriented, hard-working, team player. Our unique culture is built by the team and for the team. Our compensation structure provides unlimited upside to our team members. We will teach you all that you need to know to be successful on our team, so we do not require any specific degree or work history. We just hope you are as non-traditional and eager to prove yourself as we are!

Your key responsibilities are to deliver white glove service and honor the FSG Principles while:

  • Recording accounting entries based on both cash and accrual activity, ensuring accuracy and compliance
  • Monitoring investment activity and performance, including preparing roll-forwards
  • Reconciling cash activity and investigating and resolving discrepancies
  • Preparing and critically assessing management fee calculations, allocation schedules, and carried interest models
  • Compiling financial statements, annual reports, partner notices, and tax schedules
  • Coordinating and liaising with internal team members and third parties, including audit and tax partners, serving as a reviewer of their deliverables
  • Supporting the onboarding and training of new team members, providing guidance and oversight to maintain standards of excellence

Our requirements for you as an applicant are simple:

  • Experience (3–7 years) in private equity, hedge fund, and/or private fund accounting
  • Developed understanding of GAAP and foundational knowledge of private fund specific tax concepts
  • Knowledge of key concepts such as fee calculations, capital activities, and operational best practices
  • Be a team player with an enthusiastic work ethic
  • Learn all we teach you quickly, comprehensively, and enthusiastically
  • Be exceptional in your organizational and written communication skills
  • Have an exacting attention to detail
  • Be exemplary in prioritization and multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment
  • Be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Experience with fund administration software a plus but not a requirement

If you excel in your responsibilities and fulfill your requirements, our commitment to you is:

  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Base salary commensurate with experience and success: The annual base salary range for this position is $90,000 to $115,000
  • Quarterly bonus that offers unlimited potential growth - 1/3rd of our profits (no matter how much) are shared with our team in bonuses each quarter

We are primarily a remote work company, but some of the training for this role may be best delivered in-person leveraging client sites or local coworking locations. Our clients also ask us to provide on-site support from time-to-time. In the interview process, we can outline expectations about what, if any, in-person training or support time is expected to be required for this role.

You will be successful when you deliver exemplary service to our clients and their investors, fulfill the FSG vision and purpose, and bring success to the entire FSG team. We are excited to have you join our team and appreciate your interest in joining us on a journey to success!

He or she is an expert in understanding patient journeys across multiple brands and how people live in our digital world, while bringing the heart of traditional planning. This position will frequently distil research and data analytics down into meaningful insights and strategic recommendations, clearly articulating the thinking behind our work, ideas and POVs. This person will be an advocate for the EVERSANA INTOUCH planning process to both internal and client teams, able to clearly align the planning department to help address our client’s business needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: BASE COMPENSATION: $170,000 - $190,000 annually WORKPLACE SETTING: Remote POSITION SUMMARY The Solution Architect at 10X Health paves the road for every major initiative: shaping the solution from business intent through product and system architecture, proving it in working code, and handing development teams specifications precise enough to build fast and build right.
jobs.description:
BASE COMPENSATION: $170,000 - $190,000 annually
WORKPLACE SETTING: Remote

POSITION SUMMARY
The Solution Architect at 10X Health paves the road for every major initiative: shaping the solution from business intent through product and system architecture, proving it in working code, and handing development teams specifications precise enough to build fast and build right. This is emphatically not a paper architecture role. The Solution Architect validates designs by building them, typically delivering the first 50-60% of an initiative as working reference implementation before development teams take it to completion. In an organization where AI agents have largely solved the mechanics of writing code, the scarce skill is upstream: defining granular, unambiguous, development-ready specifications ahead of time. This role owns that discipline, owns the overall technology roadmap, and spans the full surface of our platforms, including web, cloud, integrations, and mobile. The role reports to the Chief Technology Officer.

ABOUT 10X HEALTH SYSTEM
10X Health System is a pioneering company at the forefront of the health and wellness industry, dedicated to revolutionizing the way individuals approach their personal health and well-being. With a philosophy rooted in the principle that optimal health is the foundation for a life lived to the fullest, 10X Health provides cutting-edge solutions and personalized health plans designed to empower individuals to achieve and maintain peak physical and mental performance.

The company's comprehensive approach to health combines the latest advances in medical science, nutrition, fitness, and technology to offer a suite of services that include state-of-the-art diagnostic testing, individualized treatment protocols, and ongoing support from a team of world-class health professionals. 10X Health's commitment to innovation and results has established it as a leader in the health optimization space, catering to those who strive to push the boundaries of what is possible in their health journey.

OBJECTIVES

  • Own solution design for each company initiative end to end: from business intent to product architecture, system architecture, integration design, and buildable specifications
  • Prove architecture in code by building reference implementations, scaffolding, and the riskiest vertical slices, typically the first 50-60%, before handing to development teams
  • Produce granular, development-ready specifications, designed so that developers and AI coding agents can execute rapidly with minimal ambiguity or rework
  • Own product architecture alongside system architecture: how capabilities compose into products, member journeys, and revenue lines, not just how services talk to each other
  • Own and maintain the overall technology roadmap, keeping it aligned with company strategy, sequencing initiatives, and making dependencies and tradeoffs visible to leadership
  • Design integration solutions across commercial SaaS platforms, owned services, laboratory and clinical partners, and data systems
  • Set the architectural direction for mobile alongside web and cloud, ensuring one coherent platform across surfaces
COMPETENCIES
  • Remains genuinely hands-on: prototypes, codes, and ships working software as the primary method of validating architecture
  • Translates ambiguous business intent into precise technical specifications, closing the gap between what stakeholders ask for and what teams can build
  • Demonstrates deep expertise in enterprise architecture, scalable system design, and modern API and microservices patterns
  • Designs mobile application architecture (native or cross-platform) and understands the operational realities of app store delivery, offline behavior, and device data
  • Develops scalable integration solutions across platforms, applications, and data systems, including vendor and partner systems with imperfect interfaces
  • Applies DevOps and CI/CD best practices so reference implementations land in production pipelines, not in slide decks
  • Maintains strong focus on security, compliance, and data protection standards, including HIPAA obligations in a healthcare context
  • Communicates architecture clearly to executives, product stakeholders, and engineers alike, adjusting altitude without losing precision
AI and Agentic Engineering
  • Uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code as a core working method, both to build reference implementations at high speed and to pressure-test whether specifications are truly unambiguous • Designs specifications and architecture artifacts for an AI-accelerated delivery model, where granular specs are the input that lets agents and developers produce correct code fast
  • Designs and ships AI product features end to end, including model API integration, agent orchestration, retrieval augmented generation, structured tool use, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to internal systems
  • Builds evaluation and quality systems for AI features, including automated evals, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review, so AI behavior stays measurable and controllable in production
  • Applies responsible AI practices in a healthcare context, balancing model autonomy with human oversight and keeping AI features aligned with HIPAA, FTC, and broader consumer protection standards
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience as a hands-on architect on complex, multi-system initiatives
  • Proven record of taking initiatives from concept to production, personally building foundational implementations that other engineers then extended
  • Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, APIs, microservices, integrations, and scalable architecture; Microsoft Azure experience preferred
  • Experience architecting and shipping production mobile applications alongside web and backend systems
  • Experience writing detailed technical specifications and driving spec-first development across internal and offshore teams
  • Experience owning or heavily shaping a technology roadmap across multiple products or initiatives
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping production AI or LLM-powered product features, such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, copilots, or content generation pipelines
  • Practical experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot in real engineering work, ideally including building custom agent skills, MCP integrations, or automated pipelines on top of them
  • Healthcare, health-tech, SaaS, eCommerce, or consumer platform experience preferred
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Ability to spend prolonged periods working on a computer and communicating with patients and team members
  • Ability to interact with patients virtually and occasionally in person
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions
COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY
As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, 10X Health System recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates, and partners. If you require any accommodations during the application process or have any questions, please contact

SOLICITATION POLICY
10X Health does not accept unsolicited resumes, calls, or communications from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Any such submissions will be considered the sole property of 10X Health and will not obligate the company to pay any fees. Please refrain from contacting us regarding this posting.

jobs.title: Bilingual Service Coordinator & Dispatcher (French/English) — Remote
jobs.excerpt: As our Bilingual Service Coordinator & Dispatcher, you are the first voice our customers hear and the engine that keeps our field teams moving.
jobs.description:
As our Bilingual Service Coordinator & Dispatcher, you are the first voice our customers hear and the engine that keeps our field teams moving. You'll own inbound calls, turn them into well-organized jobs, and make sure the right technician is in the right place at the right time. Over time, you'll also take on billing and administrative work that keeps the operation running smoothly.

This is a remote, full-time role working Quebec business hours — which corresponds to an afternoon-to-evening shift in Beirut (see Additional Information).

Your responsibilities:

  • Answer inbound customer calls in French and English as the first point of contact, delivering a calm, professional, and reassuring experience
  • Understand and classify each request (drainage vs. plumbing, emergency vs. scheduled, type of service) and capture accurate details
  • Book appointments and on-site inspections into our field management software (Jobber)
  • Schedule and dispatch field technicians efficiently — grouping jobs by geographic zone to minimize drive time and maximize productive hours
  • Coordinate daily with field crews: confirm schedules, adjust for delays and emergencies, and keep everyone informed
  • Prepare and send invoices, process billing, and follow up on outstanding payments
  • Handle ongoing client communications and follow-ups (confirmations, reminders, status updates)
  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the internal team

Required:

In 2017, Jan Sapper, Paperlike's founder and CEO, developed and launched a screen protector for the iPad that became an instant hit with digital artists and notetakers.

Since then, we've come a long way.

Today, we sell professional accessories for iPad users worldwide through our Shopify store, Amazon, and retail stores. We've built a global team (25 amazing people from all over the world) and a brand that is well-respected in our community.

And that's where you come in. We've built a solid foundation with 250k+ followers across all social media platforms. Now we're looking for a strategic, data-driven Social Media Manager to own and evolve how Paperlike shows up on social, and help us grow a brand that people genuinely love.

About this Role

We're looking for a full-time Social Media Manager to own Paperlike's presence across all brand channels. This isn't a content creation role. It's a strategy role. You'll be responsible for how the brand communicates on social: what we say, when we say it, to whom, and why it's working (or not).

You'll own the publishing calendar, manage community engagement, drive creator seeding outreach, and report on the metrics that actually matter. You'll bring a strong point of view on strategy and the organizational rigor to execute it.

What will you do as Paperlike's Social Media Manager?

Strategy

  • Own and drive Paperlike's social media strategy across all brand channels
  • Use performance data to inform content decisions, optimize for growth, and identify opportunities
  • Stay on top of platform trends and algorithm shifts and know when to act on them
  • Bring strategic recommendations to leadership with clear rationale and measurable goals

Content & Publishing

  • Own the social publishing calendar end-to-end: planning, scheduling, and quality control
  • Write copy across all social channels with a consistent, on-brand voice
  • Maintain a strong aesthetic eye for what goes out: every post should look and feel like Paperlike
  • Project manage the content production pipeline with two video producers and the creative team to brief, review, and deploy content

Community & Creator Relations

  • Manage community engagement across all platforms, including DMs and comments
  • Lead creator seeding outreach: identify, contact, and start relationships with relevant creators

Reporting

  • Track and report on social reach, engagement, and community growth on a regular cadence
  • Translate data into insights: not just numbers, but what they mean and what to do next

>>APPLY HERE<<

This role is for you if:

  • You have a track record of owning strategy (not just executing it).
  • You lead with data. You know how to read performance metrics and use them to make decisions.
  • You're a strong copywriter. You can write a caption that stops a scroll and sounds like a real person.
  • You have a genuine eye for aesthetics and understand what "on-brand" actually means in practice.
  • You are exceptionally organized. You can juggle a multi-channel publishing calendar, creator outreach, community management, and reporting without dropping balls.
  • You have experience with Notion and Sprout Social (not required, but a strong plus.)
  • You're comfortable working independently in a remote, async-first environment.
  • You're fluent in English, with excellent written communication skills.

>>APPLY HERE<<

Who will you work with (mostly)?

  • Kayla. Head of Brand Awareness, who leads social, partnerships, and marketing campaigns. You'll report directly to her.
  • Elina. Our Partnerships Manager, who owns all things creator and brand partnerships. You’ll work with her on any campaigns and sourcing UGC.
  • Harriett. Our Social Media Support Assistant, who is in our inbox five days of the week and will be supporting you in maintaining Paperlike’s voice when we comment or DM.
  • Content Producers. Two video creators who produce art and productivity content for our organic channels. You’ll write the briefs and give feedback on their content before scheduling them to go live.
  • The broader Paperlike team, a fully remote group of 25 people spread across the world.

Money, Time & Position Type

  • This is a full-time role. You can be based anywhere in the world, but we'd need you available for occasional video calls sometime between 9:00 and 17:00 CET.
  • Either freelance (international) or employed (Germany).
  • Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Jan founded Paperlike in 2017 as a side project to solve his own need for a better iPad and Apple Pencil experience. Since he loves crowdfunding, he launched a Kickstarter for the Paperlike and was blown away by the response. He soon left his job and made Paperlike a full-time endeavor.

Now in 2026, we're a team of about 25 people. At our core, we still operate the same way: relentlessly focused on what matters, automating whatever we can to free our time and minds.

Our team is 100% remote, spread all over the world: from New York to Turkey, from Germany to China.

jobs.description:
About the Organization

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

About the Role
Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking an Everything Engineers" with a Backend focus to modernize a mission-critical legacy system managing billions of dollars in international security cooperation.

The Project

    We’re working to modernize a mission-critical legacy system that manages foreign military sales cases for the U.S. government. It’s the system of record behind billions of dollars in international security cooperation. The legacy platform is a decades-old fat-client application with hundreds of screens, millions of lines of Java code, hundreds of thousands of lines of stored-procedure logic, hundreds of reports, and a ton of batch processing. It works. But we can do better for an important national security mission.

    Our job is pretty straight forward. Out with the old, in with the new. We’re going to replace the legacy system with a modern web platform that does all the things; from a functional perspective, a technical perspective, and a compliance perspective. And we’re going to make it happen through quick iterations, built on an Agentic AI Software Development Lifecycle.

How we build (read this before applying)

    AI-led development isn’t a novelty act, its just how software is built. Full stop. Every engineer on this team works through agentic toolkits, Codex/Claude Code/etc. Every day. On production code. Our engineering harness (versioned rules, skills, and specs that guide both humans and agents) is a first-class product with its own backlog. We measure ourselves on shipped, verified capability, not lines typed.

    What that means in practice:

    • You’ll decompose problems into specs precise enough that an agent can implement them directly and concretely, and you’ll own everything you merge, because agent output is your output.
    • You’ll review rigorously. The bar is production software for a regulated federal financial system: test-driven development, human review on every merge, and a rigorous CI scans.
    • You’ll ship constantly. Small reviewable changes, an always-green main branch, an always-on beta environment stakeholders can touch.
    • You get to play with all the latest cool tech as part of your job.

      • If you think of AI-led development as vibe-coding, or some fad you tolerate between “real” coding sessions, this isn’t your team. If you’ve hand rolled enough code to appreciate how Agentic AI outsources all the tedious bits and lets you build anything, let’s talk.

What “Everything Engineer” means

    Everybody builds across the whole stack (UI, API, database, infrastructure, pipeline) because our unit of work is a complete vertical slice of business capability, not a layer. You’ll have genuine breadth: you can stand up infrastructure, debug a pipeline, reason about security controls, and hold your own in any layer of the system. And you’ll have real depth in your focus area, where you set the technical bar for the team.

Your focus: Backend

    You’ll own the heart of the rebuild: the domain model and services that replace decades of accumulated business logic.

  • Domain services in TypeScript/Node behind a REST API: case lifecycle state machines, document generation, pricing and payment-schedule calculation engines, workflow and milestone logic.
  • Business-rule archaeology. The legacy system’s rules live smeared across converted Java, PL/SQL packages, and database triggers. You’ll help extract them into an evidence-cited knowledge base, then reimplement them with tests that prove parity, including golden-master harnesses that replay legacy calculations and diff results to the penny.
  • Financial-grade correctness. Append-only audit trails, segregation-of-duties enforcement, reproducible calculations, and interface controls. This system faces federal financial audit standards, and we build that in rather than bolting it on.
  • External interfaces. Rebuilding fi le-based and API integrations with a dozen partner systems (logistics, accounting/ERP, training management), contract-first, with emulators before live connections.

Who thrives here

  • Deep, wide technical background. You’ve written a lot of code for web-based systems, and you understand the whole ecosystem it lives in: cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, networking, security, not just the application layer. When something breaks two layers below your code, you follow it down.
  • Agent-native. Real, hands-on mileage with Codex and/or Claude Code (or equivalent) on codebases that matter. You have opinions about specs, context, and harness design based on your experiences.
  • A tinkerer. Intellectually curious, pulls threads, wants to understand why the legacy trigger cascades the way it does before replacing it. You build quality solutions because you actually understand the problem.
  • Generous. You share information by default: docs, demos, pairing, better harness rules for everyone. You put the success of the team ahead of your individual success.
  • Good to break bread with. We’re a small team on a challenging mission.

The Stack

    TypeScript end to end. Node with a REST API. PostgreSQL with Prisma. React front end. Temporal workflows. AWS GovCloud, defined in AWS CDK (TypeScript). GitHub and GitHub Actions CI. Vitest and Playwright. Codex and/or Claude Code (or equivalent) with a versioned team harness. Slack and Jira. Everything gets wrapped in containers and pushed to EKS or ECS. On the legacy side you’ll deal with: Oracle 19c, PL/SQL, converted-Forté Java, Cognos, Control-M.

Requirements

  • US citizenship and eligibility for a US SECRET clearance
  • 7+ years building and operating production web systems
  • Mentors the mid deliberately
  • Strong track record building production web systems, with demonstrable depth in server-side and domain-model work
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development tools (Codex and/or Claude Code, or equivalent) on real codebases
  • Fluency across the ecosystem: cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and security fundamentals
  • Travel no more than once per quarter

Desired Experience

    Ability to read PL/SQL and legacy Java (you’ll be doing archaeology, not just greenfield work); experience with financial calculation engines, audit- or compliance-sensitive systems, or complex state machines.

    Nice to have:
    Prior work in a regulated or government environment (FedRAMP, RMF, IL-anything); REST API design at scale; Oracle-to-Postgres migration scars.

jobs.description:
Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Nonprofits do some of the most important work in the world, and most of them are still managing grants in spreadsheets. We're fixing that.

Instrumentl is a profitable, hypergrowth, YC-backed SaaS platform building the operating system for grant-funded organizations. More than 5,500 nonprofits use Instrumentl to discover, track, and win grant funding, from local community organizations to the San Diego Zoo and the University of Alaska. Collectively they’ve moved over $1 billion through our platform.

We're growing quickly, customers love us (check out our G2 reviews!), and we're hiring people who want to build something that matters.

About the role:

    We're hiring a Manager, Scaled Customer Success to build and run our scaled CS motion, reporting to our VP of Customer Success. As our customer base grows, we're splitting CS into two motions: a book-of-business motion for our highest-touch accounts, and a scaled motion that reaches the long tail of customers through data-driven, one-to-many engagement. You'll own the scaled side end to end, leading a team of roughly six Scaled Customer Success Managers and building the operating processes that let a small team deliver real value at high volume. This is a hands-on leadership seat for someone who has actually run a scaled motion before and wants to build one from the ground up at a profitable, fast-moving company.

What you'll do:

    Own the scaled motion

  • Own day-to-day execution of the scaled CS motion, where a small team supports a high volume of lower-ACV customers through data-driven, one-on-one engagements
  • Design the customer journey for scale: define the touchpoints, plays, and automation that help customers reach value without a dedicated CSM for every account
  • Set clear, data-driven goals for the team tied to activation, adoption, retention, and expansion across the scaled book
  • Partner with the book-of-business motion so accounts move cleanly between segments and customers never fall through the cracks

    • People management & coaching

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of roughly six Scaled Customer Success Managers
  • Run effective 1:1s focused on performance, skill development, and growth
  • Conduct call and workflow reviews and provide enablement to help the team improve their craft
  • Support goal-setting, feedback, and performance management in alignment with company values

    • Operational ownership & systems

  • Build and own the operating rhythm for scale: segmentation, health scoring, playbooks, and the reporting that tells you where to focus
  • Stand up and improve the systems the motion runs on, including CRM workflows, lifecycle automation, and dashboards
  • Use data and customer signals to decide where the team spends its time and to catch risk early
  • Identify gaps in execution and proactively improve workflows and handoffs as the motion matures

    • Hands-on customer leadership

  • Join customer calls and conversations as needed, including escalations and moments that need a leader in the room
  • Guide the team through complex customer situations and decision-making
  • Model strong customer communication, empathy, and problem-solving in real interactions

What we're looking for:

    Required

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, including direct people management of a CSM team, at a level where you owned team performance and development
  • Demonstrated ownership of a scaled, pooled, or digital-first CS motion that you actually ran, not just observed, with a track record of driving retention or expansion at high volume
  • A genuinely data-driven, operational approach: you build the segmentation, health scoring, playbooks, and reporting a scaled motion runs on rather than managing account by account
  • Proven ability to move fast and stay effective in a startup environment: comfortable with ambiguity, iterating in the open, and building process where none exists yet

    • Nice to have

  • Experience standing up a scaled motion from scratch, including the first version of the tooling and automation
  • Background working with a product-led or self-serve customer base alongside a sales-led motion
  • A real connection to the nonprofit sector or mission-driven work
  • Experience partnering closely with a peer manager who owns a separate CS segment

Compensation & Benefits

    For US-based candidates, the target salary range is $130,000–$160,000 USD base + equity. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skillset, scope, interview performance, and geographic location.

    Benefits

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (50% for dependents).
  • Generous PTO, including parental leave.
  • 401(k).
  • Company laptop and home-office stipend.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Pricing & Revenue Planner to support our growing Worldwide Planning team in the Operations org. In this role you will partner with Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Product, R&D, and other revenue impacting teams to shape our pricing and customer willingness to pay outlook and track our revenue pacing vs. expectations. You will work with cross-functional teams to identify deal-related impacts, deliver market insights on customer trends, evaluate key discounting assumptions, and provide subject matter expertise to executive stakeholders and the rest of the Planning team. You will also manage CFO-level reporting on key company metrics including variable cost, product mix, and hardware-related dynamics impacting company profitability. Ideal candidates should be curious learners with experience in SaaS pricing analytics and benchmarking, be able to drive new processes and tools, and be comfortable translating large amounts of data into actionable insights.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada, Mexico, and the US except SF Bay Metros (CA), NYC Metro (NY), & Washington DC Metro. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage pricing analytics, forecasting average sales prices and discounting levels by product group, geography, and sales segment to provide a bridge between unit forecasts and revenue targets.
  • Generate and own financial cost reporting metrics such as hardware cash flow, projected spend, warranty expense, and excess & obsolescence risk in partnership with finance and accounting teams.
  • Synthesize data into actionable narratives and present findings to senior leadership across Operations, Finance, Sales, and Product.
  • Analyze customer and sales trends within product families, identifying areas of opportunity to drive revenue and margin improvement.
  • Use technical expertise to efficiently gather new data, automate data processing, and implement tools and best practices for data management.
  • Provide access to data & KPIs to rest of planning team using reports and dashboards, implementing business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker) for data visualization and analytics.
  • Establish a deep understanding of Samsara’s business, products, and company priorities to assist Demand Planners with insights on new programs / features, sales pacing, and conversion rates. Drive improvements to the forecasting process by developing rigorous analyses using historical data and in-depth knowledge of the business, changing the forecast model to meet business needs as required.
  • Identify key insights/trends driving company hardware cost; share findings with key stakeholders to identify areas of continued improvement to company growth and profitability.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Degree in a relevant analytical field (e.g. finance / economics / mathematics / computer science / data science).
  • 8+ years (or 6+ with Masters) of combined experience in finance, consulting, supply chain planning, demand planning, business planning, &/or data analytics.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify key drivers of topline and cost variances, and to clearly lay out assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to quickly synthesize information in a digestible format for a wide variety of stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure problems, focus on detail and accuracy, and ability to respond creatively with flexibility to issues.
  • Ability to define best practices for data collection processes, translate data into insights, and drive impact.
  • History of collaboration across technical & non-technical teams with strong relationship building skills.
  • Proven strategic business thinker who keeps the desired outcome in mind while driving results.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with financial planning & analysis (FP&A), supply chain finance, or financial reporting.

jobs.title: Founding Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: Osmind is a public benefit corporation advancing psychiatry through technology, services, and real-world evidence to bring innovative mental health treatments to patients in need.
jobs.description:
Osmind is a public benefit corporation advancing psychiatry through technology, services, and real-world evidence to bring innovative mental health treatments to patients in need. Osmind's psychiatry-tailored software and services, used by leading psychiatry practices across the U.S., help improve patient outcomes while driving practice success. Osmind's network of over 1000 clinics comprises the country's largest network of interventional psychiatry practices. Simultaneously, Osmind's clinic network, point-of-care software, and real-world data support life sciences companies in developing and scaling access to cutting-edge treatments. Osmind is a 50-person, Series B-stage company and has raised funding from top investors such as DFJ Growth, Y Combinator, and General Catalyst.

The Opportunity

We're hiring two Founding Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to build Osmind's outbound motion from the ground up. We're adding a proactive motion alongside the inbound demand we already see, and this is the team that will start those conversations. You'll report directly to our Director of Sales with no layer in between, and the approach you work out in the first few months becomes the playbook everyone after you runs on.

The clinics you'll reach out to treat people whose depression hasn't responded to conventional care, using interventional therapies like ketamine, Spravato, and TMS. Running one of these programs is operationally demanding, and clinics that struggle with the business side of it often can't grow, or stop offering the treatment altogether. When we help a clinic run that side of its practice well, more patients get access to care that works.

We're growing quickly, with strong market pull and a large opportunity ahead of us. The Account Executive path is the main one from here, and we hope and expect the first BDR Team Lead to come from this group rather than an outside hire. Our outbound runs on Unify, whose AI chat interface handles enrichment and sequence building, and we expect you in it daily from day one — automation carries the volume so your own time goes to the conversations that need a person.

What You'll Do

  • Own a list of target clinics. You'll know the treatments they offer, how they operate, and who actually makes decisions.
  • Research each account before you reach out, so your first sentence is about their situation rather than our software.
  • Spend real time on the phone. The conversations that move these clinics forward happen live rather than over email.
  • Respond fast when a clinic shows interest, whether that comes as a reply, a click, or a visit to our site.
  • Qualify honestly and verify what you're told. Passing a poor fit to an Account Executive costs the team more than a missed meeting.
  • Route each clinic to the right offering before handing it over — some want us to run the business side for them, others want the software on its own.
  • Own your outbound workflow in Unify. Enrichment, sequencing, and drafting are yours to run, and we want you pushing past the defaults rather than accepting them. This is a daily tool, not a bonus skill.
  • Help write the playbook. You're arriving before it exists, and what works for you becomes how we do this.

What We're Looking For

  • Ownership — this is new ground for us, so we need someone who will experiment and find a way through as we build the playbook together
  • Comfortable talking to people who weren't expecting to hear from you, without needing a warm introduction to start a conversation
  • Able to hold a real conversation about how a business makes and loses money, or ready to get there quickly
  • Treats whoever answers the phone as an ally rather than an obstacle — in a clinic, that person often decides whether the owner ever hears about us
  • AI-first instincts: you reach for it before doing something manually. Ideally you have built or configured an outreach or enrichment workflow yourself, in Unify, Outreach, Salesloft, Clay, or something similar, rather than only using one someone else set up
  • Writes clearly and persuasively. The first two lines of a cold email do the work, and we will look at your writing before we meet you
  • Coachable and wants to be — you'll work closely with the Director of Sales and get a great deal of it
  • No prior BDR experience required. We're looking for grit and creativity ahead of a track record

Bonus points

  • Experience in healthcare, medical billing, or working in a clinic
  • Exposure to mental health care, professionally or personally

About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is building the future of on-demand delivery and we are looking for a Senior Director of Global Operations to lead and build the operational engine that powers it at scale. Wing has recently announced plans to expand into eleven new major US metro areas: Memphis, New Orleans, Philadelphia, Phoenix, San Diego, the San Francisco Bay Area, Cincinnati, Los Angeles, Miami, St. Louis, Tampa and Salt Lake City. This growth is in addition to our existing drone delivery markets: Dallas-Fort Worth, Atlanta, Houston, Charlotte and Orlando. jobs.description:
EnergyHub is working to enable a carbon-free, distributed energy future by seamlessly integrating enormous numbers of energy devices with the electric power grid. Our platform coordinates and collects terabytes of data from what will soon be more than 1,000,000 distributed energy devices, such as thermostats, electric vehicles and home batteries.

Coordinating and evaluating the performance of all of these devices to forecast and estimate the delivered grid value requires state-of-the-art data science, control systems and machine learning. As such, EnergyHub seeks to hire an Energy Data Scientist to join EnergyHub’s Analytics Engineering team. As an Energy Data Scientist you will work closely with other data scientists and analytics engineers to improve the models used for evaluation of our control algorithms. You will collaborate with the Data Science and Power Systems Intelligence team to understand the algorithms and optimizations used in order to improve our performance evaluation and forecasting abilities. You will also contribute to our data management software systems and will become core to the foundation of a future with carbon-free and distributed energy.

What you will do:

  • You will drive the development of M&V methodologies and data science models for more accurate and transparent evaluation of our advanced grid services from fleets of distributed energy resources.
  • You will write production-level code, prototype new data products, and apply machine learning algorithms to energy IoT data
  • You will work to translate data from one of the largest distributed energy datasets in the electricity industry into actionable insights for electric utilities and other energy industry stakeholders
  • You will collaborate closely with stakeholders inside and outside of EnergyHub including Data Engineering, Client Success, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Market Development teams.
  • Other duties as assigned

Who you are:

  • You are passionate about enabling a carbon-free, distributed energy future
  • You thoroughly enjoy finding valuable insights in large, complex datasets
  • You have experience with Python and the scientific stack (pandas, numpy, scipy)
  • You have proficiency in SQL and understand good data modeling practices (basic ETL/ELT)
  • You have a practical comprehension of basic machine learning algorithms and are familiar with popular software packages such as Sklearn and Tensorflow.
  • You can explain results from large-scale data analyses to diverse audiences in a way that is clear, interesting and actionable
  • You can have fun while working on really hard problems with really smart people

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience with scaling data science products in the cloud (e.g., Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure)
