jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Customer Success Consultant – Strategic Accounts is a trusted advisor responsible for driving adoption, value realization, and long-term success for a focused portfolio of high-value strategic customers. These customers receive a more personalized and proactive level of service, including Strategic Review meetings every six months, collaborative Success Planning, and in-person engagements.

This role is ideal for professionals with a strong background in customer success, account management, or consulting, particularly those who thrive in high-touch, relationship-driven environments. You will work closely with strategic clients to align Granicus solutions with their evolving goals, ensuring they achieve measurable outcomes and remain long-term partners.

What Success Looks Like

You treat every customer interaction as a chance to learn something you didn't know — about their goals, their organization, their industry. You build intimacy with customers through proactive outreach, and you think ahead on their goals and how we can help them get there — often before they've had to ask. You're comfortable asking “why” past the first answer, and you're genuinely curious about how customers actually use the product, not just whether they say they're satisfied with it.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Essential Functions

    Strategic Customer Engagement

    • Serve as a dedicated strategic advisor to a smaller, high-impact book of business.
    • Conduct Strategic Review meetings every six months with each customer to assess progress, align on goals, and identify new opportunities.
    • Develop and maintain shared Success Plans that outline customer objectives, key milestones, and success metrics.
    • Build deep relationships through in-office visits, conference attendance, and tradeshow engagements as needed.

    Customer Success Management & Strategy

    • Act as the primary point of contact for strategic customers, ensuring a seamless experience across onboarding, adoption, and renewal.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to resolve issues and deliver value.
    • Analyze customer usage data and engagement metrics to inform proactive outreach and strategic recommendations.
    • Proactively surface risk and opportunity signals before they show up in a health score — through usage patterns, organizational changes, or conversations that go beyond the stated agenda.
    • Monitor customer health and implement mitigation strategies to reduce churn risk.

    Growth & Expansion

    • Identify and nurture expansion opportunities through consultative conversations and strategic planning.
    • Ask questions beyond the immediate request — the best expansion opportunities usually surface from understanding what the customer is trying to solve, not just what they explicitly asked for.
    • Partner with Sales to co-develop account growth strategies and support upsell/cross-sell initiatives.
    • Present tailored value propositions to executive stakeholders.
    • Ability/experience in ability to assist in RFP response process as well as to present in a finalist capacity to a customer

    Customer Advocacy & Experience

    • Champion the voice of the customer internally, advocating for product enhancements and service improvements.
    • Contribute to customer reference programs and success story development.
    • Stay current on Granicus product updates, industry trends, and best practices in customer success.

    Customer Success Operations

    • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM and customer success platforms.
    • Follow standardized processes while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
    Track and report on key performance indicators, including engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Requirements:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or consulting, preferably with strategic or enterprise clients.
  • Proven ability to manage executive relationships and lead strategic planning conversations.
  • Demonstrated track record of identifying and acting on opportunities without being prompted — able to give a specific example of surfacing an expansion, a risk, or a process improvement before someone else flagged it.
  • Genuine curiosity — comfortable asking “why” past the first answer, and interested in how customers actually use the product, not just whether they're satisfied with it.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and customer success tools.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for client meetings, conferences, and events.
  • Familiarity with public sector organizations is a plus.

AI Skills & Capabilities

Required level: AI-Fluent User (Foundational, Level 3). Actively and independently uses AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work — synthesizing account usage data ahead of Strategic Reviews, drafting and refining Success Plans, and preparing for customer conversations. Comfortable writing a clear, specific prompt and iterating on the output, and applies healthy judgment to verify AI-assisted work rather than taking it at face value.

  • Uses AI-assisted tools as part of normal account prep — not a novelty, a working habit.
  • Can identify where AI genuinely saves time on repetitive account work (data synthesis, drafting, summarization) versus where it doesn't fit.
  • Preferred, not required: experience building a repeatable AI-assisted workflow or template that others on the team have adopted (Power User level — Intermediate, Levels 4–5) — a plus for candidates who've gone beyond ad hoc use, but not a bar every candidate needs to clear.

Performance Metrics

  • Strategic Review completion rate and quality
  • Success Plan adoption and alignment with customer goals
  • Customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Retention and renewal rates
  • Product adoption and usage growth
  • Expansion revenue and opportunity identification
  • Ratio of rep-initiated to customer-initiated strategic conversations — a proxy for proactive vs. reactive engagement, measurable off existing cadence tracking.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 25% domestic (and potential international) travel for in-person client meetings, conferences, and strategic engagements.

About Us

If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

jobs.excerpt: OverviewAt SSOE, we do not just design buildings; we architect the backbone of the digital economy.
jobs.description:
Overview

At SSOE, we do not just design buildings; we architect the backbone of the digital economy. We are looking for a Senior Architect to lead our most technically sophisticated data center projects, driving the design of high-availability, power-dense environments for hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise clients. This role is for a specialist who thrives at the intersection of scalable modular infrastructure and mission-critical resilience. You will be the architectural anchor of a multidisciplinary team of experts to integrate complex cooling and power systems into seamless, sustainable designs. From steering Revit/BIM strategy to navigating ASHRAE and NFPA compliance, you will own the design lifecycle from schematic through construction. If you are ready to deliver the infrastructure that keeps the world connected, your next career milestone starts here.

AI and Innovation

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities

A Typical Day Might Include:

The following duties are typical of the position but are not all encompassing.

  • Lead the architectural design and technical documentation for large-scale data center projects, overseeing everything from site planning and core/shell to complex white space and support area configurations.
  • Develop comprehensive Basis of Design (BoD) documents, programming, and site-fit analyses that prioritize power density, tiered redundancy, and long-term modular expansion.
  • Function as a technical lead during milestone presentations and design charrettes, translating complex operational requirements into actionable architectural solutions.
  • Develop and maintain BIM models using Revit, coordinate across disciplines through federated models, and perform clash detection with Navisworks to minimize field issues and RFIs during construction.
  • Interpret and apply codes and standards including IBC, NFPA, TIA-942 data center standards, and local jurisdictional requirements to ensure regulatory compliance throughout design phases.
  • Lead cross‑discipline coordination with electrical, mechanical, process/piping, fire protection, structural, civil, and IT/telecom to eliminate clashes and ensure system operability.
  • Prepare and review construction documents, specifications, and detail drawings, ensuring completeness and technical accuracy for client review, approval, and permitting.
  • Conduct site walks/assessments and verify existing conditions influencing architectural planning and system placement to optimize scalability and modular growth potential.
  • Lead quality control reviews and validation of design deliverables, providing technical leadership and mentoring junior staff architects to elevate team competency.
  • Coordinate submittal reviews, respond to RFIs with technically precise clarifications, and manage timely package turnovers to meet project schedules.
  • Document and track design changes rigorously through formal change control processes to maintain alignment with client expectations and contractual obligations.
  • Integrate sustainable design principles where applicable, supporting LEED documentation and energy-efficient material selections to minimize environmental impact.

Qualifications

Qualifications You’ll Need on Day One:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture from an accredited program is required.
  • Licensed Architect with responsible charge authority; ability to obtain additional state registrations as project needs dictate.
  • Minimum of twelve years of professional architectural experience, with a majority specializing in mission-critical/data center data center facility design.
  • Deep understanding of scalable data center design principles including modular growth, tiered redundancy, and critical power and cooling infrastructure.
  • Thorough understanding of relevant codes and standards, including IBC, NFPA, and TIA-942 standards.
  • Strong technical communication skills, capable of effectively interfacing with clients, contractors, and internal discipline leads.
  • Experience mentoring junior architects and technical staff, driving professional development within integrated project teams.
  • Salary Range: $120,000 - $160,000/year depending on location, education, depth of relevant experience. Opportunity for ample rewards, leadership incentive/bonus program, and ownership investment opportunities.
  • Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure & certifications), and generous PTO & paid holidays.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have, But Not Required)

  • Direct exposure to hyperscale or colocation data center facilities and understanding of their unique design and operational demands.
  • Experience delivering LEED-certified projects, with familiarity in sustainable architectural materials and energy-saving design strategies.
  • Background supporting commissioning and startup phases of critical facility projects, including constructability reviews and coordination of system testing.
  • Awareness of project cost management and schedule constraints to balance design innovation with practical delivery imperatives.

jobs.description:
Overview

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

The Onboarding Inside Account Manager (OBIAM) is more than a sales training role—it's the launchpad for a successful career in enterprise technology sales. As an OIAM, you'll combine customer relationship management, consultative selling, and operational excellence while learning from experienced Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs).

In this hybrid role, you'll serve as both an Inside Account Manager (IAM) and Client Experience Specialist, helping new customers experience the best of Connection from day one. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives, manufacturers, distribution partners, and internal support teams to onboard customers, uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue growth, and deliver exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you're motivated by building relationships, solving business challenges, and developing a career in technology sales, this role offers hands-on experience, mentorship, and a clear path for growth.

What You'll Do

Create Exceptional First Impressions

You'll lead a world-class onboarding experience that helps new customers quickly realize the value of partnering with Connection.

  • Deliver a personalized, "white glove" onboarding experience for new enterprise clients.
  • Introduce customers to their dedicated Connection team and available resources.
  • Demonstrate our technology solutions, customer portal, reporting capabilities, and self-service tools.
  • Understand each customer's business priorities, challenges, and strategic initiatives.
  • Configure customer portals, standards, and purchasing workflows to align with business needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the very beginning.

Develop into a Trusted Sales Advisor

Working alongside experienced Enterprise Account Executives, you'll learn to identify opportunities, support sales initiatives, and contribute to business growth.

  • Support one or more Enterprise Account Executives with proactive sales activities.
  • Develop and manage customer quotes, including technically configured solutions.
  • Maintain a four-hour response goal for customer quote requests.
  • Register opportunities and manage deal registrations with manufacturer partners.
  • Follow up on active proposals and sales opportunities.
  • Identify cross-sell, upsell, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct spend analysis and proactively recommend new technology solutions.

Build Strong Customer Relationships

You'll become a trusted business partner by providing responsive service and strategic account support.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with customers, manufacturers, distributors, and internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple customer departments and decision-makers.
  • Help customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
  • Partner with customers on pricing strategies, standards management, and procurement optimization.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and proactive account recommendations.

Lead Operational Excellence

You'll coordinate the resources needed to deliver a seamless customer experience from quote through fulfillment.

  • Oversee daily account activity to ensure timely order processing and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Inside Sales Support to maintain order accuracy and meet shipment expectations.
  • Assist with pricing reviews, order escalations, and complex open-order management.
  • Support return merchandise authorization (RMA) escalations.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities remain accurate and up to date.
  • Analyze customer activity and prepare meaningful business reports.

Collaborate and Lead

As your knowledge grows, you'll become a key resource for both customers and teammates.

  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and manufacturer partners.
  • Mentor and guide Inside Sales Support Representatives on customer priorities.
  • Share best practices and contribute to team success.
  • Support new Enterprise Account Executives during onboarding by introducing company resources, sales processes, and operational tools.
  • Help accelerate new EAE productivity through coaching, collaboration, and ongoing support.

What Success Looks Like

Successful OIAMs:

  • Build lasting customer relationships based on trust and responsiveness.
  • Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience that drives customer confidence.
  • Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Meet or exceed sales, gross profit, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.
  • Continuously grow their sales, technical, and business knowledge.

Why Join Connection?

At Connection, you'll gain exposure to enterprise technology sales while working alongside experienced professionals who are invested in your success. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: About ManifestManifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.
jobs.description:
About Manifest

Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.

Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.

We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.

We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.

This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.

Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.

You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality.

You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.

You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.

You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.

What You'll Do

  • Own roadmap, prioritization, delivery, and product outcomes for one or more areas of Manifest
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their businesses, and the tours and activities industry
  • Lead discovery with customers, internal stakeholders, support teams, sales, customer success, and go-to-market partners
  • Translate customer problems, business goals, and operational complexity into clear product direction
  • Define product requirements, success metrics, release scope, and tradeoffs
  • Partner closely with engineering to shape pragmatic, high-quality solutions, and help sequence and drive delivery
  • Work closely with front-end engineers on user flows, interaction details, edge cases, and product polish
  • Use AI-assisted tools, lightweight prototypes, wireframes, diagrams, and sketches to clarify product ideas and reduce ambiguity
  • Help raise the bar for UX quality, including in areas without a dedicated Product Designer
  • Create clear product artifacts: problem statements, opportunity briefs, product specs, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and release notes
  • Balance customer value, business impact, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Communicate product direction clearly across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and leadership
  • Collaborate with Product leadership on strategy while taking ownership of day-to-day product execution

What We're Looking For

  • Significant Product Management experience, ideally in a B2B or B2B2C SaaS environment
  • A track record of owning roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for meaningful product areas
  • Strong product judgment: you can move from ambiguous problems to coherent product direction
  • Strong written communication and the ability to create clear, actionable product specs
  • A measurement-driven approach to product, defining success metrics up front and proving the impact of changes quantitatively
  • Fluency and enthusiasm for AI-assisted product work using tools like Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma, or FigJam to prototype, explore, and communicate ideas
  • A technical background, former engineering experience, or strong technical fluency; enough to understand the product deeply and partner closely with engineers on technically nuanced, UI-heavy areas
  • Comfort owning delivery and project execution on small teams alongside product vision
  • Experience leading discovery, evaluating opportunities, and making thoughtful tradeoffs
  • Strong UX instincts and an eye for product quality, usability, workflow design, and polish
  • Familiarity with modern front-end patterns, design systems, HTML, CSS, or component-based product development
  • Experience with complex workflows, operational tools, booking flows, ecommerce, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy SaaS products
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to undefined problems, including in zero-to-one / startup-mode environments
  • A pragmatic, collaborative operating style

Nice to Have

  • Experience in travel, tourism, activities, hospitality, reservations, ecommerce, or booking platforms
  • Experience working on developer-adjacent products or platforms
  • Experience in a scale-up environment where product, design, and engineering responsibilities are highly collaborative
  • A track record of using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or specification in a real production setting
  • Experience with analytics, experimentation, funnel optimization, SEO, or conversion-focused product work

How We Work

We move quickly, but we care about craft.

Manifest serves users with complex day-to-day workflows, so product quality matters. We care about whether the product makes sense, whether the workflow is intuitive, whether the edge cases are handled thoughtfully, and whether the experience feels modern and trustworthy.

We value product managers who are curious, direct, clear-thinking, and outcome-oriented. We are not looking for someone who simply collects requirements or manages tickets. We're looking for someone who can understand customer problems, shape direction, make tradeoffs, and partner with Engineering from ambiguity through delivery and iteration.


The salary range for this position is $130,000 - $170,000 CAD, commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: IT | OT Security Architekt (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus.
jobs.description:
Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen.

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit.

KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst.
  • du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst.
  • du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz.
  • du deine Expertise in SOC-Plattformen, Detection Engineering und Automatisierung ausbauen willst.

Aufgaben

  • Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsarchitekturen über IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme hinweg
  • Design sicherer Cloud- und Hybrid-Architekturen (Azure, AWS, GCP) inkl. Landing Zones, Identity- und Netzwerkdesign, Verschlüsselung und Security Baselines
  • Erstellung von Zielarchitekturen, Security-Roadmaps und Migrationspfaden – insbesondere für Cloud-Transformationen und Multi-Cloud-Szenarien
  • Durchführung von Threat Modeling, Architektur-Reviews und Risikoanalysen für Anwendungen, Netzwerke, Cloud-Workloads und Plattformen
  • Design von Netzwerk- und Perimetersicherheit inkl. Segmentierung, Firewalling und Zero Trust Network Access – On-Premises und in der Cloud
  • Konzeption von IAM- und PAM-Architekturen sowie von Kryptografie- und PKI-Konzepten, inkl. Cloud-nativer Identity- und Key-Management-Dienste
  • Bewertung und Absicherung von Cloud-Plattformdiensten, Container-/Kubernetes-Umgebungen und CI/CD-Pipelines (DevSecOps)
  • Definition von Security-Anforderungen an Projekte, Produkte, Cloud-Provider und Dienstleister
  • Übersetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) in technische Vorgaben und prüfbare Kontrollen
  • Fachliche Beratung von CISOs, Cloud-Teams, Architektur-Boards und technischen Entscheider:innen
  • Erstellung von Security-Konzepten, Richtlinien und technischen Dokumentationen
  • Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge in Discovery, Architektur-Reviews und Dokumentation – inklusive fachlicher Validierung und Freigabe der Ergebnisse

Qualifikation

  • Souveräner Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen im Beratungsalltag inkl. kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse
  • Ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Vertraulichkeit beim KI-Einsatz: Du weißt, welche Daten in welches System dürfen, und kennst die Risiken (Datenabfluss, Modelltraining, Prompt Injection)
  • Bereitschaft, Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich KI-basiert weiterzuentwickeln
  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in IT-/Cyber-Security, davon mehrere Jahre in Architektur- oder Beratungsrollen
  • Breites Technologieverständnis über Netzwerk, Endpoint, Identity, Applikation und Cloud
  • Erfahrung mit Zero-Trust- und Segmentierungskonzepten sowie IAM/PAM (Entra ID, Active Directory)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, SABSA/TOGAF
  • Kenntnisse in Kryptografie, PKI und sicherem Applikationsdesign
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von großem Vorteil:

  • Cloud-Architektur-Know-how: Design und Absicherung von Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS, GCP), Cloud-native Security-Dienste, Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Prompt Engineering, KI-Agenten oder LLM-Integration in Workflows
  • KI-Governance (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM)
  • Regulierte Umgebungen (KRITIS, Finanzsektor, Industrie/OT)
    Zertifizierungen (nice to have)
  • Cloud-Architektur- und Cloud-Security-Zertifizierungen
  • CCSP (ISC²) oder CCSK (Cloud Security Alliance)
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) und/oder Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional und/oder AWS Certified Security – Specialty
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect bzw. Professional Cloud Security Engineer
  • CISSP (ISC²)
  • CISSP-ISSAP (Architecture-Konzentration)
  • SABSA SCF (Security Architecture Framework)
  • TOGAF
  • CISM (ISACA) für den Governance-Anteil
  • OffSec OSCP

Benefits

  • Fixgehalt ab 80.000 € plus Gewinnbeteiligung bis zu 70.000 €
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Arbeit, 30 Tage Urlaub
  • IT-Equipment wie Apple MacBook
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Krankenversicherung, Shopping- und Mitarbeiterrabatte

Werde Teil von APT-ONE und mach Sicherheit zu deiner Mission!

jobs.title: Health Innovation Strategist / Senior Strategist
jobs.excerpt: THE POSITION:As a Strategist/ Senior Strategist within the EVERSANA INTOUCH Health Innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing global digital health go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for our life sciences clients and ecosystem partners.
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

As a Strategist/ Senior Strategist within the EVERSANA INTOUCH Health Innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing global digital health go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for our life sciences clients and ecosystem partners. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and report directly to the Senior Vice President of Health Innovation, working at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and real-world execution.

In this client-facing role, you will help shape the future of digitally enhanced healthcare, supporting the design, positioning, and scaling of innovations including digital therapeutics, digital companions, connected care and telemedicine solutions, AI-driven tools, XR applications, and combination products that integrate with pharmaceutical or medical device treatments.

You will be responsible for leading or supporting strategic projects across the full innovation lifecycle—from early-stage ideation and value proposition design to launch strategy, market access, and global deployment. The role requires a solid understanding of how digital health innovations are evaluated, launched, and adopted within pharma and medtech environments in Europe, and the ability to translate this into actionable, business-oriented strategies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams.

These results are achieved by:

STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & INNOVATION

  • Define and implement global go-to-market (GTM) and business model strategies for digital health assets—including, but not limited to, digital companions, digital medical devices, DTx, data platforms, and AI-driven tools.
  • Operate at the intersection of pharmaceutical commercialization and digital innovation, guiding clients and internal teams to unlock scalable value.
  • Lead or support projects across the full lifecycle of innovation: from ideation and opportunity scoping to GTM planning, regulatory approval, market access, and launch execution.
  • Grow and develop clients.

DIGITAL HEALTH GTM & COMMERCIALIZATION

  • Develop tailored commercialization and market launch strategies for digital health solutions globally and, especially in Europe, ensuring alignment with client brand, access, patient advocacy, medical, and portfolio priorities.
  • Translate regulatory requirements, user needs, and clinical evidence and market requirements into actionable roadmaps for commercialization.
  • Support Regulatory and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, reimbursement dossiers, and digital health procurement applications in collaboration with clients.
  • Bridge digital strategy with agency of record (AOR) operations, ensuring integration into broader brand planning, omnichannel campaigns, and field enablement efforts.

MARKET & LANDSCAPE INSIGHTS

  • Conduct robust market analysis, competitive landscaping, care pathway assessments, and technology scouting to identify strategic opportunities.
  • Leverage both qualitative and quantitative data to generate business insights and innovation strategies.
  • Stay informed on evolving regulatory and market trends to ensure compliant, forward-looking strategy development.

CLIENT LEADERSHIP & ENGAGEMENT

  • Act as a strategic partner to global and regional pharma and medtech clients, with a strong understanding of the pharmaceutical launch process and stakeholder dynamics.
  • Lead or co-lead client engagements, including strategic workshops, advisory boards, and innovation co-design sessions.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and partners.

PROJECT & TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Lead or support cross-functional delivery teams from planning to implementation, collaborating with and where appropriate coordinating internal resources across agency, data, technology, and regulatory functions.
  • Provide mentorship to junior strategists and contribute to building internal capabilities and delivery excellence. Collaborate effectively with senior leadership and support strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, pitches, client support and thought leadership.

COMMUNICATION & DELIVERABLES

  • Develop high-quality strategy presentations, business plans, and narrative deliverables in English (and optionally in Italian).
  • Communicate complex concepts with clarity and impact to diverse audiences including clients, KOLs, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support development of articles, policy summaries, or dissemination plans where needed.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Operate effectively within EVERSANA’s matrix structure, aligning strategy execution across teams and service lines.
  • Connect the Health Innovation team with EVERSANA’s broader capabilities—spanning commercial, medical, data, regulatory, and agency services—to drive integration and value.

INCLUSION, INTEGRITY, AND GROWTH

  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through inclusive leadership, collaboration, and continuous personal development.
  • Act with accountability and integrity, embracing our cultural values in all engagements.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel (not frequent: domestic and international)
  • Hours (minimum 40 hours per week)

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for digital health assets (e.g., digital therapeutics, digital companions, AI-driven platforms, hybrid drug-device combinations).
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic partner to pharmaceutical and health innovation clients, aligning digital initiatives with brand, medical, access, and portfolio objectives.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialization models, product lifecycle management, and launch planning across global and local contexts.
  • Experience leading client-facing strategy engagements and managing cross-functional delivery teams from planning through execution.
  • Ability to translate clinical evidence, regulatory and policy requirements, and user needs into actionable strategic roadmaps.
  • Ability to draft business and launch plans, implement commercialization roadmaps, review supporting evidence, and contribute to regulatory submissions, Health Technology Assessment (HTA) dossiers, reimbursement applications, and digital health procurement processes in collaboration with clients.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), and preferably also in Italy, with excellent communication and presentation skills for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to effectively engage and collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, including KOLs, clinicians, patient associations, and internal subject matter experts.
  • Skilled in preparing strategic narratives, business plans, and high-quality presentations in PowerPoint and narrative formats.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and creativity—able to work independently and drive outcomes in complex, dynamic environments.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a corporate, matrixed environment, managing multiple priorities with accountability and integrity.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant field, such as:
    • Advanced degree in Medicine, Public Health, Health Economics, Healthcare Management or related fields (e.g., MD, MPH, or MSc)
  • +5/7 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medtech, or digital health sectors—preferably in strategy, commercial operations, innovation, or launch excellence roles.
  • Proven experience working with or within life sciences companies on GTM strategies for digital innovations, medical devices, or connected care platforms.
  • Strong grasp of European healthcare systems, market access pathways, and digital health policy trends.
  • Familiarity with value demonstration, health economics, or evidence generation strategies is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with agency, data, technology, and AI teams to develop and implement integrated solutions.
  • Hands-on approach, with the ability to operate across both strategic design and implementation.
  • Experience authoring publications, white papers, or policy briefs is valued.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $135,000 and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. As one of the organization's senior security architects, this role will lead complex security architecture engagements across cloud, infrastructure, applications, data, and emerging technologies. The Staff Security Architect will influence enterprise technology strategy, establish security architecture standards and reusable design patterns, drive improvements to architecture review and threat modeling processes, and provide technical leadership across the Security Architecture function.

This position requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and exceptional communication skills. The successful candidate will regularly engage with senior technology leaders, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to balance security, risk, innovation, and operational effectiveness while helping mature Versant's overall cybersecurity architecture program.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following activities:

  • Lead security architecture engagements for complex enterprise initiatives, strategic programs, and high-impact technology implementations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering, infrastructure, cloud, data, and product teams throughout solution design and delivery.
  • Develop security architecture strategies, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and technical guidance that enable secure-by-design development across the enterprise.
  • Lead and facilitate advanced threat modeling exercises, architectural risk assessments, and security design reviews for critical business initiatives, translating identified risks into clear control requirements and actionable remediation outcomes.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and vendor solutions to determine security risks, architectural fit, and alignment with enterprise security strategy.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and technology leadership to integrate cybersecurity requirements into enterprise technology roadmaps and architectural governance.
  • Define pragmatic security controls and compensating measures that appropriately balance business objectives, operational requirements, and organizational risk tolerance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across one or more security domains, including cloud security, application security, identity, network security, data security, AI security, or zero trust architectures.
  • Mentor other security architects and cybersecurity professionals by providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and knowledge sharing, while serving as a technical reviewer for complex engagements.
  • Develop reusable documentation, security patterns, architecture decision records, and implementation guidance to improve engineering efficiency and consistency.
  • Stay current on evolving threat landscapes, industry trends, emerging technologies, and security best practices, translating them into actionable recommendations for Versant.
  • Present security architecture recommendations, technology risks, and strategic initiatives to technical leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across business and technology organizations to foster collaboration, trust, and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 5-8 years of progressive experience across cybersecurity disciplines, including security architecture, application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, governance, risk management, or security engineering.
  • Minimum 3 years designing enterprise security architectures for complex cloud-native, hybrid, or distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing enterprise security architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and security design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and security architecture methodologies.
  • Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform), including cloud-native security services and modern application architectures.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling using industry frameworks such as STRIDE, PASTA, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Threat Modeling, or similar methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps practices, CI/CD security, and application security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and penetration testing.
  • Experience designing security controls for modern architectures including APIs, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, serverless, identity platforms, and zero trust networks.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise security technologies including IAM, PAM, EDR, SIEM, network security, encryption, secrets management, PKI, and data protection technologies.
  • Experience interpreting and applying security and regulatory frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, SOX, and CIS Controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions without direct authority across multiple technology organizations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to evaluate business risk and recommend practical security solutions.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting technical concepts and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Experience simultaneously leading multiple strategic initiatives while effectively managing competing priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees are a plus.

DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GIAC, TOGAF, or equivalent.
  • Experience establishing or maturing enterprise security architecture programs.
  • Experience supporting digital media, streaming platforms, content production, broadcast operations, or other media and entertainment technologies.
  • Knowledge of modern identity architectures, Zero Trust, AI security, data security, and cloud-native security principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence organizational change through technical leadership, collaboration, and consensus building.
  • Passion for mentoring technical professionals and advancing security architecture best practices across the organization.

jobs.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
jobs.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Manager to lead and mature Fullscript's security compliance program. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for driving our governance, risk, and compliance strategy while directly managing a team of two GRC professionals.

You'll own our security compliance program across multiple frameworks, including SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, and HITRUST, ensuring we remain continuously audit-ready while scaling our controls alongside the business. You'll lead internal and external audits, partner closely with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Product, and IT, and help translate regulatory and customer requirements into practical, scalable security practices.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic program ownership with day-to-day execution and who thrives in highly collaborative, fast-growing SaaS environments.

What You'll Do

Governance & Compliance

  • Own and evolve Fullscript's Governance, Risk & Compliance program.

  • Maintain and continuously improve compliance across SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, and HITRUST.

  • Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.

  • Ensure compliance activities are embedded into operational processes rather than point-in-time exercises.

  • Track regulatory, contractual, and customer compliance obligations and ensure appropriate control coverage.

Audit & Assurance

  • Lead all external compliance audits, including planning, evidence collection, auditor coordination, issue resolution, and successful certification.

  • Manage internal control assessments and readiness activities throughout the year.

  • Coordinate remediation efforts across Engineering, IT, Security, and business teams.

  • Own relationships with external auditors and assessment firms.

  • Develop reporting and dashboards that communicate compliance posture and audit readiness to leadership.

Risk Management

  • Partner with Security leadership to mature enterprise security risk management.

  • Maintain risk registers and facilitate risk assessments across technology and business functions.

  • Drive remediation planning and track progress through completion.

  • Support third-party risk management activities as required.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong partnerships with Privacy and Legal to ensure alignment between security, regulatory, and privacy obligations.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and IT to operationalize security controls.

  • Support customer security reviews, due diligence requests, and compliance questionnaires.

  • Provide practical guidance that enables business growth while maintaining an appropriate risk posture.

Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of two GRC professionals.

  • Establish team priorities, operating cadence, and professional development plans.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

  • Remain actively involved in execution, serving as a working manager who contributes directly to audits, control implementation, and compliance initiatives.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance, Information Security, IT Audit, or Security Compliance.

  • Previous people management experience leading small, high-performing teams.

  • Hands-on experience owning enterprise compliance programs within SaaS or healthcare technology organizations.

  • Demonstrated success leading external audits for:

  • SOC 2 Type II

  • PCI DSS

  • HITRUST

  • Familiarity with HIPAA and its requirements.

  • Experience coordinating multiple concurrent compliance initiatives across engineering and business stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of security frameworks including NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and HITRUST.

  • Experience partnering closely with Privacy and Legal teams on regulatory compliance initiatives.

  • Experience managing control evidence, remediation programs, and continuous compliance activities.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex compliance requirements into practical business guidance.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or health technology experience.

  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, or similar.

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CISM, HITRUST CCSFP, PCI ISA/QSA, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

  • Experience supporting customer security reviews and enterprise sales due diligence.

Why This Role Matters

Trust is one of Fullscript's most important products. As our GRC Manager, you'll help ensure that our security and compliance programs scale alongside the business, enabling innovation while maintaining the confidence of our customers, partners, and regulators. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our compliance program, mentor a growing team, and influence security strategy across the organization.

What We Can Offer You

  • Generous PTO and competitive pay

  • Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health

  • Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program

  • Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives

  • Discount on Fullscript catalog of products

  • Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*

Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡

Compensation range
The salary range for this role is between $140,000 and $165,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to join our BASE Focus Area in the Marketplace Management Systems team, to work in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area is responsible for core platform capabilities that enable and evolve Wellhub’s business model, supporting both our current business and future growth opportunities.

In this role, you will lead key product initiatives across two strategic areas: Referral Program and Client Management. You will help evolve our referral program as a scalable growth channel, creating experiences that drive acquisition and engagement, while also building and improving the capabilities that enable a sustainable marketplace.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, design, engineering, operations, business stakeholders, and other product teams to deliver high-quality products that meet both Wellhub's goals and clients' needs.

If you are passionate about building products that make a difference in people’s lives and are excited about the opportunity to join a team that is directly connected to Wellhub's most important goals, to grow in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the development of tools aimed at simplifying and optimizing the way Wellhub offers its services to the market, sustainably increasing value to thousands of clients, millions of users, and partners around the world;
  • Lead the product requirements definition, actively collaborating with various cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions;
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by constantly evaluating and refining current products, processes, tools, and methodologies;
  • Lead the creation and execution of the product roadmap, aligning with business objectives and customer needs. Prioritize initiatives and maintain focus on high-impact features;

  • Familiarity with Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and the ability to run sprints, manage backlogs, and work iteratively is critical;

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Product Management and Product Lifecycle are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive, Toast Retail
jobs.excerpt: After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops.
jobs.description:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

Role Overview

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.

You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
  • Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
  • Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
  • Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
  • Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
  • Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
  • Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
  • Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
  • Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
  • Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
  • A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
  • Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
  • Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
  • A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
  • Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
  • Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
  • Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
  • Ability to travel 30% or more.

What will help you stand out

  • Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
  • Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
  • Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to complete complex RFPs, bonus if you’ve helped write a RFP for a prospect just starting their evaluation process
  • Experience helping stand up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket.
  • Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture.

jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Staff Software Engineer, DevOps
Location: Remote (US)
Reports to: Manager, DevOps

A quick snapshot…

As a Staff Software Engineer, DevOps at Conga, you will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and evolving the infrastructure, automation, and cloud platform capabilities that power Conga’s revenue lifecycle management solutions. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Operations teams to establish scalable DevOps practices, accelerate software delivery, and improve platform reliability across our global SaaS ecosystem.

This role goes beyond operational support. As a Staff-level engineer, you will influence architectural decisions, drive modernization initiatives, and champion best practices that improve developer productivity, system scalability, and operational excellence. You will be a trusted technical expert, helping teams navigate complex infrastructure challenges while advancing Conga’s cloud transformation strategy.

Why it’s a big deal…

DevOps is a critical pillar of Conga’s ability to deliver reliable, secure, and innovative solutions at scale. As our platform footprint continues to grow, maintaining deployment velocity while ensuring system resilience and security becomes increasingly important.

As a Staff Software Engineer, DevOps, you will help shape the future of our engineering platform by designing highly available cloud infrastructure, advancing automation capabilities, and enabling best-in-class development experiences. Your leadership and technical expertise will directly impact software quality, operational efficiency, and our ability to rapidly deliver customer value.

This is an opportunity to influence engineering practices across the organization while working alongside talented engineers focused on building world-class enterprise software solutions.

What you’ll lead…

DevOps Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a technical leader for DevOps initiatives across engineering teams.
  • Define architectural standards and best practices for infrastructure, deployment automation, and operational excellence.
  • Drive strategic initiatives that improve scalability, resiliency, and platform performance.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to engineers across the organization.

Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery

  • Design, implement, and optimize enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines that accelerate software delivery.
  • Establish automation strategies that improve deployment consistency, quality, and release velocity.
  • Partner with development teams to streamline build, test, deployment, and release processes.
  • Drive adoption of DevOps best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

Cloud Platform Engineering

  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available cloud environments across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Lead infrastructure modernization efforts using Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.
  • Develop scalable cloud-native solutions that support current and future business requirements.
  • Optimize platform performance, reliability, security, and operational costs.

Containerization & Kubernetes Enablement

  • Design and support enterprise-grade containerized environments utilizing Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Define deployment patterns and operational standards for Kubernetes-based workloads.
  • Lead initiatives focused on orchestration, scalability, observability, and platform automation.
  • Drive the adoption of cloud-native development and deployment practices.

Infrastructure Automation & Reliability

  • Develop Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using technologies such as Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Build automated solutions for provisioning, configuration management, compliance, and operational support.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response capabilities across cloud environments.
  • Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and reliability-focused engineering practices.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with Security teams to implement cloud security best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Design solutions that support encryption, identity management, access controls, and network security.
  • Lead efforts to strengthen platform resilience through disaster recovery and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Ensure infrastructure solutions align with security and governance standards.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

A proven track record…

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale cloud infrastructure and software delivery platforms.
  • Proven success leading complex DevOps, cloud modernization, or platform engineering initiatives within SaaS organizations.
  • Experience architecting highly available, fault-tolerant systems supporting mission-critical workloads.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy and drive engineering best practices across multiple teams.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of microservices architectures and cloud-native application design principles including SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, and multi-tenant platforms.
  • Advanced expertise with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure management.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks including Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Extensive knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and modern container orchestration technologies.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, routers, and network security.
  • Experience implementing cloud security frameworks, identity management, and compliance controls.
  • Working knowledge of software development technologies including .NET Core/.NET Framework, Java, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and solve complex infrastructure and application challenges.

Key Competencies

Technical Leadership

You influence engineering direction through deep expertise, sound architectural judgment, and a commitment to engineering excellence.

Cloud & Platform Architecture

You design scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions that support enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

Strategic Problem Solving

You approach complex technical challenges with a systems-thinking mindset and deliver sustainable long-term solutions.

Collaboration & Influence

You build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, and operations teams to drive alignment and achieve shared goals.

Operational Excellence

You are passionate about reliability, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.

Here’s what will give you an edge…

  • AWS, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, or other cloud platform certifications.
  • Experience architecting and operating large-scale Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience designing globally distributed, highly resilient cloud platforms.
  • Expertise with disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, including OAuth, WS-Security, encryption at rest, and encryption in transit.
  • Experience implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and observability frameworks.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments utilizing Atlassian Jira and modern DevOps toolchains.
