The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

  • Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
  • Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.
  • Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
  • Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
  • Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
  • Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.
  • Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

First 90 Days

  • Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.
  • Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.
  • Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.
  • Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

  • Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial workflows that improve efficiency and insight generation.
  • Strengthen forecasting, reserving, and bid processes through improved automation and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Successfully assume ownership of additional actuarial responsibilities, including reserve oversight and governance.
  • Establish a clear long-term organizational vision for the actuarial function.

Long Term

  • Build one of the industry's most modern actuarial organizations by combining deep actuarial science with AI-enabled decision support.
  • Improve forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and enterprise decision-making through advanced analytics and automation.
  • Develop a highly engaged, high-performing actuarial team that is recognized as a strategic partner across the organization.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
  • You have significant leadership experience in Medicare Advantage actuarial functions, including pricing, reserving, forecasting, and bid development.
  • You are an AI evangelist and have demonstrated experience deploying AI workflows across your functional areas. Moreover, you are enthusiastic about applying automation and modern tooling to fundamentally improve the actuarial function.
  • You have experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives that influence executive decision-making.
  • You are equally comfortable discussing actuarial methodology with technical experts and communicating business implications to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have a track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing actuarial teams.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can build, innovate, and shape the future of an organization.

Benefits Overview:

Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. Lyra is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Payer Enrollment Supervisor who thrives in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment and takes ownership of payer enrollment operations, provider participation, and enrollment program integrity. This role will lead and oversee payer enrollment activities with a strong focus on accuracy, timeliness, payer requirements, and maintaining continuous provider participation across contracted networks.

The Payer Enrollment Supervisor will be responsible for overseeing the full payer enrollment lifecycle, including initial enrollments, revalidations, re-credentialing-related enrollment activities, demographic updates, roster submissions, and payer maintenance. This individual will drive scalable processes, ensure enrollment readiness, and proactively identify and resolve issues that could impact provider participation or revenue cycle operations.

Balancing operational execution with program development, this role will supervise and support payer enrollment staff, serve as a subject matter expert on commercial payer enrollment requirements, and act as a key liaison between Enrollment, Credentialing, Contracting, Revenue Cycle, Billing, Provider Operations, and payer representatives to ensure providers are enrolled, active, and revenue-ready.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the end-to-end payer enrollment and maintenance lifecycle for individual and group providers, including initial enrollments, revalidations, re-credentialing-related enrollment activities, demographic updates, roster submissions, and other payer requirements, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.

  • Supervise, coach, and support payer enrollment staff through workload oversight, training, performance management, and quality review to ensure consistent and high-quality execution.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on commercial payer enrollment requirements and participation standards, providing guidance on complex enrollment matters and serving as an escalation point for payer, provider, and enrollment issues.

  • Oversee ongoing CAQH profile maintenance, including provider demographics, practice information, credentials, attestations, re-attestations, and supporting documentation; establish controls to monitor expirations and outstanding updates.

  • Monitor enrollment applications, payer statuses, rosters, and effective dates to proactively identify delays, discrepancies, and risks to provider participation or billing readiness, ensuring providers remain active with contracted payers.

  • Communicate directly with commercial payers to clarify requirements, resolve enrollment issues and discrepancies, address delays, and escalate complex matters as needed.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Credentialing, Contracting, Compliance, Legal, Provider Operations, Revenue Cycle, Billing, and other teams to ensure alignment across provider data, contracts, credentialing, enrollment, and billing readiness.

  • Maintain accurate and complete enrollment records and documentation across enrollment and provider data systems, ensuring data integrity and readiness for internal audits and compliance reviews.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve payer enrollment policies, procedures, workflows, and controls to support consistency, scalability, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  • Track and report enrollment metrics, turnaround times, application statuses, CAQH maintenance, and other key performance indicators; identify trends, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Lead process improvement and automation initiatives to reduce enrollment processing times, improve accuracy, enhance visibility, and strengthen the provider and internal stakeholder experience.

  • Stay current on payer requirements, CAQH processes, state and federal regulations, and industry best practices, partnering with leadership to proactively address changes and strengthen payer enrollment strategy and provider revenue readiness.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent work experience).

  • 4+ years of payer enrollment experience in a healthcare organization, medical group, health plan, hospital, CVO, or behavioral health setting.

  • 2+ years of experience in a lead or supervisory role preferred.

  • Proven ability to coach, manage accountability, and lead a team to maintain high standards of quality and timeliness.

  • Deep working knowledge of commercial payer enrollment processes,provider participation requirements, roster management, revalidations, and platforms including CAQH, NPPES, PECOS, payor portals, credentialing software, and ticketing systems (e.g., CredentialStream, Salesforce, Zendesk).

  • Strong understanding of how credentialing, contracting, enrollment, and revenue cycle operations interconnect, with a track record of scaling and improving operational workflows.

  • Highly detail-oriented self-starter who manages competing deadlines, drives process follow-through, and exercises sound judgement when resolving complex payor and provider escalations.

  • Exceptional analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across departments, service lines and leadership levels. Proven ability to build, improve, and scale operational processes.

Site Defense is responsible for protecting Reddit at internet scale—serving as the first line of defense against DDoS attacks, automated abuse, large-scale scraping, and other network-level threats. You will design and own the critical infrastructure that safeguards Reddit’s data from large scale attacks.

  • Partner closely within Infrastructure and with Security, and internal Safety teams to balance security, performance, and user experience

  • 7+ years of experience building and operating high throughput and low latency production distributed systems.

jobs.title: Lead Biostatistician
jobs.excerpt: Primary Function of PositionAs a senior technical leader within the Clinical Affairs department, the Lead Biostatistician (Biostatistician 5) sets the statistical vision and direction for the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical studies spanning early feasibility through pivotal pre-market trials and post-market evidence generation.
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

As a senior technical leader within the Clinical Affairs department, the Lead Biostatistician (Biostatistician 5) sets the statistical vision and direction for the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical studies spanning early feasibility through pivotal pre-market trials and post-market evidence generation. The Biostatistician 5 operates as a fully independent statistical leader and the recognized go-to statistical authority across Clinical Affairs and beyond, staying abreast of the latest developments in the field and translating them into impactful improvements for the team. This role owns multiple business or functional areas and a portfolio of ten or more concurrent projects, sets the programming and analysis standards the department works to, develops the training curricula, SOPs, and work instructions that build capability across all levels of the function, and represents Intuitive Biostatistics directly with regulatory agencies, principal investigators, key opinion leaders, and the broader scientific community. This is an individual contributor role carrying substantial technical and strategic leadership expectations without direct people-management responsibility.

Roles & Responsibilities

Study Design & Protocol Development: Independently strategize and develop the statistical approach for complex clinical protocols, including Bayesian and frequentist design selection, endpoint and estimand framing, hypothesis tests, power analyses, sample size justification, randomization design & review, and adaptive and/or interim analysis strategy. Serve as the final internal statistical authority for design decisions across owned studies and advise on design trade-offs at the program and platform level. Serves Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs, DSMBs) as the unblinded sponsor statistician.

Statistical Analysis Plans & Mock TLFs: Set the vision and direction for Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and mock Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) across the portfolio, defining the standards, templates, and degree of pre-specification for the department. Review and approve SAPs and mock TLFs authored by others against those standards, balancing flexibility and consistency across studies.

Data Analysis: Set the vision and direction for the analysis of clinical trial data, selecting and championing the methodology applied across studies and ensuring analyses are reproducible, defensible, and of a quality that withstands regulatory and peer review. Personally own the most complex or novel analytical problems in the portfolio, and direct interim analyses, database lock, and unblinding activities per study requirements.

Portfolio Management: Manage a portfolio of 10 or more projects simultaneously and take ownership of multiple business or functional areas, setting priorities, sequencing work, and allocating statistical effort across them.

Clinical Operations Roadmap: Serve as the Biostatistics representative and strategic partner in core team and program-level forums, shaping evidence generation strategy across surgical specialties and product platforms, setting execution roadmaps, managing timelines and stakeholder expectations.

Team Communication: Act as an influential voice across Clinical Operations and beyond, with a reputation as the go-to statistician. Influence senior leadership as a key strategic thought partner, distilling statistical complexity into clear, actionable direction with explicit clinical and business implications. Lead meetings and set agendas for the biostatistics team.

Scientific Literature & Evidence Generation: Write or edit the methods, results, and interpretation sections for a portfolio of studies with strategic guidance to support regulatory submissions, compliance documents, scientific journals, and medical conferences. Lead additional research as needed to generate clinical evidence, such as analyses of large clinical or administrative databases, systematic literature reviews, and meta-analyses. Stay abreast of the latest developments in biostatistical methodology and translate them into impactful improvements to how the team designs, analyzes, and reports. Independently contribute to the scientific community through peer-reviewed publication, conference presentation, and methodological contribution.

External Engagement: Conduct independent, direct interactions representing Intuitive Biostatistics with regulatory agencies, Principal Investigators (PIs), Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and external statisticians, including addressing regulatory authority questions on statistical design and analysis for pre-approval, post-approval, and post-market clinical follow-up studies. Sustain multiple external relationships and be regarded as a thought leader in the field.

Data Management Support: Co-strategize with Data Management to develop the direction for data quality, consistency, scalability, and traceability. Specify CDISC-aligned data structures (SDTM, ADaM) and establish analysis-ready dataset specifications.

Process Improvement & Departmental Standards: Set the vision for programming and analysis standards across the department, lead by example in own code and deliverables, and implement across the department. Develop and own SOPs and Work Instructions to drive standardization, validation, and quality control of analysis pipelines such that results meet rigorous standards for regulatory submission and scientific publication.

Mentorship & Capability Building: Set the training curriculum for the biostatistics team and deliver training on both biostatistics methodology and programming practice. Provide technical leadership and career-development guidance to statisticians at all junior levels, raising the technical ceiling of the department. Oversee and direct external statistical vendors and CROs.

Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all activities strictly adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 14155, ICH E9, ICH E6, and 21 CFR Part 812 regulations. Apply situationally relevant FDA guidances including adaptive designs and Bayesian methods for medical device trials.

Qualifications

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training

Minimum Degree: Master's (MS) or Ph.D. in Biostatistics or Statistics.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 9 years of experience with an MS, or 6 years with a Ph.D.

Clinical Trial Experience: Minimum of 5 years of clinical trial experience required.

Medical Device Experience: Minimum of 5 years of medical device experience required; surgical and robotic-assisted device clinical research strongly preferred.

Statistical Methods: Track record of developing and applying industry-leading, innovative, and integrative biostatistical methodology to problems that standard approaches do not solve. Depth expected across several of: adaptive and group-sequential designs, Bayesian methods, use of historical or external controls, survival and longitudinal modeling, hierarchical models, multiplicity control, missing data and sensitivity analysis, and analysis of large real-world datasets.

Programming: Mastery of R required; SAS and Python additionally valued. Demonstrated ability to set programming standards for a team, write clean, functional, modular, well-tested code in a shared development environment, and lead by example in code review and validation practice. Fluent in version control (Git) in a GxP validated environment for reproducible analyses ready for regulatory compliance audits.

AI-Enabled Productivity: Proven experience applying frontier AI models to dramatically expand the productivity of the biostatistician job function as a whole, beyond personal use. Candidates must be able to point to specific, verifiable examples of workflows they have re-engineered with frontier models, and to quantify the resulting gains in cycle time, throughput, or quality. The successful candidate will be expected to drive adoption across the biostatistics team by establishing the patterns, tooling, and human-in-the-loop verification controls that make AI-assisted work reliable, reproducible, and compliant in an international GxP environment.

Independence & Leadership: Fully independent operation with substantial leadership scope, including the ability to set direction for others, resolve ambiguity without escalation, and be held accountable for the technical quality of a multi-project portfolio.

External Reputation: Established reputation and multiple sustained relationships within the external scientific (biostatistics, medical devices, clinical trials) and regulatory community, with a record of independent contribution to that community.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills with technical and non-technical constituents, including senior leadership and external audiences. Strong scientific writing and editing skills, high attention to detail, and unwavering scientific integrity.

Logistics

Location: Remote OK. Preference will be given to candidates able to be onsite in Sunnyvale, California or willing to relocate.

Travel: Up to 10%.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target compensation ranges are listed.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Integration Consultant to support the implementation and delivery of technical integrations between enterprise systems and cloud-based business applications.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Integration Consultant to support the implementation and delivery of technical integrations between enterprise systems and cloud-based business applications.

In this role, you will work closely with clients and cross-functional consulting teams to understand business requirements, design integration solutions, and configure, test, and deploy integrations into production.

You will also contribute to technical discussions around integration architecture, application security, authentication, and enterprise integration best practices.

Location: Germany – Remote
Contract Type: Fixed-term contract (12 months)
Working Hours: 32 hours per week, with the possibility of up to 40 hours

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and analyze client business and technical requirements.

  • Design, configure, test, and deploy integration solutions.

  • Translate technical requirements into appropriate integration architectures and configurations.

  • Support integration testing, troubleshooting, and production deployment.

  • Collaborate with functional consultants, project managers, and client stakeholders throughout implementation projects.

  • Provide technical guidance on integration patterns, data transformation, security, and authentication.

  • Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to project leadership.

  • Ensure integrations meet client requirements and performance expectations.

  • Contribute to successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • An active Workday Integration Certification is mandatory. Candidates must be certified and ready to work on customer engagements.

  • At least 5 years of experience delivering complex enterprise business application projects.

  • At least 5 years of experience with integration technologies, including SOAP, REST, XML, XSLT, Java, .NET, backend web development, and web services.

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, data transformation, data transmission, and performance optimization.

  • German language proficiency suitable for client-facing communication.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with international teams.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25%.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with middleware technologies such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, SAP PI/PO, or similar platforms.

  • Knowledge of enterprise integration architecture and application security.

  • Previous experience in customer-facing consulting and enterprise implementation projects.

jobs.description:
About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

Net at Work is seeking a strategic and operationally strong Practice Director to lead and scale our Sage Intacct Practice. This is a senior leadership role responsible for the overall success of the practice, including strategy, delivery excellence, client outcomes, team leadership, operational performance, and profitable growth.

The Practice Director will partner closely with Executive Leadership, Sales, Solution Engineering, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance, and Alliances to strengthen Net at Work’s Sage Intacct market position and client delivery capabilities.

This role requires a leader who can operate strategically while remaining close to the business operationally — someone who understands consulting delivery, practice economics, ERP implementations, and how to build scalable teams and processes in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall strategy, direction, and growth of the Sage Intacct Practice.
  • Drive practice revenue, utilization, profitability, backlog management, and delivery performance.
  • Oversee staffing strategy, forecasting, capacity planning, and operational KPIs.
  • Ensure high-quality ERP implementations and strong client outcomes.
  • Partner with Consulting Managers and delivery leaders to support project execution and escalation management.
  • Improve operational processes, reporting visibility, and delivery governance.
  • Lead, coach, and develop consulting and delivery leadership teams.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, mentorship, and career development across the practice.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Solution Engineering on opportunity qualification and delivery alignment.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on go-to-market messaging and vertical positioning.
  • Maintain strong relationships with Sage, strategic partners, and executive stakeholders.

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in ERP consulting, professional services, technology advisory, or practice leadership.
  • Experience leading ERP consulting or implementation teams within a professional services environment.
  • Strong understanding of delivery operations, utilization management, project margin, staffing models, and consulting economics.
  • Experience with Sage Intacct or comparable cloud ERP/financial systems platforms preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong executive communication, client management, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.

Preferred Background

  • Sage Intacct consulting or partner ecosystem experience.
  • Mid-market ERP consulting environment.
  • Experience building scalable consulting practices and operational processes.
  • Experience working with CFOs, Controllers, COOs, and executive stakeholders.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Values

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
  • Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

Compensation and Benefits

This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. 

We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

The compensation and benefits information is accurate of the date of this posting and subject to plan eligibility. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Integraatioala sopii osaajalle, jolla on vahva looginen päättelykyky, kyky hallita kokonaisuuksia sekä kiinnostusta siihen, miten yhteiskunta ja eri organisaatiot toimivat prosessien tasolla.” -Lauri, Integration Architect.

➡️ Tutustu rooliin lisää blogistamme.

🏆 Tarjoamme

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • kokemusta järjestelmäintegraatioista ja ainakin yhdestä integraatioalustasta.

  • kokemusta relaatiotietokantojen työstämisestä SQL:llä.

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

🧐 Frendszone

Erikoisuutenamme on oma, suomalainen integraatioalustamme Frends iPaaS, jota käytämme useimmissa projekteissamme. Frends on hybridi, low-code alusta, joka pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä. Palvelemme monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla, joten projektit vaihtelevat sekä sisällöltään, kestoltaan että toimialaltaan.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset oppimaan.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Arkeemme pääset sukeltamaan täältä.

FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Tutustu myös blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

  • Vanhat järjestelmät vanhenisivat ennen aikojaan, jos niiden päälle ei integraatiokeinoin pystyttäisi rakentamaan moderneja käyttöliittymiä.

  • Raha ei liikkuisi. Ihmiset jonottaisivat pankkikonttoreissa maksamassa laskuja ja nostamassa rahaa.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.

Requirements

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

Highlights

Build next-generation AI agents using C#, Azure, MCP and Azure OpenAI. Join AnywhereNow's Agent Factory team to create enterprise AI solutions that move from concept to production.

As a Senior Architect, you lead architecture and technical strategy for enterprise-scale Azure programs. You guide delivery teams, shape modernization approaches, and ensure that architectural decisions enable business transformation. At this level, your focus expands beyond a single domain to include collaboration across related disciplines. You build credibility through delivery excellence, technical leadership, and the ability to influence architecture strategy across projects and practices.
You balance deep technical expertise with growing cross-domain awareness, mentoring architects and engineers, promoting reusable frameworks, and contributing to presales and modernization initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture and technical strategy for enterprise-scale Azure modernization and transformation programs.

Expertise

At this level, Senior Architects demonstrate deep expertise in one primary domain while developing fluency across adjacent areas. They apply their technical mastery to shape delivery success, reusable frameworks, and modernization strategies that align with business outcomes.

Application Innovation

Cloud Platform

Data & AI

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Why PermitFlow Wants You

This role is foundational. You’ll help shape PermitFlow’s enterprise motion—working directly with the VP of Sales, CEO, and other leaders to build the playbook that wins at the highest levels of construction-tech.

We’re seeking a proven closer with 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, ideally in construction-tech or adjacent industries (PropTech, InsurTech, Field Service software). You thrive in complex, multi-stakeholder deals ($1M+ in scope), and you’re motivated by both the mission and the career upside of joining a company at this stage.

You’ll:

  • Acquire net new enterprise logos

  • Expand within existing roll-up and national accounts

  • Convert pilots into multi-division and enterprise-wide partnerships

This is a high-stakes, high-upside opportunity in a massive and fragmented market.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts—prospecting, discovery, business case development, negotiation, and close

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded deals with executives, operators, and procurement across multiple business units

  • Develop and execute account strategies for net new, expansion, and PE roll-up accounts

  • Build ROI-driven business cases that resonate with C-suite and board-level stakeholders

  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Solutions, CS, Product, Marketing, SDR) to scope solutions and ensure successful outcomes

  • Maintain forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and deal visibility throughout long sales cycles

  • Provide insights to GTM and Product leadership to shape our enterprise motion and roadmap

  • Travel as needed for customer meetings, conferences (e.g. Pantheon), and roll-up HQ visits

Who You Are

  • Industry Knowledge: Construction-tech experience strongly preferred; experience with home services contractors, GCs, or developers a plus

  • Strategic Seller: Skilled at navigating executive relationships, procurement, and multi-division rollouts

  • Problem-Solver & Storyteller: Capable of surfacing operational pain points and building compelling, ROI-backed business cases

  • Builder Mentality: Excited to join a high-growth startup in build mode, helping define the enterprise GTM playbook from the ground up

  • Mission-Driven: Energized by transforming how infrastructure gets built and scaling technology in one of the largest industries in the world

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Closing multi-stakeholder, enterprise-level deals with long sales cycles

  • Driving both new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts

  • Building repeatable, scalable sales processes that inform PermitFlow’s enterprise motion

  • Strength of executive relationships and ability to navigate PE roll-up strategies

jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

At Mercer Advisors, our purpose is to amplify and simplify our clients’ financial lives through a fully integrated family office offering. We bring together fiduciary professionals across disciplines to do the best work of their careers—as one unified team committed to doing what’s right for clients. We continue to reinvest in our people and platform so that our growth creates more opportunities for teammates and more value for clients.

Regis is Mercer Advisors’ offer designed for ultra-high net worth families with complex, multi-generational wealth. Regis clients often have the means to build their own family office, and they require a deeply integrated wealth management experience with the highest level of service, coordination, and sophistication. We are a team of world-class fiduciary professionals delivering holistic advice across investments, financial planning, estate strategy, tax strategy, and more with the aim of making every client feel like our only client.

We are seeking an exceptional Tax Partner - Regis - to serve as the lead tax advisor, strategist, and subject matter expert for our Regis families. You will lead engagements alongside senior wealth advisors and other Regis team members, with direct accountability for the tax outcomes and experience of our most complex families. This is not a support or review role—you will bring the credibility, judgment, and gravitas that UHNW families expect from their most trusted advisors.

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

  • Serve as the lead tax advisor and primary point of accountability for a select group of Regis families, maintaining and growing a book of clients with balance sheets that often exceed +$100M.
  • Build practical, year-round, and multi-year tax strategies tailored to each family’s goals, ownership structures, businesses, trusts, investments, charitable activities, and succession plans.
  • Lead and develop a select team of UHNW-focused tax professionals supporting Regis engagements, overseeing staffing, engagement economics, billing, and service quality.
  • Identify planning opportunities and risks arising from business transactions, concentrated positions, real estate, carried interests, equity compensation, major charitable gifts, residency changes, and cross-border exposure (foreign trusts, PFICs, GILTI, FATCA/FBAR) bringing in specialists when the issue calls for deeper expertise.
  • Oversee tax compliance at a level appropriate to each engagement: directly, when Mercer prepares the returns, or through active review and coordination when a family’s own CPA firm or internal tax team handles preparation.
  • Lead the response to significant federal and state tax notices, examinations, and controversy matters, coordinating with counsel and other specialists through resolution.
  • Partners with Regis wealth advisors and Mercer’s broader team — estate planning, investments, financial planning, and family office services — so tax advice is fully integrated with each family’s overall plan.
  • When relevant, collaborate and coordinate the tax calendar / division of responsibilities with the families outside CPAs, attorneys, trustees, investment bankers, valuation professionals, controllers, and other advisors
  • Support new client development through prospective client meetings and partner with Regis leadership to evolve the tax service model, team, and technology.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • CPA license required; advanced degree in taxation (MST/LL.M.), law degree, or comparable technical credential strongly preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive tax experience, with the majority spent advising clients with balance sheets of $25M or greater; meaningful experience with $100M+ families required.
  • Deep technical command of individual, fiduciary, partnership, corporate, estate, gift, and state and local taxation, including advanced planning strategies commonly used by ultra-high net worth families.
  • Experience identifying cross-border tax and reporting issues and working effectively with international tax specialists; direct technical expertise in every international area is not required.
  • Experience managing significant tax notices, examinations, and controversy matters, including coordination with tax counsel.
  • Meaningful experience advising entrepreneurs, business owners, executives, and multi-generational families through liquidity events, business succession, wealth transfer, and other significant transactions.
  • Ability to analyze complex facts, focus on what matters, and deliver clear, practical recommendations — with excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain sophisticated tax matters in plain language.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing tax professionals and build a culture of accountability and technical excellence.
  • Comfort operating in a team-based, integrated advisory environment within a regulated RIA structure; experience at a family office, multi-family office, wealth management firm, or national accounting firm strongly preferred.
  • Unquestioned integrity and a strong commitment to confidentiality, sound risk management, and putting the client’s interests first.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Work Schedule:

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

Working Conditions:

This position may be in a professional office environment or a dedicated home office workspace which is free of interruptions. Whether position is in a dedicated office space or home office workspace, basic technology needs will be provided to satisfy position requirements. Routinely sitting and standing for periods of time. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

Application Deadline: The initial deadline for applications is 9/14/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

The annualized compensation range for this role is based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skillset, and geographic location where work is performed. The cash compensation range includes both base salary and an annual bonus. The total compensation package may include additional cash bonus amounts and other incentive compensation.

Total expected cash compensation range
$250,000—$400,000 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

  • Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance
  • Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.
  • Kaiser Medical plans available in California
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.
  • Two comprehensive Dental Plans

  • Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.
  • 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.
  • Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days
  • Employee Assistance Plan
  • Family Medical Leave

  • Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.

  • Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life’s challenges and more.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option
  • Pet Insurance
  • Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

Job Title: Director, Gross-to-Net

Job Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Principal, Market Access Technology & Solutions, Gross to Net Services Lead

Company & Team Overview


Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA - the Human Data Science Company™, offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.


The IQVIA Market Access Technology & Solutions team is a market-leading technology-enabled services division within IQVIA, that helps manufacturers in the US pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. With offerings across systems integration partnerships and services, and managed business process outsourcing services, and analytics, we create value for our clients by advising and partnering with them on execution of key operational initiatives in today’s challenging landscape.


Position Overview

This Principal-level leader within IQVIA Market Access Technology & Solutions – Managed Services / Business Process Outsourcing team, leads cross-functional, distributed teams to provide advisory services and deliver exceptional gross-to-net (GTN) close and forecast services to US pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. The role combines GTN forecast and accrual model creation and management, balance sheet reserve management, cross-functional stakeholder management, project management for implementations of IQVIA's proprietary GTN application and transitions into steady state, and active support of business development and practice growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as principal owner of client delivery with ultimate responsibility for client satisfaction and delivers high levels of quality/added value, and provides follow-up with client after project deliverable have been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Utilizes quantitative and analytical skills and experience working with datasets related to Demand, Ex-factory Sales, Inventory, Chargebacks, Rebates, Patient Assistance Programs to create Gross-to-Net models for forecasting (Long Range, Latest Estimate, Rolling, etc.) and accruals management
  • Support client’s FP&A and Accounting organizations’ expectations for Gross-to-Net Close, Balance Sheet Reserve and Forecast processing cycles
  • Manages projects related to implementation of IQVIA's proprietary GTN application and transition to steady state ongoing operations
  • Provides direction, advice and intellectual leadership to clients and delivery teams.
  • Provides high level input to, and ensures the development of, client deliverables in agreed-upon SLAs.
  • Leads thought leadership and firm building initiatives.
  • Remains current on industry, client and competitive trends and directions in order to anticipate and identify new business challenges and issues at assigned clients.
  • Mentors, coaches and shares subject matter expertise with others to help develop individuals and our capabilities to deliver world-class solutions for clients.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience in consulting, or pharmaceutical industries with evidence of career progression
  • Strong academic track record including minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and an MBA or relevant graduate degree (desired but not a requirement)
  • Extensive experience in the life sciences industry with strong conceptual understanding of pharmaceutical supply chain and distribution channels, purchase-based and utilization-based contracting, and regulatory compliance, including government programs and pricing
  • Experience advising and supporting Clinical stage / pre-Commercial clients with GTN launch readiness activities for products that covered by pharmacy benefit and medical benefit, with various route of administration.
  • Working understanding of GAAP principles related to revenue recognition and gross-to-net accounting practices (CPA designation, even if inactive is preferred)
  • Ability to support client’s FP&A and Accounting organizations’ expectations for Gross-to-Net Close and Forecast processing cycles, which may include weekend and holiday hours to support SLAs
  • Working understanding of and willingness to keep current knowledge about regulatory impacts to pricing, contracting, market access to support conversations with client’s market access teams
  • Extensive experience working with datasets related to Demand, Ex-factory Sales, Inventory, Chargebacks, Rebates, Patient Assistance Programs
  • Extensive experience creating models for Gross-to-Net forecasting (Long Range, Latest Estimate, Rolling, etc.) and accruals and balance Sheet reserve management
  • Experience creating pre-deal and cross-channel pricing models with scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis capabilities
  • Strong quantitative skillset with experience working in Excel, PowerBI or other similar toolsets
  • Strong analytical skillset supported by utilizing SQL to analyze large datasets
  • A track record of leadership and people development
  • Strong project planning, time management, and organizational skills
  • Strong understanding of hands-on project management experience utilizing waterfall, agile and hybrid approaches
  • Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) supporting configuration, integration, data conversion, testing, deployment, and operational readiness workstreams for ERP / financial systems, GTN platforms, Revenue Management platforms, and systems integrations
  • Experience leading distributed teams within the United States and in global/regional hubs external to the United States
  • A willingness and ability to travel as needed

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
  2. Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
  3. Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
  4. Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
  5. Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
  6. Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
  7. Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
  3. Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

"Integraatiopuolella rajapinnat ja teknologiat kehittyvät ja muuttuvat jatkuvasti, eli meillä saa koko ajan tutkia ja oppia uutta. Täällä näkee myös hyvin mielenkiintoisesta näkökulmasta oman integraatioalustamme kehittymistä.” -Jura, Integration Developer.

➡️ Tutustu lisää blogeistamme Integraatiokehittäjän työhön ja kenelle työ sopii.

🏆 Tarjoamme

  • kilpailukykyisen palkan riippuen kokemuksestasi 55-69K

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • oman, kehittyvän integraatioalustan Frendsin, joka on saanut tunnustusta kansainvälisessä Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ -tutkimuksessa

  • joustavat työajat ja lokaation, etänäkin hommat hoituu

  • työnantajan joka tukee erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa

  • tukea antavan esihenkilön ja oman tiimin

  • turvallisen ja vakaan työpaikan

  • kattavat työsuhde-edut (mm. laaja työterveyshuolto ja sairaskuluvakuutus, koulutusmahdollisuuksia, sertejä, lounasetu, virikesetelit, kulttuuri- ja liikuntakerho, kuntosali, hieronta)

💻 Teknologiat

Erikoisuutenamme on oma integraatioalustamme Frends, jota käytämme useimmiten projekteissamme. Frends on täysin suomalainen low-code, hybridi-integraatioalusta. Tuotteen tuoreimmassa inkarnaatiossa käytetään moderneja teknologioita ja pilvipalveluita. Frends on pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä.

➡️ Lue, millaista Frendsillä on tehdä kehitystyötäblogistamme ja katso myös lyhyt demo-video. Voit myös tutustua Frendsiin lisää tuotteemme dokumentaatio-sivuilta.

Töissämme pääset tutustumaan myös Azuren eri teknologioihin kuten Machine Learning ja Data Factory. Taikasanoja työssä menestymiseen ovat REST, JSON, XML, XSLT ja SQL. Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset myös oppimaan.

🧐 Frendszone

Lyhyesti kuvattuna, olemme IT-konsulttitalo ja palvelemme hyvin monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Osa kehittäjistä on keskittynyt täysin kehitystyöhön, osa tekee tämän lisäksi esimerkiksi määrittelyä, kouluttamista tai myynnin tukea. Kuuntelemme tekijöitämme ja pyrimme muokkaamaan roolia ja urapolkua jokaiselle mieluisaksi.

➡️FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arjestamme voit myös lukea lisää täältä. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Tutustu blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

⭐ Miten edetään?

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

  • Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

  • Vanhat järjestelmät vanhenisivat ennen aikojaan, jos niiden päälle ei integraatiokeinoin pystyttäisi rakentamaan moderneja käyttöliittymiä.

  • Raha ei liikkuisi. Ihmiset jonottaisivat pankkikonttoreissa maksamassa laskuja ja nostamassa rahaa.

About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

Company Name: S&P Global Inc.

Job Title: Lead, Information Security

Location: 55 Water Street, New York, NY 10041 (Telecommuting permitted from anywhere within the U.S.)


Job Duties: S&P Global Inc. seeks a Lead, Information Security who will perform security analysis and communicating vulnerabilities identified in web applications with stakeholders, developers, and senior management. Provide scoping data to assist in developing project proposals. Create detailed assessment reports describing identified security weaknesses, potential business risks, and prioritizes mitigation recommendations. Develop improved methodologies, processes, infrastructure, tools, and deliverables that contribute to the ongoing enhancement of vulnerability assessment capabilities. Gather requirements from Business Analysts and Application Owners. Incorporate and define security requirements, map security requirements and define the data flow diagrams, and deliver threat models in the design phase. Provide strategic direction and tactical oversight for major security projects, including penetration tests, patch management, change control, application security, and infrastructure security. Perform application security assessments for native, web, and hybrid applications using open source and commercial tools. Report key metrics to executive management and reporting on the health of applications and infrastructure components, interacting with application owners and product engineering team to share the assessment results.


Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related IT field plus 5 years of experience in the job offered or related occupation. 5 years of experience must include: Utilizing enterprise-grade Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools, including Fortify, to tune rulesets, integrate SAST into complex pipelines, and interpret false positives with accuracy. Using Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools, including Burp Suite Pro and OWASP Zap, to review black-box and gray-box testing efforts, including logic flaw exploitation. Managing open-source risk across large codebases, using Mend to perform Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and conducting manual code reviews across multiple programming languages, including Java, Python, C# and either JavaScript or Node.js. Conducting formal threat modeling using frameworks, including STRIDE, PASTA, or MITRE framework, and integrating threat modeling into architectural and design phases of the SDLC. Building, scaling, and managing secure SDLC programs in large organizations, including embedding security into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps. Applying or mapping application security controls to regulations, including DORA, ISO/IEC 27034, NIST 800-53 / SSDF, and SOC 2 Type II and performing remediation efforts or assessments tied to audits and regulatory reviews. Application security across distributed product teams, including managing security for hundreds of applications across varied stacks and creating centralized risk dashboards using ServiceNow or similar platforms. Scoping, coordinating, and validating results from external/internal pentests and translating test findings into actionable development tasks, prioritizing remediation based on risk. Securing applications in multi-cloud environments, including AWS (IAM, Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda) and Azure (App Services, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud), as well as integrating application security tooling and controls within cloud-native CI/CD workflows.


***Telecommuting permitted from anywhere within the U.S.


Employer will accept a foreign Bachelor’s degree or any other combination of degrees, diplomas or professional credentials and/or experience determined to be equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree by a qualified evaluation service.
