jobs.title: Principal Presales Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Principal Presales Engineer on Twilio’s New Business Communication team!

About the job

This position is needed to enable our customers to build the future of communications. The Twilio Principal Presales Engineer role is a critical part of the sales team, responsible for delivering the technical win for customer accounts. They lead the technical pre-sales relationship, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipates concerns, and offers creative solutions. They build customer trust in Twilio solutions.

Principal Presales Engineers should be comfortable engaging a CEO or sketching out an API flow on a whiteboard with customer software engineers.

As a Principal Presales Engineer, you will be fully autonomous. You will be capable of driving the technical side of all but the most complex opportunities independently. Furthermore, you will provide leadership and deal support within the Solutions Engineer organization, driving the design and execution of medium to large projects with feedback from other engineers, participating in architectural decisions on the team, and coordinating with other Twilio teams such as product.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with Account Executives to execute pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concept, RFP, design documentation, technical presentations and enablement sessions
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to uncover their needs and difficulties, demonstrating our capability to facilitate their success and address their challenges effectively
  • Build and present powerful and complex presentations and product demos to help showcase the capabilities of Twilio Communications Products
  • Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to our customers, introducing innovative solutions and architectures that catalyze and propel innovation
  • Contribute to the broader Solutions Engineering community through knowledge sharing, constructing demonstration materials, and creating reusable presentations

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Minimum of 8 years in a solutions engineering (presales) role, specializing in the sale of complex technical products, or 10+ years of professional experience supporting technical products, along with customer-facing experience, particularly in delivery or consulting.
  • Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain audience confidence
  • An engaging storyteller - you can gain audience confidence and communicate complex topics to multiple levels of audience.
  • Ability to build a deep understanding of a customer’s communications needs and guide them to a technical solution
  • Customer focused problem solver, adept at striking the balance between crafting innovative technical solutions and prioritizing the customer's best interests.
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, and ability to handle competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Previous software development experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP)
    • Web development (JavaScript, HTML/CSS, frontend frameworks - React, Vue.js, Angular)
    • Building with REST APIs
  • Bachelors and/or Masters degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science,) or equivalent practical experiences

Desired:

  • Experience with new business accounts and evangelizing new use cases and technology
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and cloud application architecture.
  • Previous experience in Telecom, SIP, Contact Center, or Security
  • Experience with sales methodologies

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or the surrounding areas of San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, or San Jose, CA

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $138,872.00- $173,590.00.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $146,592.00 - $183,240.00.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $154,304.00 - $192,880.00.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 19, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Clovr Labs is recruiting a Software Engineer to work on new and interesting projects.
Let's give you some context on who we're looking for and what to expect when you join the team.
👋 About us

Clovr Labs is a boutique consulting firm working at the intersection of cybersecurity, Bitcoin, and lean product development. We care deeply about building simple, elegant solutions to complex problems and believe in iterating quickly to uncover the best ideas.

We’re developing a range of products across several cutting-edge technology domains, including Bitcoin and the Lightning Network, powering instant, low-cost payments at scale. One of our flagship products is, an enterprise-grade payment service provider built on the Lightning Network.

🧩 Your role

We’re looking for engineers who are curious, driven, and excited about creating high-quality software.

As a Payments Software Engineer at Clovr Labs, you will:

  • Help evolve and expand our existing products and internal systems.

  • Work closely with a motivated and collaborative team to build new automation and infrastructure solutions.

  • Design and deliver product features that bring real value to our clients.

  • Dive into the details, polish the experiences you build, and take pride in high craftsmanship.

🎬 What do we expect from you?

  • Business mindset: you understand the business goals behind your work and choose technology that serves those goals and delivers value for customers and the company. You seek user feedback and iterate quickly based on real-world insights.

  • Strong sense of ownership: you understand the problem, find or build the right solution, and take responsibility for delivering it to production and ensuring it works reliably.

  • Strong security mindset: you proactively assess risks, anticipate threats and failure scenarios, and design and code defensively to protect our customers.

  • Experience with production systems: you are comfortable operating live services and use logs, metrics, and traces to understand system behavior, detect issues early, and resolve them effectively.

  • Correctness and financial integrity: you design for idempotency, data consistency, and precise monetary calculations, handle retries, concurrency, and partial failures safely, ensuring every transaction is traceable and can be reconciled.

  • Adaptability: you stay committed and flexible as priorities change, adjusting your approach as new information emerges.

  • Teamwork makes the dream work: you are a strong team player and believe that a team together can ship great things. you work closely with others, challenge ideas respectfully, welcome being challenged, and take shared responsibility for the team’s success.

  • AI-powered engineering: you use AI as a core part of your workflow to understand problems, explore solutions, and accelerate delivery, applying engineering judgment to validate its output and taking ownership of the results.

  • English proficiency is helpful; understanding Spanish is a nice plus.

🛠 Key roles

  • You will join a small team currently scaling up. We are passionate about it and we are not trying to hide it.

  • We expect you to bring your experience in implementing best practices to our team such as pair programming, continuous deployment, tech debt management.

  • A key part of our duties is to dedicate time to non-business requirements of the systems we are working on, such as cost, maintainability, scalability, and security.

  • Self learning is an expectation. You will be provided with enough time and resources to learn new stuff and to become a better developer.

  • You should have a cost-benefit analysis mindset and use logical reasoning to address the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions.

🎏 It's nice to have

  • Have a technical interest in Blockchain concepts, specially Bitcoin and the Lightning Network. Also in payments processors and understanding how these systems operate in practice.

  • Special interest and high understanding of modern cloud-native software solutions, with special focus on observability, security and performance.

  • Experience building software applications with a combination of Go and C# or can easily adapt to using these languages.

  • Interest in Open Source Software (OSS), we highly value contributions to Open Source Software. Many of our main components are OSS, and we take pride in contributing back to other OSS projects.

🔍 What we offer

  • Fully and asynchronous remote work within Spain, independence, ownership and flexibility is what you can expect from our mindset.

  • Fair wages for people with attitude above all (60k - 80k negotiable).

  • Evolve in a stimulating and challenging environment.

  • Share and learn with a passionate and diverse team.

  • Work from home budget, choose what you need to create your dream home office, including internet and electricity.

  • Annual learning budget, learn a new programming language or go to a tech conference, if it is important for your career, it is important for us.

  • Fully paid team building activities three or four times a year, somewhere around the world.

Clovr Labs is incorporated in Spain and the team meets regularly in Barcelona. We speak English and Spanish, most of the time at the same time, but we would appreciate it if you could send us the contents of your application in English.

Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET (Canada-only)

Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation

Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment type: Full-time or contract, depending on client engagement
Seniority: Senior
Industry: Financial Services / Credit Unions

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.

  • Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.

  • Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

  • Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.

Digital Banking & Credit Union Testing

  • Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.

  • Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.

  • Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.

  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.

  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.

  • Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.

  • Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.

  • Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.

  • Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.

  • Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software testing or quality engineering experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on test automation development.

  • Experience testing financial services, banking, credit union or other transaction-intensive applications.

  • Strong proficiency with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.

  • Programming or scripting experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, or Python.

  • Strong API testing skills using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, authentication, authorization and system integrations.

  • Experience with SQL, data validation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, defect management and risk-based testing.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate directly with client stakeholders.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with Canadian credit unions or digital banking transformation programs.

  • Testing digital banking platforms such as VeriPark, Backbase, Central 1 Forge/MemberDirect, Intellect Design, Temenos, Lumin or eBankIT.

  • Integration testing with core banking systems, especially Fiserv DNA or CGI RFS360.

  • Experience with Canadian payment capabilities, including Interac e-Transfer, bill payments, and payment processing.

  • Knowledge of mortgage lending, loan origination, commercial banking or CRM workflows.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, and . NET-based enterprise environments.

  • Mobile application testing across iOS and Android.

  • Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or similar tools.

  • Accessibility testing aligned with WCAG standards.

  • Experience testing AI-generated code or implementing automated quality controls in AI-assisted development environments.

  • Experience supporting banking platform migration, cutover or production hypercare.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to:

  • Understand the client's digital banking architecture, critical workflows and integration dependencies.

  • Establish or improve automated regression coverage for high-priority banking journeys.

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend practical improvements.

  • Contribute to reliable release-readiness reporting and defect management.

  • Reduce manual regression effort while improving confidence in production releases.

Why Join Aequilibrium?

  • Work on meaningful digital banking modernization projects with Canadian credit unions.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, architects, and banking specialists.

  • Contribute to complex integration, automation, and member-experience challenges.

  • Help shape modern quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and testing.

  • Join a remote-first Canadian team focused on purposeful impact and technical excellence.

To apply: Please submit your resume and highlight your test automation expertise, financial services experience, banking platforms, and core banking integrations in your cover letter.

Role: Platform Engineer – AI & Automation Platform

This role is responsible for building, operating, and advancing the shared platform capabilities that product teams depend on to deliver secure, scalable, AI-enabled solutions. The engineer will help drive platform reliability, AI enablement, automation, CI/CD modernization, observability, and developer acceleration across the SDLC. The ideal candidate combines strong platform engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in automation, AI-assisted development workflows, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, and enterprise delivery tooling.

  • Build, manage, and evolve shared platform engineering capabilities across Power Platform, Dynamics 365 F&O, Azure, AWS, APIs, integrations, and digital applications

  • Implement reusable platform services, automation frameworks, connectors, templates, shared components, and developer acceleration tooling
  • Support AI and automation lifecycle capabilities including Power Platform Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot integrations, Azure AI Foundry, machine learning workflows, and agent orchestration patterns
  • Build and support platform observability including telemetry, logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational dashboards
  • Support automated quality engineering practices including pipeline validation, regression execution, automated testing integration, and release gating
  • Implement and operationalize platform security controls including RBAC, managed identities, API security, secrets management, DLP policies, audit logging, and environment governance
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Cloud Engineering, and Data & AI teams to align implementations with enterprise standards and governance requirements
  • Support AI governance practices including behavioral monitoring, agent lifecycle controls, Responsible AI enforcement, risk evaluation, and operational review processes
  • Assist product and engineering teams with platform onboarding, automation adoption, environment provisioning, troubleshooting, and platform optimization
  • Drive platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence across shared engineering services
  • Contribute to developer experience improvements through automation, self-service tooling, standardized patterns, and reusable engineering assets
  • Support cost optimization, performance tuning, and operational efficiency initiatives across cloud and platform services

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Automation Engineering, or related enterprise engineering roles

  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar platforms
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, environment management, and configuration management
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, authentication, OAuth, REST services, and enterprise integration patterns
  • Experience supporting cloud-native and hybrid architectures across Azure and AWS

  • Experience with AI-enabled engineering workflows, Copilot technologies, LLM integrations, automation tooling, or agentic workflows
  • Strong understanding of platform security, governance, operational controls, and enterprise engineering standards
  • Experience supporting agile product delivery teams in large enterprise environments
  • Strong troubleshooting, automation, and systems thinking capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power Platform Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or enterprise AI enablement platforms
  • Experience supporting AI orchestration, MCP-based integration patterns, automation agents, or AI-assisted SDLC workflows
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, Playwright, pipeline-based quality enforcement, or test automation platforms
  • Experience with containerization, serverless architectures, and modern cloud platform services
  • Experience with Application Insights, Log Analytics, Power BI operational reporting, or enterprise telemetry platforms
  • Familiarity with SOX controls, audit readiness, operational governance, and regulated enterprise environments

Architect solutions covering data ingestion, preprocessing, search and retrieval, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), fine-tuning, and prompt engineering. Large Language Model (LLM) architectures including transformer-based models, such as GPT, BERT, or T5. Training, fine-tuning, and adapting large-scale LLMs for domain-specific applications. Text generation, summarization, classification, question answering, and entity extraction as part of implementing scalable information retrieval systems. Open Source and research contributions related to machine learning or Artificial Intelligence. Position:Software Engineer - Consumer Products

About Lincoln Center:
Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts is a global home for music, dance, theater, film, and culture. We steward a 16-acre campus in New York City, collaborate with leading resident arts organizations, and connect millions of people to the arts each year. We are building a modern digital foundation that expands access to culture, deepens relationships with audiences, and supports new creative frontiers.

Role Overview:Lincoln Center is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Commerce team within the Digital Experience (DX) department. The DX department builds and operates a digital ecosystem that reflects the excellence of the art presented on our stages. Within DX, the Commerce team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that power ticketing, donations, memberships, and patron accounts.

Reporting to the Tech Lead for Consumer Products, the Software Engineer will work closely with Product Managers to design, build, and maintain the core commerce experiences that drive revenue and audience engagement across Lincoln Center.

This role focuses on delivering reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems that support how audiences discover events, complete transactions, manage their accounts, and engage over time. You will contribute to the development of modern, API-driven platforms that integrate with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, payment providers, and analytics tools.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who cares about user experience, system reliability, and performance. This person brings technical rigor, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset, with experience building or contributing to digital commerce systems. This role is highly cross-functional and sits at the intersection of digital experience, engineering, operations, and data.

What you'll get to do here:

  • Build and maintain features that support ticketing, checkout, donations, memberships, and patron account experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Designers to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, payment processors, and third-party services.
  • Optimize performance and reliability across high-traffic commerce experiences, particularly during on-sale and peak demand periods.
  • Implement analytics tracking and instrumentation to support funnel analysis, experimentation, and continuous optimization.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of API-driven architectures that enable flexibility, scalability, and reuse across systems.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, and participate in code reviews to uphold engineering standards.
  • Support debugging, troubleshooting, and resolution of production issues to ensure a stable and consistent patron experience.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve system usability, reduce operational friction, and enhance internal workflows.
  • Help ensure all commerce experiences meet accessibility standards and deliver a seamless, intuitive user experience.

You'll be a fit if you bring:

  • Experience in building or contributing to digital commerce systems such as ticketing, e-commerce, payments, or subscription platforms.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in modern web development technologies such as JavaScript or TypeScript, and frameworks such as React or Next.js.
  • Experience working with backend systems and APIs, including REST or GraphQL services.
  • Familiarity with integrating external systems such as payment gateways, CRM platforms, or ticketing systems.
  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Understanding of modern software development practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems across multiple integrations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with analytics, experimentation, or performance optimization is a plus.

What is Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts?

Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc. (LCPA) is a cultural and civic cornerstone of New York City. We believe the arts play an important role in our lives: they nourish our hearts and minds, teach us valuable lessons and critical skills, and help us create community. We invite you to consider joining our talented, multi-faceted team.

We are:

1. The manager of the 16-acre Lincoln Center campus

-We are one of eleven amazing resident arts organizations

2. A leading Arts Presenter.

-We curate numerous programs and performances, showcasing music, dance, and more

3. An Education Hub.

-We have reached 20 million students, educators, principals, and community members

Who are our people?

LCPA is a team of dreamers, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who use unique platforms in the heart of New York City and beyond to advocate for the transformative impact of artistic experiences.

Lincoln Center People imagine and create in concert with this mission by founding President John D. Rockefeller III - "The arts are not for the privileged few, but for the many. Their place is not on the periphery of daily life, but at its center."

We welcome applicants from all sectors who agilely solve problems, show up as they are, and can't stop innovating.

What’s the news?

Recent and Upcoming Programming

  • Lincoln Center Reveals 25/26 Season Featuring Jeanine Tesori as Visionary Artist
  • Kyle Abraham's 20 Years of Urgency at Lincoln Center Rose Theatre

Campus Happenings

  • Lincoln Center Gets $50 Million Gift to Promote Contemporary Dance
  • The new JFK terminal will show iconic artworks from MoMA, the Met and Lincoln Center

Legacies of San Juan Hill

  • WNYC: Lincoln Center Celebrates 'Legacies of San Juan Hill
  • Lincoln Center Launches San Juan Hill Project Digital Hub To Remember the Lost Urban Neighborhood

Who is our President and CEO?

Dr. Mariko Silver

Join us!

jobs.excerpt: About Us! At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life.
jobs.description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Lead Unreal Engine Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of a complex Unreal Engine application for an immersive, interactive experience.

In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.

You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring that all software components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Roles and Responsibilities

1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

  • Own, develop, and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD).
  • Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.
  • Establish development standards and best practices for C++, Blueprints, project organization, and source control.
  • Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and potential integration challenges early in development.
  • Document the final application architecture and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unreal Engine Application Development & Delivery

  • Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unreal Engine application.
  • Implement and maintain core application systems using C++ and Blueprints.
  • Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.
  • Troubleshoot performance, rendering, compatibility, and application stability issues.
  • Manage application packaging, deployment configurations, and final production builds.
  • Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

  • Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.
  • Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.
  • Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

  • Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unreal application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.
  • Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.
  • Support integration with external hardware, display systems, and control interfaces.
  • Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.
  • Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

  • Coordinate with a third-party web development vendor responsible for creating web-based UI overlays.
  • Define and support communication interfaces between Unreal Engine and web-based UI components.
  • Integrate web overlays into the Unreal application, ensuring reliable communication, rendering, and interaction.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with the vendor on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

  • Collaborate with Unreal Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, and visual systems.
  • Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.
  • Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates and hardware requirements.
  • Troubleshoot rendering, shader, material, and Blueprint integration issues.
  • Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements

Your Journey Includes

Must Have Experience

  • Unreal Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering applications using Unreal Engine 5.
  • C++ Programming: Strong proficiency in Unreal C++ development, debugging, and application architecture.
  • Blueprints: Advanced knowledge of Blueprint systems and best practices for combining Blueprints with C++.
  • Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing GPU/CPU performance, shaders, materials, and real-time rendering.
  • Application Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable software systems and integrating work from multiple developers.
  • Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.
  • Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.
  • Production Delivery: Experience building, troubleshooting, packaging, and deploying production-ready Unreal Engine applications.

Nice to Have Experience

  • JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.
  • React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unreal Engine.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.
  • Shader & Material Development: Experience building custom shaders, materials, and advanced rendering effects in Unreal Engine.
  • Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.
  • AV & Show Control Systems: Experience with external control systems, hardware communication protocols, and real-time event-driven applications.
  • Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability.

Thank you for applying. We're committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it's not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

Job Title: Platform Engineer - Commercial Services Tools

Job Location: Budapest, Hungary

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is the cloud software leader for the life sciences industry, building the platform that helps the world’s largest pharma and biotech companies bring treatments to patients faster. The Commercial Tools team is building the next generation of services tools that our global services teams rely on every day, and we're building them best-in-class on a genuinely modern stack.
As a Services Platform Engineer you'll ship real, cutting-edge AI features to production fast — working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small, highly collaborative team that moves quickly and hands you real ownership from day one. You'll go deep across backend, frontend, cloud and applied AI, learn from engineers who know the craft, and build a career at the frontier of AI engineering — in an industry where the software you write helps get treatments to patients faster.

What You'll Do

    • Build best-in-class AI features end to end — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and LLM apps on AWS Bedrock and Bedrock Knowledge Bases, like our CRM Helper on ECS Fargate — and ship them to production fast
    • Design and ship async Python services (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async, asyncpg on Postgres 17) that stream live job progress to users over WebSocket/SSE
    • Build and own features in our React/TypeScript portal that global services teams rely on every single day
    • Take real ownership from day one — features are yours from design through deploy, with mentorship from engineers who know the craft
    • Move fast and keep it solid: own the tests, CI and observability that let a small team ship confidently every day
    • Range across the whole stack — backend, frontend, cloud (AWS) and applied AI — and go as deep as your curiosity takes you
    • Learn the Veeva Vault and CRM platform APIs that power the life-sciences tools you're building

Requirements

    • 2+ years building and shipping real production software — you've put your work in front of real users
    • Strong Python with hands-on experience building async REST APIs, FastAPI ideal (SQLAlchemy 2 async / asyncpg / Postgres a plus)
    • You've built at least one real agent or RAG application and understand embeddings, vector search, chunking, and prompting in practice
    • Comfortable across the stack — happy to jump into a React/TypeScript frontend as well as backend services
    • Working knowledge of SQL / PostgreSQL and confident with Git-based team workflows
    • Foundational AWS — you've deployed something and understand IAM roles and containers (Docker)
    • Genuine curiosity for AI and hunger to learn new tech fast — you want to build a career at the frontier of AI engineering
    • Strong written and verbal English, and you thrive in a fast-moving, fully remote team

Nice to Have

    • Exposure to AWS Bedrock and agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph
    • Async Python and WebSocket/SSE streaming
    • Frontend experience with React, TypeScript, Vite and MUI
    • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines
    • Observability tooling such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 14,000,000 - 24,000,000 HUF
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. jobs.description:
Job Title: Scrum Master

Term: 12 months

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Reports to: Technical Program Manager

Level: Intermediate/ Senior (4-8 years of relevant experience).

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate and coordinate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective) with clear agendas, time-boxing, and documented outcomes (decisions, risks, actions, owners, due dates).
  • Own and maintain the team's delivery metrics dashboard (sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, defect rates, cycle time, cumulative flow), surfacing trends and escalating concerns to the TPM.
  • Actively identify, track, and remove constraints blocking squad members from delivering sprint goals; escalate cross-organizational blockers to the TPM within agreed SLAs.
  • Coach squad members and relevant stakeholders on agile principles, Scrum practices, and delivery best practices, progressively building internal agile capability.
  • Facilitate cross-squad coordination where multiple technical work streams (Backend, Frontend, API, Data) have interdependent sprint commitments.
  • Support knowledge transfer by ensuring that process documentation, decision logs, and sprint artefacts are maintained in the agreed shared workspace.
  • Report on delivery health metrics at fortnightly steering cadence, partnering with the TPM for programme-level reporting.

Measurable Outcomes & Deliverables

First 30 Days

  • Attend all Scrum ceremonies and produce baseline assessment of ceremony health, compliance, and documentation gaps.
  • Own the delivery metrics dashboard and report on velocity, burndown, defect rates, and cycle time and report any present gaps.
  • Produce a cross-squad dependency register across Backend, Frontend, API, and Data workstreams.
  • Confirm fortnightly steering cadence with the TPM and key stakeholders.

Days 31–60

  • Sprint velocity stabilizing; at least two consecutive sprints with 80% sprint goal achievement.
  • DoD compliance rate tracked and reported; 90% of completed stories meet DoD criteria.
  • Backlog health confirmed: two sprints of stories refined and sprint-ready at all times.
  • At least one agile coaching session delivered to client counterparts or junior squad members.
  • Delivery metrics dashboard live and shared with TPM and stakeholders.

Days 61–90

  • Retrospective improvement actions tracked; demonstrable improvement in at least two delivery metrics since sprint 1.
  • Agile maturity assessment (informal) of squad completed; coaching plan for remaining engagement period produced.
  • All sprint ceremonies running to time and rated as useful by squad members (informal pulse check).
  • Knowledge transfer - one squad member or stakeholder who has visibly adopted improved Scrum practices through coaching

Ongoing KPIs

  • Enable the squad to consistently achieve agreed sprint goals through effective planning and execution.
  • Ensure stories meet the agreed Definition of Done before acceptance.
  • Proactively identify, escalate, and facilitate resolution of delivery blockers and dependencies.
  • Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog that supports upcoming sprint planning and delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement by facilitating effective sprint ceremonies and retrospectives and ensuring agreed improvement actions are followed through.

Stakeholders & Ways of Working

Agile Ceremonies Owned: Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement.

Reporting Cadence:

  • Fortnightly delivery health summary to TPM.
  • Sprint metrics dashboard updated at end of each sprint.
  • Ad-hoc impediment escalation to TPM as required.

Cross-Functional Touchpoints:

  • All squad roles (API Engineer, Backend, Frontend, Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer).
  • Product Owners and stakeholders attending sprint reviews.
  • TPM for programme-level dependency and risk alignment.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–8 years of experience in Scrum Master or agile delivery roles, with at least 2 years in technology delivery environments.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification required.
  • Proven ability to facilitate agile ceremonies for cross-functional technical teams, including engineers, data scientists, and designers.
  • Experience tracking and improving delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, burndown, DoD compliance).
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills; ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and remove impediments at both team and organizational level.
  • Experience working in embedded client-side or consulting delivery contexts preferred.
  • Familiarity with backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
  • Understanding software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, integration, and release processes.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SAFe Agilist or equivalent scaled agile certification.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or mobile money delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with Kanban or hybrid Scrum/Kanban delivery models.
  • Prior experience embedding within a client organisation in a consulting or secondment capacity.
  • Experience facilitating agile transformations or team capability-building programmes.
  • Exposure to API integration, backend, or data science delivery workstreams.

Tools & Technologies

  • Backlog and sprint management: Jira / Azure DevOps / equivalent
  • Documentation and knowledge base: Confluence / SharePoint
  • Communication: Microsoft Teams
  • Metrics and reporting: Jira dashboards / Excel / Azure DevOps dashboards
  • Retrospective facilitation: Miro or equivalent
  • Collaboration: Miro / Mural / equivalent virtual whiteboard

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
